jobs.title: AI Engineer | PAM Health Corporate
jobs.description: Overview: The AI Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and deploying AI\-driven automation solutions across PAM Health. Acting as a crucial technical contributor, this individual will partner with business stakeholders across the organization to identify workflows that can be optimized. Leveraging large language models (LLMs) and agentic frameworks, the AI Engineer will build tools that enhance organizational efficiency and support patient care. This role spans a broad range of experience levels (Junior to Senior, with expectations scaling accordingly) and requires a strong commitment to deploying technology within a secure, HIPAA\-compliant healthcare environment. Responsibilities: **I. Position Responsibilities*** AI Development \& Automation: Design, build, and maintain AI agents and automation workflows using Python to streamline processes across clinical, financial, HR, and administrative departments * Framework Utilization: Leverage modern agent development SDKs and frameworks (such as LangChain, Pydantic AI, Google ADK, or the OpenAI Agents SDK) to build robust, scalable AI applications * System Integration: Integrate AI solutions with existing enterprise applications and Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems, facilitating secure and efficient data exchange * Cloud Deployment: Deploy, host, and manage AI models and applications within cloud infrastructure * AI\-Assisted Engineering: Accelerate development timelines and maintain high code quality by actively utilizing AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, or Antigravity) * Security \& Compliance: Ensure all AI tools and automated workflows adhere to strict healthcare compliance standards, maintaining data privacy, security, and HIPAA compliance when handling Protected Health Information (PHI) * Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with non\-technical stakeholders across the organization to gather requirements, scope automation projects, and translate business challenges into actionable AI solutions * Continuous Innovation: Actively monitor, test, and evaluate emerging AI technologies, models, and industry best practices **II. Leadership*** Inclusiveness: Promotes cooperation, fairness and equity; shows respect for people and their differences; works to understand perspectives of others; demonstrates empathy; brings out the best in others and in his/her team * Managing Staff: Coaches, evaluates, develops, and inspires staff; sets expectations; recognizes achievements * Stewardship and Resource Management: Demonstrates accountability and sound judgment in managing company resources; appropriate understanding of confidentiality and company values; adheres to and supports company policies, procedures and safety guidelines * Problem\-Solving: Identifies problems and involves others in seeking solutions; conducts appropriate analysis and searches for best solutions; effectively and efficiently implements appropriate responses to correct problems; responds promptly and effectively to new challenges * Decision\-Making: Makes clear, consistent decisions; acts with integrity in all decisions; distinguishes relevant from irrelevant information; makes timely, appropriate decisions. * Strategic Planning and Organizing: Understands company vision and aligns priorities accordingly; measures outcomes; uses feedback to redirect as required; evaluates alternatives; appropriately organizes complex issues to desirable resolution * Communication: Connects with peers, subordinate employees and all customers; actively listens; clearly and effectively shares information; demonstrates effective oral and written communication skills; negotiates effectively. * Quality Improvement: Strives for efficient, effective, high\-quality performance in self and in the department; delivers timely and accurate results; resilient when responding to matters that are challenging; takes initiative to make improvements * Leadership: Motivates others; accepts responsibility; maintains high morale in department; develops trust and credibility; expects honest and ethical behavior of self and staff * Teamwork: Encourages cooperation and collaboration; builds effective teams; works in partnership with others; is flexible; responsive to the needs of others * Development: Maintains up\-to\-date skills through involvement with professional organizations and/or continuing education **III. Customer Service*** Maintains the highest level of customer service via courtesy, compassion and positive communication. * Promotes the mission and vision of PAM Health within the work environment and the community. * Respects dignity and confidentiality by adherence to all applicable policies and procedures. **IV. Health and Safety*** Works in a manner that promotes safety; wears clothing appropriate to the performance of the job. * Participates in OSHA required training. * Follows universal precautions as appropriate for position; complies with Employee Health requirements for continued employment. * Reports unsafe practices to management. * Knows own role in case of an emergency Qualifications: **POSITION QUALIFICATIONS:** **Education and Training:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field; OR equivalent practical/professional experience. **Experience:*** Proven software engineering experience (level commensurate with Junior to Senior expectations), with a primary focus on Python development * Demonstrated hands\-on experience building, testing, and deploying AI\-driven applications, LLMs, or autonomous aagents * Preferred: Familiarity with the healthcare industry; especially in the post\-acute care sector * Preferred: Experience integrating with, or extracting data from, Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems * Preferred: Experience deploying AI and software solutions in secure, HIPAA\-compliant environments handling sensitive data * Preferred: Experience with cloud computing platforms, specifically Microsoft Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:*** Strong proficiency in Python programming and its broader data/AI ecosystem * Familiarity with agent development SDKs (e.g., LangChain, Pydantic AI, Google ADK, OpenAI Agents SDK) * High proficiency with modern AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity) * Solid understanding of Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) fundamentals (embeddings, vector stores, multi\-modal data processing * Strong understanding of RESTful API development and third\-party system integrations * Knowledge of data privacy principles, security best practices, and healthcare regulatory requirements (HIPAA) * Excellent problem\-solving skills with the ability to operate as a technical generalist across varied business domains * Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex AI concepts to non\-technical stakeholders clearly and effectively About PAM Health: **PAM HEALTH (PAM)** based in Enola, Pennsylvania, provides specialty healthcare services through more than 80 locations, as well as wound clinics and outpatient physical therapy locations, in 17 states. jobs.title: AI Solutions Developer
jobs.description: **JOB POSTING** =============== **TITLE:** AI Solutions Developer **STATUS:** Full\-time, Exempt **DEPARTMENT:** Information Technology **LOCATION:** Atlanta, GA (Hybrid) **REPORTS TO:** VP, Member Technology **DATE:** 10/1/2026 **ABOUT THE ROLE** ------------------ UniPro Foodservice is hiring its first dedicated AI Solutions Developer. The job is not to run a research lab or train models from scratch. It is to work with our IT teams and the people closest to the business, build software that uses AI where it genuinely helps, and turn the ideas that work into secure, maintainable solutions. The work will also extend beyond UniPro. This role will consult directly with our Members on practical AI opportunities, help them think through tools and implementation approaches, and support Member\-facing pilots and solutions. Successful work here can have a meaningful impact across our membership, not only inside our own organization. **ABOUT UNIPRO** ---------------- We're a cooperative of independent foodservice distributors. Our Members compete against companies many times their size, and they win by staying closer to their customers and moving faster. UniPro gives them the scale, buying power, Supplier relationships, data, and technology that would otherwise be much harder to access on their own. That makes the scope of this role broader than a typical internal development position. Something we build for UniPro may improve our own operations first, become part of a Member\-facing product, or turn into a practical approach we can help Members apply in their own businesses. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** ------------------ You'll start by learning how UniPro actually works and where AI can improve a real process. You won't be doing that work on your own. You'll work side by side with Member Technology, Development, Data, Operations, Security, and business teams, using the same standards and delivery processes that support the rest of our technology environment. **Build and deliver useful AI solutions** * Design and build AI\-enabled software, services, agents, integrations, and automation using appropriate technologies for the problem and the environment. * Prototype quickly, then take the ideas that work through architecture, testing, security, deployment, monitoring, documentation, and support. * Work directly with model APIs and practical patterns such as structured outputs, tool or function calling, agents, retrieval\-augmented generation, semantic search, and human review where they make sense. * Work through established Git, pull request, code review, testing, and CI/CD practices with the IT teams responsible for the systems you are changing. * Work with the teams that own the data to make sure the information behind a solution is reliable enough to build on, and build evaluation and monitoring into what you ship. **Work with UniPro teams and our Members** * Sit with teams across IT, finance, procurement, rebates, Member operations, and Supplier relationships to understand where the friction really is before deciding what to build. * Consult directly with Members on practical AI opportunities, tool choices, implementation approaches, controls, and adoption, working with Member Technology and the other UniPro teams needed to support the work. * Help Members and internal teams understand what is realistic, where the tradeoffs are, and what needs more validation before it is ready for production use. * Run pilots with the people who will use the result, including Members where appropriate, measure what worked and what did not, and use that feedback to improve the next version. * Bring what we learn from Member work back into UniPro standards, reusable patterns, and Member\-facing solutions where it can help the broader membership. **Help establish how AI is used responsibly** * Work with IT leadership and the appropriate IT teams to establish a standard process for evaluating, approving, building, and releasing AI capabilities across UniPro. * Help put the right controls around each use case, including risk assessment, data handling and security, architecture and code quality, testing and evaluation, documentation, ownership, monitoring, and long\-term maintainability. * Help define when additional review, approval, or training is needed before a tool or feature is made broadly available, and make sure users have the guidance they need to use it well. * Contribute to UniPro's AI roadmap, bring a practical technical point of view to what is feasible and worth doing, and work with the responsible teams to deliver against it. * Test new models, tools, and frameworks when there is a reason to do so, and document what each material effort was meant to achieve and what it actually delivered. **WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** -------------------------- We're looking for someone who already knows how to build software and has gone far enough into applied AI to be useful on day one. You do not need to have trained models from scratch or spent years in an ML research lab. You do need strong development fundamentals, sound judgment, and evidence that you can turn new technology into something people can actually use and support. * Three to five years of professional software development experience, including hands\-on work with applied AI, automation, data\-intensive applications, or integrations. * Strong working knowledge of appropriate software development technologies, plus experience with APIs, authentication, SQL, Git, and modern software development practices. * Hands\-on experience with large language model APIs and patterns such as structured outputs, tool or function calling, agents, retrieval\-augmented generation, embeddings, or semantic search. * Experience taking software past the proof\-of\-concept stage, including automated testing, CI/CD, cloud deployment, logging and monitoring, production support, and the tradeoffs around quality, cost, latency, security, and maintainability. * Enough comfort with data to query it, combine sources, validate quality, and work with the people who own it when the answer is not sitting in one clean table. * The ability to sit down with a non\-technical colleague or Member, understand the real problem, explain the options and tradeoffs without jargon, and keep iterating when the first idea is not the right one. * A collaborative approach and comfort working across multiple IT and business teams rather than operating as a separate AI function. **Nice to have** * Experience with cloud and data platforms such as AWS, Azure, Snowflake, or similar. * Experience with Laravel/PHP, Vue, or working alongside a modern software application team. * Familiarity with Microsoft 365 and Copilot, Power Platform, D365 F\&O, or a background in foodservice, distribution, procurement, or supply chain. **WHY YOU MIGHT WANT THIS JOB** ------------------------------- * You'll help shape how UniPro uses AI at a point when the standards, reusable patterns, and operating model are still being established. * Your work gets used. We're small enough that you'll see what you build running in the business, and successful work can also reach our Members. * The scope is intentionally broad: internal software, operational automation, data\-heavy workflows, Member\-facing solutions, and Member consulting can all be part of the role. * You will work with experienced IT and business teams that can help turn good ideas into solutions that are supportable for the long term. **PRACTICAL DETAILS** --------------------- * Reports to the Vice President, Member Technology and works across the IT organization on architecture, standards, data, security, deployment, and production delivery. * Based in Atlanta, GA on a hybrid schedule. We'll consider fully remote for the right person. * Occasional travel, under 10 percent. * Occasional work outside normal hours to support projects or issues. * Other duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description: **About the role** You will be the main contact for a group of our clients after they sign with us. You will run regular check\-ins, track what we promised and what we delivered, and raise problems early. You will work closely with our project leads and consultants, and with our sales team on renewals and new work. Our clients are mostly US companies that run data and AI projects on platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, Salesforce, Informatica, Reltio, and Anaplan. jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ FlowGen Labs is a frontier enterprise AI company building the zero\-touch enterprise: context\-aware agents that operate inside deeply customized SAP environments at machine speed, grounded in each company’s ontology, current operational data, and operating procedures so complex workflows can run autonomously instead of relying on manual support teams. FlowGen is focused on turning legacy ERP from a system of record into an execution layer for finance and operations. Deployed at Fortune 500 companies across CPG, distribution, high\-tech, and oil and gas, FlowGen Labs brings together a frontier AI and SAP team from DeepMind, SAP, Meta AI, and Amazon AGI Labs. **Role Summary** ---------------- Build the systems that help FlowGen find the right customers and turn interest into revenue. You will work directly with the founders and go\-to\-market team to connect data, software, and AI across prospecting, marketing, and sales, giving a small team the reach and execution speed of a much larger one. This is a hands\-on engineering role with broad ownership. You will identify the real constraint, build a practical solution, and remain accountable through deployment, adoption, and measurable results. You will: * Build automated workflows that turn customer signals into qualified pipeline: account discovery, enrichment, prioritization, lead routing, and outbound activation. * Own enrichment end to end. Turn inbound interest, target account lists, and event contacts into accurate, deduplicated CRM records with useful account context and clear next steps. * Develop account scoring around our ideal customer profile. Combine company data, buying signals, and AI research to help the team focus on enterprises where FlowGen can deliver the most value. * Build AI agents and internal tools for account research, meeting preparation, call summaries, proposals, and RFP or security questionnaire drafts. Put useful account intelligence into the team's daily workflow. * Connect our CRM, enrichment providers, outbound tools, and internal data systems through APIs and reliable data pipelines. Own the data models, sync logic, and quality of the information the team relies on. * Ship code that holds up in production: clear reviews, logging, monitoring, retries, and error handling. Debug broken integrations, failed data jobs, and unreliable model outputs, and fix the underlying cause. * Work with the founders and sales team to find repetitive work, test new approaches, and measure what improves pipeline quality, conversion, and time spent selling. Keep improving the systems as the company scales. **What We Are Looking For** --------------------------- * 1\+ years building software or technical systems in GTM engineering, growth engineering, revenue operations, sales engineering, or a closely related role. A track record of shipping useful systems matters more than a specific title. * Strong Python and TypeScript skills. You can work with APIs and asynchronous workflows, design a database schema, and debug a production issue from logs. * Hands\-on experience with a modern GTM stack: CRMs, enrichment tools, and outbound platforms. You understand how accounts and leads move through a sales process and how to keep the underlying data trustworthy. * Practical experience building with LLMs, including prompt design, evaluations, structured outputs, and handling failures. You know how to make an AI workflow dependable enough for people to use every day. * Strong SQL skills and sound judgment about data models, integrations, and pipeline design. You think through duplicate records, API limits, concurrent updates, and what changes when volume grows. * Strong business judgment and crisp communication. You can turn an ambiguous sales or marketing problem into a scoped project, explain the tradeoffs, and connect technical work to business outcomes. * Ownership mentality and follow\-through on the details. No job is too small: you'll build a new agent and fix the broken CRM sync, and you do both well. * Real curiosity about enterprise AI, agentic workflows, and how large companies actually operate. Experience building CRM integrations or production AI applications is especially useful. **Why Join** ------------ * Work directly with the founders and shape how an early\-stage frontier enterprise AI company scales. * Help define how autonomous agents operate inside the systems that run the world’s largest companies. * Direct product and company impact with minimal bureaucracy. * A high bar for craft, velocity, accountability, and pragmatic shipping. **Logistics** ------------- * Location: In person, San Francisco Bay Area * Employment: Full time * Total Compensation: $150,000–$250,000 per year, including base salary and equity. jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - ML Systems
jobs.description: **About NextToken** ------------------- NextToken builds specialized models and the systems that help them improve. You’ll work directly with the founders on research and engineering, help shape our technical direction, and see your work deployed in customer products. **The role** ------------ You'll build the systems that make model improvement reliable and repeatable, from generating data and running experiments to evaluating and deploying checkpoints. Researchers and customer teams should be able to understand a run, recover from failures, and use its results without rebuilding the process each time. You'll work across data pipelines, distributed execution, training, and serving, with initial responsibility shaped around your strongest area. An important part of the job is deciding where existing tools fit and where the gaps lie. **What you'll work on** ----------------------- ### **Training and reinforcement learning** Develop the infrastructure for post\-training experiments, from distributed rollout execution to training and checkpoint evaluation. Improve resource allocation, parallel execution, and recovery so researchers can run more experiments and spend less time managing them. ### **Inference and performance** Make model serving efficient for both agent workloads and training data generation. Investigate bottlenecks in batching, KV\-cache use, scheduling, and memory movement, and evaluate changes against latency, throughput, cost, and model quality. Depending on your specialty, this can include kernel and runtime optimization with CUDA, Triton, or related tools. ### **Data generation and environments** Build scalable systems for collecting trajectories, coordinating teacher models, and running agent environments. Make data generation and evaluation reproducible, with reliable execution and clear connections between datasets and the experiments that use them. ### **Research tooling and deployment** Develop benchmarks, observability, and automated experiment workflows that help researchers test ideas and understand results. Work with researchers and customers to turn new methods into dependable training and deployment capabilities, and share useful systems work through technical writing and open\-source contributions where appropriate. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * Technical depth in ML infrastructure, with experience in training systems, model serving, or distributed data and rollout pipelines. You can reason about how these interact in demanding ML workloads. * Understanding of the execution demands of post\-training: how sampling, reward evaluation, optimization, and checkpoint updates fit together, and where efficiency or reliability can break down. * Ability to evaluate systems changes through reproducible measurements and work with researchers and customers to decide which problems matter most. Experience with distributed training frameworks, vLLM or SGLang, GPU profiling, container orchestration, or research platforms is particularly relevant. CUDA, Triton, and compiler or runtime expertise are useful specializations. We value depth in one area and the ability to work across the surrounding stack; kernel expertise is not required. We welcome engineers from ML infrastructure teams, research groups, and startups, including earlier\-career engineers with a substantial systems project. The depth of your contribution matters more than a particular title or tenure. **Apply** --------- Tell us about a system you're proud of: what it needed to do, what you personally built, and a difficult reliability or performance problem you solved. ideally in utility\-scale solar or energy infrastructure * Ability to read and interpret grading plans, topographic maps and civil drawings * Experience with survey data, DEMs/DTMs and coordinate systems * Proficiency in Civil 3D or similar * A track record of organization, adaptability, attention to detail, and project management skills * Located in the SF Bay Area or willing to relocate for in\-person role **NICE TO HAVE** * Experience estimating civil construction costs, including roads, fencing, grading, clearing and grubbing, and trenching. * Professional Engineering (PE) license. * Experience with 2D CAD and 3D CAD tools, such as Civil3D or SolidWorks * Geotechnical design experience with design of foundations, equipment pads, and/or utility trenches * Field experience in a construction environment **PHYSICAL AND SENSORY REQUIREMENTS** * A mix of desk work using standard office equipment * This role may require occasional (\<10%) travel to project sites **WHAT WE OFFER** * 11 paid company holidays and flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) * Company\-paid in\-office lunches * Stock options * Medical, vision, dental, and other benefits * Pre\-tax commuter benefits * 401(k) This jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description: **Software Developer** ====================== Information Technology · Atlanta, GA (Hybrid) · Full\-time, Exempt UniPro Foodservice is looking for a software developer who wants to work across the whole stack instead of one piece of it. On most of our projects, the same person builds the front end, the service behind it, and the integration that connects it. We’re a small development team. The applications we support get used every day by Members, Suppliers, and our own staff, so you’ll know the people using what you build. **About UniPro** ---------------- We’re a cooperative of independent foodservice distributors. Our Members compete against companies many times their size, and they win by staying closer to their customers and moving faster. UniPro gives them the scale, buying power, supplier relationships, and increasingly the data and technology that would otherwise be out of reach. The software we build is a real part of that. It’s how Members do business with us. **What you’ll do** ------------------ **Build across the stack** * Build features end to end, from the interface to the application logic to the data underneath. * Work in our current stack. Vue.js and TailwindCSS on the front end, PHP/Laravel and MySQL behind it, all running on Ubuntu and AWS. You’ll also pick up whatever else a project needs. * Build user\-facing features that are usable, accessible, and work on the screen sizes people actually have. * Build and maintain APIs, services, and scheduled processes. **Connect systems** * Build integrations between our applications, vendor platforms, and Member and Supplier systems: APIs, file exchanges, and EDI. * Write and tune SQL, and work with our data team on data\-driven features. **Keep it running** * Maintain and improve applications already in production, including code you didn’t write. * Write tests, review code, and help releases go out cleanly through CI/CD. * Keep an eye on performance and reliability, from query efficiency to page load and rendering. * Follow secure development practices: credential handling, keeping dependencies current, and protecting Member and Supplier data. * Learn where your code actually runs. Our applications sit on Ubuntu servers in AWS, and we want you comfortable enough to read a log and track down a problem. * Diagnose problems when something breaks, document what you found, and propose a fix. **Work with the people who use it** * Sit with business stakeholders to understand the workflow before you build for it, and get to clear acceptance criteria before you start. * Use AI coding tools where they help. We expect generated code to be reviewed and tested like anything else. **What we’re looking for** -------------------------- * A college degree or equivalent certifications. Equivalent experience will be considered. * Roughly 3 to 5 years building and supporting web or business applications. * Solid fundamentals in at least one modern language, plus HTML, CSS, and JavaScript or TypeScript. We prefer PHP/Laravel experience, since that’s what our existing applications run on. * Experience with a component\-based frontend framework, and with server\-side code and APIs. * Comfort with relational databases and SQL. * Git and code review as normal practice. * Enough comfort at the Linux command line that working on a server isn’t a problem. * Effective, responsible use of AI\-assisted development tools. This is specific knowledge we’re hiring for, and an area we’ll keep investing in. * Evidence that you’ve picked up something unfamiliar and gotten productive with it. That matters more to us than matching our stack exactly. **Nice to have, and we’ll teach you the rest** ---------------------------------------------- * Our specific stack: PHP/Laravel, Vue.js, TailwindCSS, MySQL. * EDI or file\-based integration work. * AWS, Ubuntu/Linux administration, or Nginx. * Automated testing and CI/CD, and GitHub workflows. * Snowflake, D365 F\&O, or other systems we integrate with. **Why you might want this job** ------------------------------- * The scope is wide. You won’t be assigned one piece of one application and left there. * Your work gets used. We’re small enough that you’ll see it running in the business and hear about it when it helps. * You’ll work directly with the people you’re building for. * There’s room to grow, and we invest in further training to help you get there. **Practical details** --------------------- * Reports to the Manager, IT Development. * Based in Atlanta, GA on a hybrid schedule. We’ll consider fully remote for the right person. * Occasional travel, under 10 percent. * Occasional work outside normal hours to support releases or production issues. * Other duties as assigned.

From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. Whether you’re designing next\-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career. Responsibilities: **THE ROLE:** We are looking for a Firmware Engineer with a strong background in low level firmware and SoC power management. As part of the Power Management Firmware (PMFW) team, the Engineer will design, develop, integrate, and debug firmware responsible for power management and platform control across AMD SoCs. The role spans pre silicon development and validation through silicon bring up, production readiness, and customer enablement. The engineer will work closely with firmware architects, silicon design, power and performance teams, BIOS, validation, and other firmware teams to develop robust platform firmware and drive complex issues to resolution. **THE PERSON:** You are passionate about low level firmware development and enjoy solving complex problems at the intersection of hardware and software. You are a motivated self starter who can work independently while collaborating effectively across firmware, silicon, validation, and architecture teams. You have strong debugging and problem solving skills and are comfortable owning technical problems from initial investigation through root cause and resolution. You have excellent technical communication and interpersonal skills and can provide technical leadership on complex firmware development and platform bring up activities. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Design, develop, integrate, and debug platform management and power management firmware for AMD SoCs * Lead firmware feature development from pre silicon through silicon bring up, validation, and production * Debug complex firmware and hardware interactions and drive issues through root cause and resolution * Collaborate with architecture, silicon, BIOS, validation, and power teams to define and deliver platform features * Provide technical leadership, design and code reviews, and mentorship to other firmware engineers **PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:** * Strong embedded firmware development experience with C and C\+\+ * Experience with SoC power management, boot, reset, initialization, or other low level platform firmware * Strong understanding of SoC architecture and hardware firmware interfaces * Experience with pre silicon development and post silicon bring up and debug * Strong debugging and root cause analysis skills across firmware and hardware boundaries * Demonstrated ability to independently own complex firmware features and technical problems * Demonstrated ability to leverage AI assisted development and debugging tools to improve firmware quality, debug efficiency, and engineering productivity **ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree preferred in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. **\#LI\-NP1** Qualifications: *Benefits offered are described:* AMD benefits at a glance. *AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee\-based recruitment services. AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third\-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants’ needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process.* *AMD may use Artificial Intelligence to help screen, assess or select applicants for this position. AMD’s “Responsible AI Policy” is available* *here.* *This posting is for an existing vacancy.*

jobs.title: Principal Engineer
jobs.description: We are driven to do more. More for our customers and the financial professionals who offer our products. If you are driven to do more and love the challenge of pursuing more, Athene is your kind of company. You will find we offer more than the basics to create an inclusive and dynamic work environment at our various locations. **Purpose \& Impact:** Help build Athene’s founding engineering team in Austin and shape technology that transforms how annuity and retirement products are distributed and managed. As Principal Engineer, you will provide hands\-on technical leadership for a new platform, starting with the product rules and calculation services that support guarantee decisioning and the interfaces that enable AI systems to use those services safely. You will design and deliver critical software, guide complex engineering decisions and establish practices that help the team build with speed, quality and accountability. With executive sponsorship, Athene’s scale and Apollo’s investment expertise, this is an opportunity to build something consequential while putting innovation, ownership and our BEAM values into practice. **Key Deliverables:** * **Design and build core platform services.** Translate business and actuarial requirements into scalable product rules, calculation services and APIs. Partner with Product, Actuarial, Operations and engineering teams to align designs, dependencies and delivery priorities. * **Deliver critical software and guide technical decisions.** Build prototypes, define system interfaces and solve complex implementation challenges. Write and review production code, lead design reviews and create clear technical documentation that other engineers and coding agents can use. * **Build controls into the platform.** Design for calculation accuracy, auditability, data integrity, security and reliable operations. Develop interfaces that allow AI agents to interact with financial services through appropriate permissions, validation and safeguards. * **Advance development with AI coding agents.** Decompose work, coordinate multiple agents and establish testing and review gates for their output. Remain accountable for delivered software and measure improvements in delivery time, quality and engineering effort. * **Establish reliable engineering practices.** Strengthen automated testing, CI/CD, observability, release controls and production readiness. Investigate incidents, address underlying causes and improve the systems and practices that prevent recurrence. * **Simplify solutions and develop team capability.** Reuse existing capabilities where practical, make sound technical trade\-offs and reduce unnecessary complexity. Mentor engineers through design discussions, code reviews and pairing, helping the team make effective decisions independently. **What You Need to Bring:** * 6\+ years of designing, building and operating production software systems or relevant professional experience, preferred. * Demonstrated success guiding complex technical designs and delivering software in collaboration with other experienced engineers. * Demonstrated expertise using multiple AI coding agents to deliver production software, including task decomposition, orchestration, automated validation and review. Ability to explain and substantiate the impact on delivery speed and quality while independently evaluating and troubleshooting generated code. * Deep hands\-on expertise in cloud\-native, distributed, API\-first systems, with technologies such as Python, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, AWS, event streaming, infrastructure as code and modern CI/CD. * Experience developing interfaces and controls for AI agents, including tool or Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, permissions, safeguards and evaluations. Experience with rules engines, calculation or pricing services, or annuity and retirement products is a plus. * Experience building systems in financial services or another highly regulated environment, with strong attention to accuracy, security, auditability and data integrity. Bring clear written communication, critical thinking, adaptability and the ability to influence and mentor through technical expertise. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. **Willing to consider candidates at multiple levels based on skills and experience.** Drive. Discipline. Confidence. Focus. Commitment. Learn more about working at Athene. Athene is a Military Friendly Employer! Learn more about how we support our Veterans. Athene is committed to inclusion and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other status protected by federal, state or local law.

You will work closely with engineering teams and technical leaders across the United States, Australia, and India. **About the Team** Atlassian’s Dev AI engineering organization is pioneering the next generation of AI\-native developer experiences and autonomous software development lifecycle (SDLC) capabilities. We build the intelligent platforms, agent runtimes, and developer tooling that empower engineering teams worldwide—transforming how software is planned, written, reviewed, tested, and shipped across Jira, Bitbucket, and the Atlassian Teamwork Graph. We are looking for a Senior Principal Engineer to provide organization\-wide technical leadership across our Dev AI platforms and agentic developer initiatives. This role will shape the multi\-year architecture and technical evolution of our autonomous developer agents, runtime sandboxes, agent orchestration engines, and context\-retrieval infrastructure. This is a high\-leverage individual\-contributor role. You will establish technical direction, lead complex cross\-organizational initiatives, resolve architectural ambiguity, and raise the engineering quality bar across multiple teams. You will partner with engineering managers, principal engineers, product and program leaders, platform teams, security specialists, and Atlassian product organizations. Success in this role means creating a coherent technical direction across teams, delivering reusable platform capabilities rather than isolated solutions, and turning complex AI capabilities, distributed system requirements, and developer needs into architectures and execution plans that teams can successfully deliver. aligned with Atlassian’s broader AI and platform strategy. * Drive consequential architectural decisions across complex distributed systems, balancing reliability, scalability, security, latency, and inference economics. * Resolve architectural ambiguity across organizational boundaries, establishing clear ownership, system interfaces, and technical contracts. **Agentic Architecture \& SDLC code\-intelligence capabilities—including code synthesis, automated review, and semantic search—grounded in repository context and the Atlassian Teamwork Graph. * Establish shared libraries, frameworks, and paved roads that eliminate duplicate effort and standardize agent patterns across teams. **Trust, Reliability \& Operational Excellence** * Establish production\-readiness bars and engineering standards for availability, customer data isolation, latency, and responsible AI governance. * Shape technical direction for automated agent evaluation, benchmark frameworks, and telemetry jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, ML Evaluation & Introspection Infrastructure
jobs.description: **Who we are** Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self\-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly. The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone. At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn. **What we are looking for** We’re searching for a **Senior Software Engineer, ML Evaluation \& Introspection Infrastructure** to join our Behavior Analysis team, reporting to the team’s engineering manager. Aurora’s trucks already haul freight on Texas highways with no one on board, and every new version of the learned model that drives them has to prove, on real driving data, that it is better and safer than the one before. Behavior Analysis builds the systems that make that call: the evals that compare model versions, the embedding search that makes every driving scenario findable, and the introspection tools that show why a model did what it did. Engineers build more than 100 training and eval datasets a week through our tools. We’re a small team, so each engineer owns whole systems, and we work agent\-first: our tools are built for AI agents to drive as easily as engineers do. You’ll own core pieces of that loop and help lead what comes next: putting LLMs, VLMs and agents to work on analysis, so questions that take days to answer today take minutes. **In this role you will** * Build and scale evaluation pipelines that compare model versions on large driving datasets: offline evals, slice\-based metrics, regression detection, and model\-vs\-model reports. * Own embedding and vector\-search pipelines over driving data, versioned per model, so engineers can search, cluster and compare how any model represents the world. This is where you’d start: owning embedding generation and search end to end. * Build model introspection infrastructure (attention, attribution, ablations) that turns “why did the model do that?” from a research project into a query. * Help define how frontier LLMs, VLMs and agents change ML analysis here: triaging, labeling, clustering and summarizing driving scenarios and eval results. We already have a prototype using LLMs for data curation, and you’d help decide where it goes next. * Work side by side with the ML engineers training these models to decide what to measure, then make those measurements trustworthy, observable and cheap enough to run on every candidate model. * Build the web app and CLI that engineers and AI agents use to find datasets, training runs, evals and their costs, designed with agents as first\-class users. **Required qualifications** * Typically 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend, data or ML infrastructure. * Strong Python, and proficiency with SQL. * Designed and operated large\-scale batch or data pipelines on cloud infrastructure, including backfills, retries and cost management. * Built systems that measure or evaluate something: metrics, experimentation, evaluation or analytics platforms. * Experience with distributed compute and container orchestration (e.g. Kubernetes, AWS Batch or similar). **Desirable qualifications** * ML evaluation infrastructure: eval harnesses, golden datasets, regression detection, A/B model comparison. * Embeddings and vector search, or model introspection and interpretability tooling. * Using LLMs, VLMs or agentic workflows to automate analysis, labeling or data curation. * Autonomous vehicles, robotics or other large\-scale sensor data. * Observability for data systems (metrics, alerting, SLOs), and everyday use of AI coding agents. * Coming from backend or data engineering and want to learn ML evaluation? Apply anyway: we’ll teach you the ML side. *For roles based in Mountain View, CA and Seattle, WA:* The salary range for this position is $162,000 \- $260,000 per year. Aurora’s pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, the successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on factors including job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, relevant education or training, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. The successful candidate will also be eligible for an annual bonus, equity compensation, and benefits. *For roles based in Pittsburgh, PA:* The salary range for this position is $146,000 \- $234,000 per year. Aurora’s pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, the successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on factors including job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, relevant education or training, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. The successful candidate will also be eligible for an annual bonus, equity compensation, and benefits. **Working at Aurora** At Aurora, we bring together extraordinarily talented and experienced people united by the strength of our values. We operate with integrity, set outrageous goals, and build a culture where we win together — all without any jerks. We believe in\-person work increases collaboration, empathy, and our ability to lead effectively. As a result, Aurorans are expected to work from the office at least 3 days per week, with some roles requiring more frequent in\-office presence, up to 5 days per week, based on operational needs. Our Careers page provides insight into what it is like to work at Aurora, and you can find all the latest updates in our Newsroom. **Our commitment to safety** At the core of everything we do is our commitment to safety. Building best\-in\-class self\-driving technology will take time, and we believe that each employee at Aurora has a role in contributing to safety, every step of the way. Aurora expects commitment to our safety policies from every employee, and seeks candidates who take an active responsibility, can contribute to building an atmosphere of trust, and invest in the organization’s long\-term success by prioritizing working safely, no matter what. **Our commitment to inclusion** Aurora considers candidates without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy status, parent or caregiver status, ancestry, political affiliation, veteran and/or military status, physical or mental disability, or any other status protected by federal or state law. Aurora considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at careersiteaccommodations@aurora.tech. *For California applicants, information collected and processed as part of your application and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Aurora’s California Employment Privacy Policy.*

jobs.title: AI Engineer – Agentic Systems & RLAIF
jobs.description: Dallas, TX, United States (On\-site) Contract (1 month 26 days) Published 2 days ago Python Engineering root cause analysis google cloud platform infrastructure automation mlops CI/CD AI Agent Development CI/CD automation * We are building an RLAIF (Reinforcement Learning from AI Feedback) Plane: a governed learning system that turns production evidence from Client's customer\-facing agents into better agent decisions—safely, measurably, and reversibly. Today, small errors compound across interconnected agents, missing capabilities and stale business context silently produce fluent\-but\-wrong answers, and prompt, policy, and model changes lack one governed path to independent proof. * As an AI Engineer you will own the engineering behind that path: detecting capability and context failures before they become customer\-visible, converting root\-cause analysis into one\-factor variants, running them through hard gates and calibrated AI judges, and promoting only what is approved, versioned, monitored, and reversible. **What You Will Do:** * Build the agent runtime\- Design, build, and operate production agents and multi\-agent workflows using LangGraph, LangChain, and deep\-agent patterns—governed, monitored, and versioned from day one. * Instrument for observability\- Implement tracing, telemetry, and failure taxonomies across agents, tools, memory, and knowledge sources so every failure has a reproducible trail back to its root cause. * Engineer the evaluation harness\- Own golden sets, offline and online evals, and AI\-judge pipelines with order\-swap bias control and human calibration loops; report against business outcomes, not just model metrics. * Drive harness optimization\- Use observed failures to improve prompts, tools, skills, and rules through one\-change\-at\-a\-time experiments with regression\-safe release: hard gates, approval, canary, and rollback. * Separate the optimization paths\- Keep harness, contextual\-policy, and model\-level changes distinct and independently evaluated; build the mechanisms that detect capability and knowledge\-coverage gaps and propose governed updates. * Ship on GCP\- Deploy and scale the RLAIF Plane on Google Cloud (Vertex AI, GKE/Cloud Run, BigQuery, Pub/Sub) with CI/CD, IaC, and cost/latency controls. * Collaborate and lead\- Partner with architects, data scientists, SRE, and Client business stakeholders; document decisions, mentor engineers, and raise the bar on agent engineering practice. **Key Responsibilities:** * Ingesting and analyzing traces * Reconstructing the sequence of events, tool calls, and business flow from traces * Creating prompt/context/routing variants * Defining and implementing evaluation dimensions * Building and calibrating AI judges * Designing scoring and reward\-signal frameworks * Generating autonomous optimization recommendations Identifying root causes such as: * Hallucinations * Context drift * Poor prompts * Misrouting * Policy/compliance issue * Safety: Harmlessness, different biases, toxicity * Missing or underperforming tools * Taxonomy/ontology gaps * Re\-configuration opportunities (agent) for identification and recommendation and project outcomes. **What You Bring (Required):** * Demonstrable experience building and running AI agents in production—shipped systems serving real users, with ownership of reliability, latency, cost, and incident response. * Hands\-on experience with AI observability and evals: tracing frameworks (e.g., LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, OpenTelemetry), LLM\-as\-judge design, golden\-set curation, and regression testing. * Deep, practical experience with LangGraph and LangChain, including deep\-agent patterns (planning, sub\-agents, tool use, memory, human\-in\-the\-loop, and state persistence). * Strong Python engineering skills; comfortable with async services, APIs, containers, and testing discipline in a CI/CD environment. * Working understanding of RLAIF/RLHF concepts, prompt and policy optimization, and how to isolate a single causal change in a complex system. * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, including 2\+ years focused on LLM or agentic applications. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Cloud experience on Google Cloud (Vertex AI, GKE, Cloud Run, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, IAM); GCP certification is a plus. * Experience with retrieval, enterprise knowledge bases, and memory systems with provenance, trust scoring, and decay. * Familiarity with governed release practices in regulated or large\-enterprise settings (approval workflows, canary, rollback, audit trails). * Telecom or large\-scale customer\-service domain exposure; experience with MLOps tooling and feature flags. The pay range that the employer in good faith reasonably expects to pay for this position is $39\.30/hour \- $61\.40/hour. Our benefits include medical, dental, vision and retirement benefits. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis. *Tundra Technical Solutions is among North America’s leading providers of Staffing and Consulting Services. Our success and our clients’ success are built on a foundation of service excellence. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable law, including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Our reputation draws patients and families from around the country.* *We offer a wide variety of rewarding career opportunities and are seeking individuals dedicated to helping us achieve our vision of the healthiest kids in the country. If you want to work for an organization that makes a difference for children and families, and encourages you to be at your best every day, please apply today.* ***Please follow this link for a closer look at what it’s like to work at Children’s Wisconsin:*** https://www.instagram.com/lifeatcw/ ***\*\*This is a full time, salaried, hybrid position based out of Milwaukee, Wisconsin.*** **Job Summary** This job will connect Children's Wisconsin's clinical and business priorities to practical technology direction and solution designs. Personally develop enterprise roadmaps and standards, architect complex solutions with particular depth in infrastructure, and establish and lead the architecture practice. The role will improve technology investment decisions, reduce unnecessary complexity and risk, and guide delivery of secure, reliable, and supportable services. The position combines principal architect responsibilities with management of a developing enterprise architecture function. Initially performs the architecture work directly, establishing the methods, relationships, and reusable designs needed to support delivery; continues substantial individual architecture work as the team grows. Scope spans business capabilities, applications, data and integration, infrastructure, and cloud, with domain specialists contributing detailed expertise. Partners with the CISO's organization, which retains security architecture and security policy ownership. **Essential Functions** * Enterprise direction and roadmaps. Translates organizational strategy and clinical and business needs into current state assessments, target architectures, and achievable transition roadmaps. Connects business capabilities to applications, data, platforms, and services. Identifies dependencies, duplication, technical debt, and lifecycle risks and recommends sequenced improvements aligned with available funding and delivery capacity. * Solution architecture. Personally leads architecture for complex initiatives from discovery through implementation. Defines requirements, integration points, system boundaries, and quality expectations for availability, performance, security, recovery, and support. Produces solution diagrams, options analyses, design decisions, and implementation guidance. Resolves cross domain tradeoffs and validates that delivered solutions meet the approved design intent. * Infrastructure and cloud architecture. Provides deep architecture expertise across enterprise networks, compute, virtualization, storage, identity dependencies, resilience, and hybrid cloud. Develops reference architectures and evaluates hosting and modernization options. Works with Cloud Engineering on Azure foundations supporting analytics and later cloud expansion, and with Infrastructure on workload placement and phased data center migration designs. * Architecture governance and standards. Establishes practical architecture principles, standards, review criteria, and decision records. Leads reviews early enough to influence design and purchasing decisions. Documents exceptions, owners, risks, and remediation plans; escalates unresolved decisions through approved governance. Scales review effort to impact and risk and tracks decisions through delivery. * Investment and technology evaluation. Evaluates proposed technologies and vendor solutions for enterprise fit, integration, operating cost, lifecycle, and supportability. Develops recommendations with service owners, the IT Business Office, and procurement. Provides architecture input to investment prioritization and sourcing decisions and identifies opportunities to reuse platforms or retire redundant technology. * Architecture practice development. Builds and maintains a usable architecture repository, including standards, reference designs, roadmaps, and decision records. Establishes a repeatable engagement model with project and service teams. Coordinates application portfolio and dependency information with designated record owners and connects architecture priorities to enterprise planning and delivery. * People and practice leadership. Plans architecture workload and staffing, recruits the additional architect as approved, and establishes goals and development plans. Coaches staff, evaluates performance, and addresses performance needs as the team grows. Mentors technical leads across IS and builds shared architecture skills without creating dependence on a single decision maker. * Delivery partnership. Works directly with engineers, application owners, analytics teams, and vendors to test assumptions, assess feasibility, and resolve design issues. Participates in proofs of concept and reviews technical deliverables. Provides architecture guidance through implementation and operational handoff; engineering teams retain build and operational accountability. Communication and accountability. Explains technology choices, costs, dependencies, and risks to clinical, business, and technology leaders. Facilitates decisions across teams with competing priorities. Reports roadmap progress, material exceptions, and architecture outcomes to the CTO and governance groups and adjusts priorities as organizational needs change. * **Education** * Bachelor's Degree in information technology, computer science, engineering, business, or a related field required or relevant experience * **Experience** * 7\+ years of progressively responsible technology experience, including substantial responsibility for enterprise architecture, solution architecture, and infrastructure design in a complex organization. Demonstrated experience personally producing architecture deliverables and guiding solutions through implementation. required * 7\+ years enterprise architecture. Experience developing current and target state architectures, technology standards, and transition roadmaps tied to business needs. required * 7\+ years solution and infrastructure architecture. Strong infrastructure architecture depth, supported by prior engineering or implementation experience. Experience defining requirements, evaluating options, documenting design tradeoffs, and guiding integrated solutions into operation. required * 5\+ years leadership and execution. Experience leading architecture decisions across teams, facilitating stakeholder agreement, and mentoring technical professionals. required 5\+ years experience establishing an enterprise architecture practice; recruiting or managing architects; or leading architecture in healthcare or another environment requiring continuous service availability. Azure solution architecture, AWS, analytics platform enablement, application rationalization, and data center migration experience are preferred. Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks and modeling methods, and relevant enterprise or cloud architecture certifications, are preferred * **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** * Demonstrated ability to connect business capabilities, applications, data, integration and infrastructure; evaluate portfolio and lifecycle implications; and apply architecture governance to real investment and deliver decisions. * Proven ability to work independently as the initial architect, prioritize competing demands, establish practical methods and communicate recommendations to executive and technical audiences. * Ability to assume formal people management responsibilities as staffing grows. * Demonstrated ability to design across network, compute, storage, identity, resilience and cloud dependencies using domain specialists where needed. Children's Wisconsin is an equal opportunity / affirmative action employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment for all employees. We treat everyone with dignity, respect, and fairness. We do not discriminate against any person on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status or condition protected by the law. **Certifications/Licenses:**

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineering Technical Leader
jobs.description: **The application window is expected to close on:** 12/10/2026 Meet the Team Cisco’s Canvas AI team consists of AI researchers and software developers who collaborate to build innovative products and platforms for Cisco. We are motivated by tackling unique challenges that arise when connecting people and devices at a world\-wide scale. Canvas is an agentic workspace where our customers’ IT teams and our AI agents investigate and resolve issues across every domain. It was built for teams that need to move from alert to evidence, from evidence to decision, and from decision to resolution faster. Your Impact As a MLE Tech Lead you will set the multi\-quarter strategy for how Cisco measures agentic AI quality, owning evaluation from architecture through production operation. You will build layered, trustworthy evaluation systems (automated checks, calibrated LLM judges, and expert human review), extend them to live production traffic and simulation, and close the loop so failures turn into validated fixes. You will also drive shared measurement standards across partner teams and mentor engineers while representing the domain to senior leadership. Key responsibilities * Own the evaluation roadmap and strategy for agentic AI quality, from architecture to production. * Design a layered evaluation architecture: deterministic checks on every PR, model\-based evaluation pre\-release, and human expert calibration. * Build and calibrate multi\-model LLM\-as\-judge panels, tracking true\-positive and true\-negative rates separately. * Run the human\-in\-the\-loop flywheel with SMEs, turning annotations into training signal for automated judges. * Score production traffic online, alert on regressions and drift, and convert real traces into offline test cases. * Lead simulation, synthetic data, and adversarial testing without consuming lab resources. * Close the loop from evaluation failure to clustered issue, candidate fix, and shadow/A/B validation. * Ensure trustworthy results through experiment snapshots, dataset versioning, coverage reporting, and cost tracking. * Drive common standards, data contracts, and judge criteria across partner teams without direct authority. * Mentor engineers, set evaluation engineering standards, and represent the domain to senior leadership. Minimum Qualifications * BA/BS with 8\+ years of relevant experience, MS with 6\+ years, or PhD with 3\+ years in Computer Science, Machine Learning or a related quantitative field. * Experience taking machine learning or LLM\-based systems into production and owning them operationally, not only building prototypes. * Experience in Python and modern deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. * Experience designing evaluation, measurement or quality systems for ML or LLM products — datasets, metrics, judges, benchmarks or regression suites. * Experience setting technical direction across multiple teams through influence rather than reporting lines. Preferred Qualifications * LLM\-as\-judge design and calibration: practical experience building judge systems and validating them against human experts, including inter\-annotator agreement and judge drift. * Agentic system evaluation: measuring multi\-step reasoning, tool selection, trajectory quality and root\-cause correctness rather than single\-turn output quality. * Production monitoring at scale: asynchronous scoring of live traffic, drift detection, and alerting that engineering teams actually act on. * Simulation and synthetic environments: building reproducible test environments or synthetic data generation for domains where ground truth is scarce. * Evaluation in CI/CD: integrating automated evaluation into build pipelines and using it to gate releases. * Networking, observability or infrastructure domain knowledge: familiarity with the telemetry, topology and failure modes of enterprise network and observability systems. * Cost\-aware inference: routing, model selection and optimisation techniques that keep evaluation economically viable at production volume. * Technical community contribution: publications at top ML venues, open\-source contributions, or public technical writing in the evaluation space. Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. jobs.title: Embedded Systems Engineer, Robotics
jobs.description: **ABOUT DEXMATE** Dexmate is building the foundation for physical AI — combining a new generation of robots with a universal Physical AI OS, making robots as easy to build and deploy as software. Today, robotics is fragmented, slow, and closed: most builders are forced to reinvent the same stack again and again, and most ideas never make it past the prototype stage. We exist to change that. Our mission is to democratize robotics by lowering the barrier to entry, delivering a plug\-and\-play platform for developers, researchers, and enterprises, and cultivating an open ecosystem that accelerates the evolution of physical AI. If you want to help shape the next layer of human capability — and believe the future of robotics should be built together, not in isolation — we'd love to build it with you. **THE ROLE** We're looking for an Embedded Systems Engineer to own the boundary where our robot's electronics meet its software. You will bring up and debug new PCBs, write the firmware and drivers that make every sensor, camera, actuator, and compute module talk to each other, and make sure data moves reliably across CAN/CAN FD, EtherCAT, GMSL, I2C, SPI, and Ethernet. This is a hands\-on, cross\-layer role. One day you're probing a board with a scope to find why a bus is dropping frames; the next you're writing a Linux driver for a camera serializer or tuning an EtherCAT network for deterministic timing. You'll work closely with electrical, firmware, controls, and robotics software engineers, and you'll often be the person who figures out whether a problem lives in hardware, firmware, or software. **RESPONSIBILITIES** * Bringing up, validating, and debugging new PCBs: reading schematics and layouts, measuring signals, and isolating hardware vs. software faults * Developing firmware for MCUs (bare\-metal and RTOS) and drivers for embedded Linux platforms (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson / Orin) * Writing and maintaining device drivers and communication stacks for CAN/CAN FD, EtherCAT, I2C, SPI, UART, and Ethernet * Integrating camera and sensor pipelines over GMSL (serializer/deserializer configuration, device trees, V4L2 drivers, timing and synchronization) * Bringing up and tuning EtherCAT and CAN networks across actuators, sensors, and power systems for deterministic, real\-time performance * Debugging signal\-integrity, power, timing, and bus\-level issues with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and protocol analyzers * Contributing firmware and software input during schematic and PCB design reviews to make boards easier to bring up, test, and debug * Building diagnostics, test fixtures, and automated hardware\-in\-the\-loop tests for boards and subsystems * Supporting manufacturing, end\-of\-line testing, and field troubleshooting as robots move from prototype to deployment * Documenting interfaces, bring\-up procedures, and debugging playbooks for the wider team **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** * 3\+ years of professional experience in embedded systems in robotics, automotive, industrial automation, or complex consumer electronics * Strong C and C\+\+ skills for firmware and driver development; working knowledge of Python for tooling and test automation * Hands\-on board bring\-up experience, including reading schematics, PCB layouts, datasheets, and timing diagrams * Driver\-level experience with several of: CAN/CAN FD, EtherCAT, I2C, SPI, UART, Ethernet * Experience with MCU firmware (ARM Cortex\-M, STM32, TI C2000, or similar) on bare\-metal or RTOS platforms * Comfort with embedded debugging and lab tools: JTAG/SWD debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and protocol analyzers * Systematic debugging skills across the hardware, firmware, and software boundary * Strong communication skills and comfort working directly with electrical, mechanical, controls, and software engineers **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Experience with GMSL or other high\-speed camera links (e.g., MAX9295/MAX9296, FPD\-Link), MIPI CSI\-2, and V4L2 * Embedded Linux kernel and device\-driver development, device trees, and BSP bring\-up (NVIDIA Jetson / Orin a plus) * Experience integrating EtherCAT master or slave stacks (SOEM, IgH, or equivalent) * Familiarity with PCB design tools (Altium, KiCad) and the ability to propose schematic\-level fixes * Knowledge of signal integrity, power integrity, and EMC fundamentals * Experience with motor\-control, BMS, or power\-electronics systems * Experience with ROS 2 or other robotics middleware * Prior experience working in a vertically integrated robotics or hardware startup * Hands\-on use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex to accelerate implementation, debugging, testing, and documentation Compensation Range: $100K \- $300K

Do you want to engineer the platforms that take agentic AI from prototype to production? The Lilly Employer Organization is a critical priority for Lilly USA. It treats employers as first\-class customers alongside payers and providers, and it scales Lilly's direct\-to\-employer (DTE) access models, benefit design innovation, and employer engagement, particularly for obesity and cardiometabolic medicines. The Lilly USA Tech@Lilly Market Access team is seeking a Principal AI/ML Engineer to build the agentic AI and machine learning platforms that power this work. You will turn prototypes into reliable, scalable, well\-governed production systems. You will also build the employer data pipelines, partner integrations, and ML engineering foundations that the team reuses across employer use cases. **What You'll Be Doing:** As a Principal AI/ML Engineer, you will design and build the engineering backbone for the AI and ML systems that serve the Lilly Employer Organization: the orchestration frameworks, end\-to\-end data and model pipelines, serving infrastructure, and the evaluation and monitoring that keep them reliable in production. You will work at the intersection of employer data, benefit administration, field operations, and third\-party partner integrations. You will partner closely with data scientists to productionize models and agentic workflows. You will also work with the Employer Technical Product Manager, employer field teams, and Tech@Lilly colleagues to bring those solutions into real applications in a secure and auditable way. You will reuse infrastructure and patterns so that each new employer workflow is faster and cheaper to ship. **How You'll Succeed:** * Build and operationalize agentic AI platforms, including agent\-to\-agent orchestration frameworks, multi\-agent workflow engines, tool and API integration layers, and secure connectivity between agents, enterprise systems, and external partner platforms. * Build and integrate employer data pipelines, bringing data from employers, benefit administrators, and third\-party partners into secure, analytics\-ready platforms. * Deliver AI capabilities for employer use cases, such as employer reporting, predictive analytics, benefit optimization, and decision support for employer field teams. * Engineer robust, end\-to\-end AI/ML pipelines, covering data capture, feature engineering, training, fine\-tuning, inference, and feedback, at production scale and reliability. * Stand up ML engineering foundations, including model and prompt versioning, registries, experiment tracking, continuous integration and delivery for models, and automated evaluation and rollback within each pipeline. * Apply production\-grade deployment techniques, including scalable model serving, containerization, inference optimization, and deployment of small and specialized models hosted in\-house, with attention to latency, cost, scalability, and data residency. * Build observability and monitoring for AI systems, including tracing of agentic workflows, cost and latency tracking, drift detection, and integration of AI evaluation into production monitoring. * Implement governance and data\-protection controls, including HIPAA compliance, PHI and PII handling, de\-identification, and auditability consistent with a regulated environment. * Design reusable, horizontal engineering capabilities and shared infrastructure that multiple teams and use cases can build on, rather than one\-off deployments. * Partner with data scientists to productionize prototypes and harden them for scale, reliability, and maintainability. * Communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders and stay current with emerging agentic and ML engineering tooling. * Manage and prioritize multiple projects simultaneously. **What You Should Bring:** * Foundational knowledge in communication, leadership, teamwork, problem solving, solution and blueprint definition, business acumen, architectural processes (e.g., blueprinting, reference architecture, governance), technical standards, project delivery, and the industry. **Business Analysis and Technical Leadership, including:** * Engaging with the business and proactively seeking opportunities to deliver business value. * Understanding business requirements and effectively translating business needs and processes in BMs, and access models. Experience in healthcare or pharma is a plus. * Demonstrated ability to deliver reliable systems in complex data domains and to communicate with a geographically dispersed group of business and technical colleagues. **About the Organization:** Lilly IT builds and maintains capabilities with cutting\-edge technologies, as the most prominent tech companies do. Lilly IT is different because we use technology to advance our purpose: creating medicines that make life better for people around the world. Examples include data\-driven drug discovery, connected clinical trials, and AI that helps patients access and afford their medicines. We hire the best technology professionals from a variety of backgrounds so they can bring an assortment of knowledge, skills, and diverse thinking to deliver innovative solutions in every area of our business. The Lilly USA Tech@Lilly team is at the forefront of leveraging data and technology to launch new medicines to market, raise awareness, and help appropriate patients get access to medication. We partner closely with Lilly's market access organization, which works with payers, employers, and government customers to improve affordability and broaden access. With a deep technical and business understanding, working across all therapeutic areas and disease states, we design and implement digital solutions to power our business. We use real\-world evidence and health outcomes data to reduce friction across the patient journey, create best\-in\-class customer engagements, improve patient outcomes, and deliver business results. **Additional Information:** * Travel: 0–10% Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response. Our employee resource groups (ERGs) offer strong support networks for their members and are open to all employees.
