jobs.description: Remote \- United States Engineering Remote Full\-time **Company Overview** Farmers Business Network, Inc. (FBN®) is a pioneering digital marketplace and farmer\-to\-farmer network dedicated to empowering family farmers globally while promoting sustainable agriculture. With over 117,000 members, FBN's Farmers First® promise unites growers and ranchers in their quest to maximize profitability and increase food production. FBN leverages data, AI and direct\-to\-farm delivery to simplify the agricultural supply chain, boosting convenience and transparency, reducing farm input costs, enhancing access to financing and services, and providing personalized farm insights. Its Gradable® joint\-venture helps thousands of farmers adopt and earn rewards for regenerative practices while simplifying the access of regenerative products for the world’s leading food companies and grain buyers. **Position Summary** Own the agents that talk to FBN's customers. You design, build, evaluate and run the member\-facing agents for customer support, lending and sales. The goal: farmers get fast, correct answers and orders at any hour, and our teams spend their time on the work that needs a person. **Responsibilities** * **Customer support agent (about 40%).** Take our CX agent from a staff copilot to a member\-facing agent that answers order status, invoice, return and product questions, and covers off\-hours. Decide with the CX lead which replies the agent can send by itself, and build the hand\-off to a person for the rest. * **Lending agents (about 25%).** Automate loan operations: read, sort and file loan documents, spread borrower financial statements, follow up on conditions to close, and contact new land\-loan leads within minutes. Work inside our loan origination system (nCino on Salesforce) and its controls. * **Sales and order agents (about 20%).** Build agents that take routine and repeat orders, follow up on stalled carts and quotes, return missed sales calls and send SMS outreach that hands warm leads to a sales rep. * **Evals, safety and operations (about 15%).** Build eval suites from real cases (135K support cases and 1\.1M calls already mined). Measure accuracy, safety, latency and business outcomes. Set guardrails, monitoring and incident response for agents that act for FBN in front of customers. * Owns the customer\-facing agent portfolio end to end: design, build, evals, launch and run. * Decisions owned: agent architecture, tool and data access, eval criteria and launch readiness. Business owners approve what the agent may say and do. * Impact: company\-wide. These agents are a main part of the FY27 AI plan for Direct, CX and Lending. * Sets the standard practice for how FBN builds and evaluates customer\-facing agents. Mentors other engineers and the business champions. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field and 8\+ years of software engineering experience, or 12\+ years of related experience. (FBN S5 standard.) * Shipped LLM\-based agents or assistants to real users in production, with tool use, retrieval and multi\-step workflows. * Built eval suites and used them to decide launches: offline test sets from real data, online monitoring, and regression checks. * Strong backend engineering in Python or TypeScript: APIs, queues, data pipelines, cloud (AWS). * Integrated with business systems such as a CRM, ERP, telephony or messaging platform, with care for auth, permissions and audit trails. * Clear judgment on safety: when an agent should act, when it should draft, and when it must hand off to a person. * Works directly with non\-technical business owners. Turns an unclear customer problem into a scoped agent with success criteria. **Preferred Qualifications** * Customer support automation, contact center or conversational AI experience. * Lending, fintech or regulated workflows (document processing, KYC, credit policy). * Salesforce, nCino, NetSuite or Dialpad APIs. SQL on a data warehouse (Redshift). * Agriculture, marketplace or e\-commerce background. The following represents FBN's reasonable estimate of the US national average base salary range for this role based on market data and placement of internal employees: $220,000\-$245,000\. jobs.title: Devops Architect
jobs.description: **Who are we?** =============== At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries. We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Platform Engineer (Level 4\) with 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, and cloud\-native platform delivery to join Finastra's Platform \& Infrastructure team. This role is the primary implementation and operational owner of the platform capabilities being designed by the Platform DevOps Architect—building and maintaining the self\-service IaC provisioning system, GitOps deployment platform, CI/CD pipeline framework, observability stack, and container governance tooling that underpin Finastra's SaaS transformation. The ideal candidate combines deep infrastructure engineering skills with SRE operational discipline: they are as comfortable writing Terraform modules and Kubernetes operators as they are triaging production incidents, authoring post\-mortems, and driving reliability improvements. They work autonomously on complex engineering problems, partner closely with the TP5 architect on design validation, and mentor junior platform engineers in cloud\-native best practices. **Responsibilities \& Deliverables:** ------------------------------------- **Platform Implementation \& IaC Delivery** * Build, test, and maintain reusable Terraform modules and Crossplane compositions for compute, networking, storage, identity, and secrets management across Azure, AWS, and GCP * Implement and iterate the self\-service environment provisioning platform—validating IaC modules against policy\-as\-code guardrails (OPA, Sentinel) and ensuring security compliance at provisioning time * Author and maintain environment lifecycle automation: cost\-tagged resource creation, scheduled teardown workflows, configuration drift detection, and reconciliation processes * Write infrastructure tests using Terratest or equivalent frameworks, maintaining a high\-quality test coverage bar for all IaC modules * Manage Terraform state backends, workspace strategies, and remote execution configuration in production environments **GitOps \& Deployment Platform Operations** * Build and maintain ArgoCD application sets, app\-of\-apps patterns, and multi\-cluster synchronization configurations * Author and version Helm charts for platform services and development team workloads, enforcing Kubernetes deployment standards (resource requests/limits, security contexts, health probes, PDBs) * Implement and maintain deployment promotion workflows across dev, staging, and production environments, including automated rollback triggers and canary analysis integrations * Operate and evolve the internal developer portal (Backstage or equivalent), maintaining integrations with CI/CD systems, secret stores, and environment registries * Debug and resolve deployment failures across the GitOps platform, providing first\-line support to development squads experiencing deployment issues **CI/CD Pipeline Engineering** * Design, build, and maintain shared CI/CD pipeline templates (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or equivalent) that standardize build, test, scan, and publish workflows across Lending product teams * Integrate security tooling into pipelines as enforcement gates: container image scanning (Trivy, Snyk), SAST/DAST tooling, dependency vulnerability detection, and IaC static analysis (Checkov, tfsec) * Implement artifact management and promotion workflows: OCI image tagging conventions, Helm chart versioning, and artifact signing via Sigstore/Cosign * Monitor pipeline health, failure rates, and build performance metrics; drive continuous improvement in pipeline reliability and developer feedback latency * Partner with development squads to onboard them to shared pipeline templates, resolving integration issues and iterating templates based on team feedback **Observability \& SRE Practice** * Instrument platform components and shared services with OpenTelemetry\-based distributed tracing, structured logging, and Prometheus metrics * Build and maintain operational dashboards (Grafana or equivalent) covering platform health, deployment frequency, error rates, and infrastructure utilization * Define and implement SLO alerting using error budget burn\-rate policies; participate in alert threshold tuning and on\-call rotation * Lead incident response for platform\-layer issues: triage, mitigation, stakeholder communication, and post\-incident review facilitation * Execute chaos experiments (LitmusChaos or equivalent) to proactively validate platform resilience and identify reliability gaps before they reach production **Kubernetes \& Container Platform Operations** * Manage Kubernetes cluster operat ing, mitigating, and running post\-incident reviews * Familiarity with distributed tracing tools (Jaeger, Tempo, or equivalent) and log aggregation platforms (Loki, ELK, or Splunk) **Security \& Compliance** * Practical experience with **\*\*OPA/Gatekeeper\*\*** admission control policy authoring and enforcement in Kubernetes * Experience with container image security: scanning, signing (Sigstore/Cosign), and provenance verification * Understanding of Kubernetes RBAC, network policies, and secrets management (HashiCorp Vault or cloud\-native secret stores) * Familiarity with security compliance standards relevant to financial services (SOC 2, ISO 27001, DORA) **Engineering Practices** * Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language: **\*\*Python, Go, or Bash\*\*** — for automation, tooling, and Kubernetes operator or controller development * Experience with version control workflows (Git), code review practices, and infrastructure\-as\-code testing standards * Strong written communication skills: runbooks, ADRs, post\-mortems, and technical documentation **Required Skills \& Experience** --------------------------------- * Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS) * HashiCorp Certified Terraform Associate or Professional * Cloud platform certifications: AZ\-104/AZ\-305 (Azure), AWS DevOps Engineer Professional, or GCP Professional DevOps Engineer * Experience with **\*\*service mesh\*\*** technologies (Istio, Linkerd) for east\-west traffic security and observability * Hands\-on experience with **\*\*chaos engineering\*\*** tooling (LitmusChaos, Chaos Monkey) and resilience validation programs * Experience in **\*\*financial services or regulated SaaS environments\*\*** with familiarity in compliance\-as\-code approaches * Contributions to open\-source platform or infrastructure tooling projects We are proud to offer a range of incentives to our employees worldwide. These benefits are available to everyone, regardless of grade, and reflect the values we stand for: **Flexibility:** Enjoy unlimited vacation, subject to local regulations and business priorities. Benefit from hybrid working arrangements and inclusive policies such as paid time off for voting, bereavement, and sick leave. **Well‑being:** Access confidential one‑to‑one support through our Employee Assistance Program, connect with our network of Wellbeing Champions and Gather Groups, and take part in monthly events and initiatives designed to help you thrive—inside and outside of work. **Health \& Financial Security:** Medical, life and disability insurance, retirement plans, lifestyle, and other benefits.\* **Sustainability:** Paid time off for volunteering and donation‑matching opportunities to support causes that matter to you. **Inclusion:** Get involved in our inclusion communities, such as Count Me In, Culture@Finastra, Proud@Finastra, Disabilities@Finastra, and Women@Finastra—open to everyone who wants to participate and contribute. **Career Development:** Access online learning and accredited courses through our Skills \& Career Navigator tool. **Recognition:** Take part in our global recognition program, Finastra Celebrates, and share your voice through regular employee surveys that help shape our culture and ways of working. * Specific benefits may vary by location. At Finastra, each individual is unique—bringing their own ideas, perspectives, cultural backgrounds, and experiences. We learn from one another, value what makes us different, and create an environment where everyone feels included, supported, and able to be their authentic selves. Be unique. Be exceptional. Help us make a difference at Finastra. Applicants for this position need to be located in posted location or their immediate surrounding areas. Due to the requirements of this position, this job posting is not available for, and Finastra will not be considering any applicants who currently reside in New York City or California.

jobs.title: Staff AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost\-effective, multi\-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form! In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by *TIME* as a “Best Invention”, *MIT Technology Review* as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and *Fast Company* as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron\-air batteries is underway at our first high\-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia. Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now \- right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing \- might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better. **Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading \- you’ve come to the right place.** **Role Description** -------------------- Form Energy is hiring a Staff AI Platform Engineer to build the shared platform that lets people across the company build and run AI\-powered tools safely and quickly. As a hands\-on senior individual contributor, you will help design the application runtime, knowledge systems, agent infrastructure, and governance tooling that teams would otherwise build separately, and you will help set the patterns other engineers follow. Your work spans product R\&D, design, manufacturing process engineering, product costing, and root cause analysis. It draws on data from our battery test stands, factory manufacturing robots, and deployed projects in the field, along with the documents, slide decks, transcripts, and conversations our teams produce every day. You will sit on the AI \& Data Platform team, working with data engineers, software engineers, Information Security, and the scientists, engineers, and operators who use what you build. This is an exciting opportunity to shape how a fast\-moving company with breakthrough technology and an incredible mission puts AI to work. *This is a hybrid role, which will require working onsite from our office in Berkeley, CA, Somerville, MA or Weirton, WV 3\+ days per week.* *Relocation assistance is available.* ### **What you'll do:** * Build and operate the internal application platform that lets employees create and deploy AI\-generated applications on curated backend and frontend frameworks, with starter templates, design guidance, authentication, and secure deployment built in, so app authors own only business logic, user flows, and UI. * Give those applications governed access to data, including connectivity to our data warehouse and a shared Postgres cluster for application state that is automatically integrated into our data platform. * Build and operate a central knowledge platform over unstructured content (documents, slide decks, meeting transcripts, Slack) and structured data from battery test stands, manufacturing robots, and deployed systems, pairing document retrieval with query access to structured data through semantic models and text\-to\-SQL. Own its retrieval quality through semantic and hybrid search, re\-ranking, chunking, and classification, with source\-level permissions and evaluation sets that show whether a change helps. * Design and deploy the shared MCP infrastructure, including a gateway layer (such as agentgateway) for authentication, authorization, rate limiting, and audit logging, and build MCP servers for applications and services across the software org and for selected external tools. * Own model selection and cost: evaluate open\-source and open\-weight models against frontier models on our own tasks, decide where each fits, and reduce token usage through context management, caching, and model routing. * Build the agent orchestration layer, including multi\-agent workflows and long\-running loops with checkpoints, human review gates, and automated evaluation. Work with data engineers to decide when work should run as a deterministic, scheduled workflow and when it needs a graph or state machine in which an agent chooses among bounded steps. * Partner with product R\&D, battery design, manufacturing process engineering, product costing, and root cause analysis teams to find repeatable work and automate it, including nd up the AWS infrastructure and infrastructure\-as\-code (Pulumi and/or Terraform) it runs on. * Help stand up a company\-wide skills and plugin marketplace that vets contributions against AI policy and scans them for security vulnerabilities with open\-source and commercial tools. Advise on AI governance, recommending changes that make the policy specific to platform needs and automating its execution, such as approvals for new tools. * Raise the engineering bar through design docs and RFCs, code review, mentorship, and technical influence that reaches beyond the immediate team. ### **What you'll bring:** * *Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, computer engineering, or a related field plus 7\+ years of software or data engineering experience, including building and operating production platforms or services that other engineers depend on.* * *Strong production programming in Python and Go, with experience building APIs and backend services.* * *Hands\-on experience building LLM\-powered systems in production, including retrieval\-augmented generation, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, re\-ranking, and structured\-data access through text\-to\-SQL or semantic layers.* * *Experience with agent frameworks, tool calling, and the Model Context Protocol, and with workflow orchestration or state\-machine frameworks such as LangGraph, Temporal, or Dagster.* * *Experience building evaluation sets and harnesses for LLM systems and measuring quality, latency, and cost across model providers, including open\-weight models.* * *Experience with PostgreSQL and a cloud data warehouse, plus AWS, containers, CI/CD, and infrastructure\-as\-code with Pulumi and/or Terraform.* * *Working knowledge of platform and AI security: authentication and authorization (OAuth/OIDC), secrets management, sandboxed execution, tenant isolation, supply\-chain scanning, and risks specific to LLM tools such as prompt injection and data exfiltration.* * *A track record of building internal platforms that other teams adopt, and of independently leading the design of novel solutions through technical design docs and RFCs.* * *Excellent communication and organizational skills, including with scientists, engineers, and operators who aren't software developers, and comfort participating in an on\-call rotation.* * ***Nice to have:*** *React and design\-system experience; Snowflake or Databricks; serving open\-weight models (for example with vLLM); API or AI gateway experience; AI governance or compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001\); background in battery, energy, manufacturing, or other physical\-systems data.* *\#LI\-Hybrid* *Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. jobs.title: AI Automation Engineer
jobs.description: ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a highly motivated AI Automation Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will be the primary engineer building and maintaining our technical interview pipeline \- from the question bank to AI\-assisted scoring to full workflow automation \- working alongside the team to grow this role into a broader automation function over time. This isn't a "call an API and ship it" job: you'll be designing the systems that add/calibrate interview questions and evaluate candidate answers, which means understanding how to prompt and structure AI models for consistency, how to measure and validate output quality against ground truth, and how to catch and correct the ways these systems get things wrong. This is a role we expect to grow \- the shape of that growth is still being defined. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** Assessment Repository Management \- Add, revise, and retire technical interview questions across roles/levels/skill areas \- Maintain question metadata (difficulty, topic tags, expected answer criteria, role relevance) \- Create variant/randomized versions of questions to reduce answer\-sharing risk \- Build validation checks (automated and manual) to catch incorrect, ambiguous, or miscalibrated questions before they enter the repository \- Build automation to update problem sets and recalculate average difficulty ratings as new results come in \- Review and update questions periodically to prevent leakage/staleness and keep content aligned with actual job requirements **Scoring \& Answer Evaluation** \- Architect scoring workflows that evaluate and compare candidate answers against reference answers/rubrics, grounded in a clear methodology for what "correct" and "well\-scored" mean \- Calibrate and benchmark scoring prompts/models against human\-graded samples, measuring accuracy and identifying systematic errors or bias \- Understand and account for model failure modes (inconsistency, hallucination, prompt sensitivity) and design safeguards around them \- Flag edge cases or low\-confidence scores for human review rather than fully automating high\-stakes decisions **Process Automation** \- Automate the end\-to\-end workflow: question selection \-\> test delivery \-\> answer collection \-\> scoring \-\> reporting \- Help transition our source code and repositories to an internal Git platform \- Track test results to help establish scoring benchmarks over time **Quality \& Fairness** \- Track scoring consistency and accuracy over time; report on pipeline health \- Watch for and mitigate AI evaluation bias across candidate demographics or answer styles \- Document the process, prompts, and scoring logic for auditability **Growth \& Scope** \- Apply the same automation and AI\-integration skills developed here to other internal workflows as the role expands \- Partner with engineering teams to identify manual, repetitive processes that are good candidates for automation \- Take on additional internal tooling and infrastructure projects as capacity and scope grow **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** \- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience \- Solid programming fundamentals (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar) \- Comfort working with APIs, including LLM/AI APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) \- Demonstrated experience designing and evaluating prompts/pipelines for LLM\-based tools (not just using AI products, but building with them) \- Proficient with Git and a hosted platform (GitHub or GitLab) \- branching, PRs/MRs, code review, CI basics \- Basic understanding of databases (SQL or similar) \- Strong attention to detail and technical writing ability \- Ability to work independently on processes that are still being defined, and adapt as scope evolves **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** \- Familiarity with test/assessment platforms or ATS integrations \- Exposure to scripting automation (e.g., workflow tools, cron jobs, CI\-style pipelines) \- Interest or coursework in fairness/bias in ML systems \- Prior experience conducting or coordinating technical interviews (not required, but a plus) Fortinet offers employees a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k), 11 paid holidays, vacation time, and sick time as well as a comprehensive leave program. Wage ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, and job level. Earnings for this position are expected to be $110,000 \- $170,000Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate's subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, experience, and geographic location. All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program, Bonus eligibility is reviewed at time of hire and annually at the Company’s discretion

jobs.title: Associate AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Fuel Cycle**: Fuel Cycle empowers leading organizations with agile research solutions that deliver decision\-ready insights — fast, flexible, and fully integrated. As a market research disruptor, our AI\-powered Insights Platform is built for speed, precision, and scale. With cutting\-edge tools and seamless audience connectivity, we help brands ditch the guesswork and make smarter, customer\-led decisions at lightning speed. **Why work at Fuel Cycle?** Join a high\-growth team where curiosity is valued, ownership is encouraged, and your work drives real\-world impact. Whether you’re based at our Los Angeles HQ, New York City hub, working remotely across the U.S., or part of our global team in India, you’ll help shape the future of decision intelligence for some of the world’s most iconic brands. **Overview:** Build real AI agents on a production platform, with senior engineers working alongside you. You will work in Python and FastAPI, build tool\-calling agents on AWS Bedrock and AgentCore using the Strands Agents framework, and own technical decisions within the problems you take on, with your scope growing as you do. This role is fully in\-office in Los Angeles because our mentorship model depends on it: pair programming, in\-person code review, and a mentor a few desks away. We hire for fundamentals, curiosity, and initiative. This is an early\-career role. Engineers new to the field are welcome, and so are engineers with a year or two of experience who want to go deeper into AI and agentic systems. You do not need to know our stack on day one. **What You’ll Work On:** * Design, build, and improve AI agents, deciding how tool\-calling loops, model configuration, and multi\-step workflows are structured using Strands Agents and AWS Bedrock * Build and integrate MCP tools and servers, and learn how tool names and descriptions shape what an LLM does * Deploy and run agents on Bedrock AgentCore, working with the platform team and your mentor * Build RAG pipelines over pgvector or FAISS, choosing chunking, embedding, and retrieval approaches based on what the results show * Design, test, and iterate on prompts; evaluate answer quality, latency, and token cost, and decide which tradeoffs to make; learn how guardrails are applied in production paths * Evaluate models, tools, and approaches, and recommend which to use, with your reasoning documented * Ship features and bug fixes in FastAPI services (REST and WebSocket APIs backed by PostgreSQL and Redis), deciding how to design, implement, and test them * Contribute to background jobs and queue consumers so agent work runs outside the API request path * Apply our architectural standards, use your judgment on design choices within them, help keep design documents current, and flag where the standards should change * Submit pull requests, respond to review feedback, and review teammates’ code as you grow **What You Bring:** * Solid Python from coursework, internships, or work: functions, classes, type hints, error handling, testing basics * Data structures and algorithms, with awareness of time and space complexity * SQL fundamentals (joins, aggregations, indexes, schema design); PostgreSQL exposure preferred * REST and HTTP concepts, and how a web API is structured * Git and pull\-request workflow * Clear communication, comfort asking questions, and a habit of picking up new tools and asking for help when you’re stuck **Preferred:** * An agent project built with Strands Agents, LangChain, the OpenAI SDK, or a similar framework (coursework, personal, or professional), including how an LLM chooses and calls tools * Model Context Protocol (MCP): building or using MCP tools and servers * AWS Bedrock or Bedrock AgentCore, or AWS basics such as S3 and SQS * RAG: chunking, embeddings, and vector stores * Prompt engineering: writing, testing, and iterating on prompts * FastAPI or a similar framework such as Flask or Django, SQLAlchemy or another ORM, and a willingness to learn async Python **Experience:** * Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (bootcamp, self\-taught, or on\-the\-job) * Roughly 0–2 years of software engineering experience; internships, research, and substantial projects count * A track record of learning quickly, shown through coursework, projects, work, open\-source contributions, or community involvement **Benefits \& Perks:** Fuel Cycle is committed to supporting the well\-being, flexibility, and growth of our team. We offer a competitive and inclusive benefits package that includes: * **Comprehensive Health Coverage**: Medical, dental, and vision insurance plans * **401(k) with Company Match**: Plan for your future with our retirement savings program * **Equity Purchase Option**: Participate in Fuel Cycle’s long\-term success * **Flexible Work Schedule**: Empowering you to balance life and work * **Generous Time Off**: + 15 vacation days and 7 sick days per year + 12 company holidays + 4 floating holidays/recharge days to rest or celebrate what matters to you * **Paid Parental Leave**: Time to bond with your growing family * **Monthly Internet \& Phone Stipend**: Support for remote work setup * **Wellness \& Lifestyle Perks**: Access to tools like **Rightway (healthcare navigation), Headspace (mental wellness), Peloton (fitness)**, and more * **Team Connection Perks**: + **Weekly community lunches**, refreshments, and snacks at our LA \& NY headquarters **Compensation Overview:** The expected starting salary range for this position is **$90,000 \- $110,000\.** This range represents the typical starting compensation offered to candidates hired into this role. Final base salary will be determined based on a variety of factors, including location, work experience, skills, knowledge, education, and certifications. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for variable bonus, and may include an equity grant or purchase option. These components make up your total compensation package, which will be reviewed in greater detail during your initial recruiter conversation. **Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Equal Opportunity:** At Fuel Cycle, we embrace the values of diversity, equity, and inclusion and are committed to fostering an inclusive company culture. We believe that everyone, regardless of their background or identity, should have equal access to opportunities for growth and advancement. Our selection processes and career pathways are designed to be fair, transparent, and free from bias. We value the unique perspectives and contributions of each team member, knowing that this diverse range of experiences strengthens our team. Fuel Cycle stands firmly against discrimination based on disability, sex, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, veteran status, or any other protected status under the law. Fuel Cycle is an equal opportunity employer and fully comply with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). We will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified applicants and employees with disabilities, as needed, to enable them to perform the essential functions of their job and participate in the application and interview process. If you require accommodations during any part of the application process, please contact us at hr@fuelcycle.com to discuss your needs. Compensation Range: $90K \- $110K

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: GameStop is looking for an **Applied AI Engineer** who combines hands\-on AI capability with strong business judgment. We want a highly motivated individual with tremendous work ethic who can identify a major business problem, understand its economics, build a solution using AI, and demonstrate measurable results. We're interested in what you've actually built, who's using it, and the impact it's delivered. You'll work directly with **Ryan Cohen and the GameStop team** to improve how the business operates. **What You'll Do** * Identify opportunities to increase revenue, reduce costs, improve inventory decisions, save time, and better serve customers. * Prioritize problems based on business impact and the effort required to solve them. * Build and deploy AI agents, applications, and automated workflows. * Connect AI to business systems, databases, documents, and operational processes. * Work directly with the people using your solutions and continuously improve them based on real\-world results. * Measure accuracy, reliability, operating costs, adoption, and financial impact. **What We're Looking For** **Strong Business Judgment** * Understand how companies make money, where resources are wasted, and which problems deserve attention. * Focus on measurable business outcomes rather than technology for its own sake. **Hands\-On Technical Ability** * Build solutions personally, from initial concept through production deployment. * Combine AI models, code, APIs, data, and automation tools to solve real business problems. **Demonstrated Results** * Have a track record of applying AI to meaningful business challenges. * Can show working systems, real\-world adoption, and measurable outcomes. **Ownership and Urgency** * Operate independently with a strong bias for action. * Move quickly, overcome obstacles, and take responsibility for results. * Remain accountable for your solutions after deployment. **Clear Communication** * Explain complex technical solutions in straightforward business terms. * Demonstrate what you built, why it matters, and how you know it works. **How to Apply** **Applications must include proof of work.** Submit your resume or professional profile along with **one or two examples of significant problems you've solved using AI.** For each example, include: * **The Problem:** What was happening, who was affected, and why it mattered. * **Your Solution:** What you built and how AI contributed. * **Your Contribution:** What you personally designed, implemented, integrated, and operated. * **The Results:** Before\-and\-after measurements, timeframe, scale, and costs. Clearly distinguish measured results from estimates. * **The Evidence:** A working product, recorded demo, code sample, architecture walkthrough, or documented case study. At least one example must demonstrate a solution deployed and used in an actual business environment. Redacted examples and confidential interview walkthroughs are welcome. Please do not share proprietary information without permission. **What to Expect** Be prepared to demonstrate your work and explain the technical decisions, tradeoffs, failures, and improvements behind it. We're looking for **builders who deliver measurable business results**, not people who simply understand AI concepts. **Location** Remote candidates will be considered, with some time required in Dallas, Texas. Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Automation Engineer – Cobots
jobs.description: **Job Description** **The Role** The Manufacturing Automation Engineer – Cobots leads the development, deployment, optimization, and sustainment of manufacturing automation solutions across GPS manufacturing sites. This role combines deep manufacturing engineering expertise with end\-to\-end project leadership. You will identify processes suitable for automation, evaluate the right solution—including collaborative robots (cobots), traditional industrial robots, vision systems, controls, and other automation technologies—and lead turnkey projects from concept through launch and sustainment. You will partner with plant teams, manufacturing engineering, controls and automation teams, suppliers, and business stakeholders to deliver solutions that improve safety, quality, ergonomics, throughput, labor efficiency, equipment utilization, and cost performance. This role supports projects across multiple plant locations. Travel is expected to vary by project phase and may reach 50% or more, including overnight travel and extended time at manufacturing plants during equipment build, installation, commissioning, and launch. Travel may exceed 50% during critical launch periods. **What You’ll Do** * Visit manufacturing plants and assess current processes, production requirements, and operational constraints. * Identify and prioritize automation opportunities that improve safety, ergonomics, quality, cycle time, labor efficiency, uptime, and cost. * Conduct feasibility studies and determine the appropriate solution, including cobots, traditional industrial robots, vision systems, controls, tooling, sensors, and related technologies. * Lead turnkey automation projects from concept and planning through design, equipment build, installation, commissioning, validation, launch, sustainment, and closeout. * Develop project scopes, Statements of Requirements (SORs), technical specifications, project plans, timing, deliverables, and risk and issue\-management plans. * Obtain and evaluate OEM and supplier quotes; lead supplier and integrator selection in partnership with stakeholders. * Secure project funding through applicable governance and approval processes. * Coordinate design reviews and equipment development with plant manufacturing engineering, CME, controls and automation teams, safety and ergonomics stakeholders, suppliers, and OEMs. * Ensure equipment and process designs meet manufacturing, quality, safety, ergonomic, capability, repeatability, and specification requirements. * Coordinate equipment delivery, installation, production downtime windows, commissioning, startup, and launch support. * Troubleshoot technical and process issues, perform root cause analysis, develop recovery plans, remove obstacles, and drive corrective actions through completion. * Track project timing, open issues, risks, dependencies, and deliverables; communicate status and escalate barriers when needed. * Validate equipment capability, repeatability, quality, safety, and process performance before transition to plant ownership. * Develop standard work, process documentation, technical specifications, troubleshooting guides, training materials, and lessons learned. * Train and support plant engineers, maintenance personnel, operators, and other stakeholders on system requirements and standardized methods. * Review process data and performance metrics to identify gaps and drive continuous improvement. * Complete project deliverables, deauthorization, and closeout activities. Benchmark and evaluate emerging technologies, tools, and methods that can improve manufacturing performance. * **Your Skills and Abilities** * Strong manufacturing technical depth and hands\-on experience solving production and process problems. * Ability to evaluate manufacturing processes and translate production needs into practical automation solutions and executable project plans. * Demonstrated ability to lead projects from feasibility and concept through implementation, launch, validation, sustainment, and closeout. * Strong project execution, organization, prioritization, and follow\-through skills. * Ability to manage multiple priorities, dependencies, risks, and competing business needs in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment. * Ability to influence without direct authority and gain alignment across plant teams, manufacturing engineering, controls, quality, maintenance, safety, ergonomics, leadership, suppliers, and OEMs. * Strong communication, collaboration, facilitation, and stakeholder\-management skills. * Hands\-on technical problem\-solving, troubleshooting, recovery planning, and root cause analysis capability. * Knowledge of manufacturing and assembly processes, equipment integration, lean manufacturing, standardized work, process improvement, and continuous improvement practices. * Understanding of safety principles, risk reduction, machine and cell integration, quality requirements, and process validation. * Familiarity with controls, vision syste eholders, engineering functions, leadership, and suppliers. The ability to combine technical judgment with practical project leadership, remove obstacles, and deliver results without direct authority. * **Success in This Role** Success will be measured by your ability to deliver safe, capable, repeatable, and sustainable automation solutions that meet project timing and launch milestones while improving manufacturing performance. You will be expected to own outcomes, communicate clearly, resolve issues with urgency, and ensure that plant teams have the documentation, training, and support needed for long\-term sustainment. \&\#xa;\&\#xa;GM does not provide immigration\-related sponsorship for this role. jobs.description: **About GitGuardian** --------------------- GitGuardian is a global cybersecurity scale\-up with offices in Paris, New York City, and Boston. They should be as recent as possible, and we will call them at the end of the process. **Benefits** ------------ * 25 days of PTO (employees are strongly encouraged to use all of it!) * ️ 10 public holidays * 401(k) \+ 3% matching! with Empower * ‍️ Health, Dental \& Vision insurance (80% coverage), for individuals and their families * Short\-term \& long\-term disability insurance (100% paid) * Travel policy and annual off\-site * $70 monthly remote work stipend * $4000 referral bonus * FSA and HSA And also... * Remote policy: hybrid * Long\-term career development opportunities **More about GitGuardian!** --------------------------- **Products** * Understand how GitGuardian works in this short video! * Want to go even further? Check out our public roadmap! * Check out the State of Secrets Sprawl Report to understand our mission and the industry. * Our solutions are already used by hundreds of thousands of developers in all industries and **GitGuardian platform is the n°1 app on the** GitHub marketplace **Clients** * GitGuardian helps organizations find exposed sensitive information that could often lead to tens of millions of dollars in potential damage. * More than 70% of our customers are in the United States. * Many F500 companies use GitGuardian's platform. **People** * The Guardians are **knowledgeable**, committed, serious, **aligned with the company’s mission, and true team players**: always willing to help each other grow our skill sets! * The team is diverse and we hail from more than 20 different countries. * We are also **agile, remote\-friendly,** and **fun people** to work with. * You will get **trust \& autonomy** on your perimeter with a very **transparent internal communication** and a strong impact on the company development. *The base salary range for this position is expected to be $55,000\-$60,000 per year, with added commission and competitive equity. Actual compensation will be determined on factors such as location, relevant experience, skills, and other qualifications.* *GitGuardian is an equal opportunity employer committed to encouraging and celebrating its diverse and inclusive workforce. jobs.title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, AI-Powered Work
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ Intuit’s AI\-Powered Work team helps employees redesign how work gets done with AI. We work with enterprise functions to understand their real problems, build useful solutions, and scale what works. We are looking for engineers who can move from an ambiguous business need to a working prototype and then own the path to a reliable production outcome. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you will embed with business partners and own a complex workflow from discovery and technical scoping through implementation, production rollout, and sustained adoption. You will combine deep engineering skills with broad product thinking: understanding the problem, testing assumptions quickly, making delivery tradeoffs, and building reusable capabilities with the broader team. **Responsibilities** * Understand how employees work today, including decisions, handoffs, source systems, and exceptions. Partner with business owners and product leaders to select high\-value problems, define a measurable baseline and success criteria, and sequence delivery around dependencies and data readiness. * Build and demonstrate prototypes early to test the riskiest assumptions with users. Use evidence to refine requirements and redesign the workflow, choosing where AI, deterministic code, or human judgment best serves the outcome. * Write production software across the needed layers: user experiences, services, agents, data access, and integrations. Connect enterprise systems through approved APIs and tool interfaces, including Model Context Protocol where appropriate. * Ground solutions in relevant knowledge and business data. Implement permissions, provenance, structured outputs, and approval steps so users can understand results and retain control over consequential actions. * Create task\-level evaluations with domain experts, including ambiguous inputs and failure cases. Establish regression tests and release criteria; add monitoring, recovery paths, and deployment controls. Investigate production issues and balance quality, reliability, latency, and cost. * Own delivery through sustained adoption. Work with business partners on rollout, training, feedback, documentation, and a clear ongoing support model. Measure workflow completion, output quality, cycle time, and user effort, and communicate demonstrated outcomes and remaining limitations. * Lead solution design and technical decisions within your workstream, reviewing architecture with the Principal Engineer and platform teams. Mentor engineers, strengthen code and design reviews, and turn deployment lessons into reusable components and evidence\-backed platform improvements. **Qualifications** * A record of independently delivering complex production software from an unclear problem through launch and iteration with 7\+ years of experience, with strong technical ownership and measurable outcomes. * Deep hands\-on programming and system\-design skills in Python, Java, TypeScript, or comparable languages. Experience building cloud services, integrating APIs and data systems, and debugging reliability and performance problems across system boundaries. * Practical experience building AI\-enabled applications or agents, with an understanding of retrieval, tool execution, evaluations, and when model outputs require validation. * Strong product judgment: you can uncover the underlying need with nontechnical partners, define requirements and success measures, prioritize scope, and make tradeoffs across user value, delivery speed, and technical risk. You communicate clearly through writing and working demonstrations. * Staff\-level technical leadership demonstrated through ownership of a complex capability or workstream, cross\-team influence, thoughtful design and code reviews, and mentoring that helps other engineers deliver maintainable software. * Experience with enterprise workflows, full\-stack product development, SaaS integrations, or secure agent deployment is valuable. Prior FDE titles or consulting experience are not required. * Success means business partners use the solution in real work, the targeted workflow measurably improves, and the implementation is reliable, supportable, and reusable where it should be. * Experience with enterprise workflows, full\-stack product development, SaaS integrations, or secure agent deployment is valuable. Prior FDE titles or consulting experience are not required. Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. jobs.title: Experienced Mozaik Cabinet Drafter
jobs.description: **KERFSIDE CUSTOM CABINETS** **Experienced Mozaik Cabinet Drafter** *Full\-Time \| On\-Site \| Richland Hills, TX* At Kerfside Custom Cabinets, we build dream kitchens and beyond for our homeowner, interior designer, and luxury GC clientele. Our team does it all — DESIGN \> BUILD \> FINISH \> INSTALL — and we are looking for a passionate and experienced Mozaik drafter to join us! Kerfside is a local family owned and operated luxury custom cabinet shop in Richland Hills, Texas, specializing in bespoke kitchens, home offices, entertainment centers, closets, and whole\-home cabinetry and millwork throughout DFW. If you are ready to take on a new challenge and you love bringing a client’s dream design to life, we want to talk to you! **What You’ll Do** * Partner with clients and our sales team to translate creative vision and functional needs into bespoke cabinetry — balancing beauty, function, and buildability from first sketch to final install. * Perform final site measurements and comprehensive field documentation — capturing existing conditions, obstructions, and installation details that drive design accuracy and a successful install. * Draft custom cabinetry designs in Mozaik from architectural plans, field measurements, and design intent. * Prepare final client approval drawings and secure written sign\-off before releasing projects to production. * Prepare accurate shop drawings, cut lists, hardware schedules, and material optimization for each project. * Specify and coordinate the purchasing of project\-specific materials and specialty hardware — partnering with vendors to ensure the right components arrive on schedule for each build. * Generate production\-ready CNC files and coordinate with the production team on tooling, cut sequences, and setup. * Reverse\-engineer complex design intent from client and designer concepts into buildable, installable solutions. * Collaborate closely with the Production Manager, installers, and finishing team to anticipate shop\-to\-site challenges before they become problems. * Review measurements and specifications before production to catch issues early and reduce rework. * Serve as the technical interface between design intent, production reality, and on\-site installation. * Help build and lead the drafting department — mentoring new drafters, establishing standards, and shaping the team as the company grows. **What We’re Looking For** ***Required:*** * 3\+ years of hands\-on Mozaik drafting experience in a production cabinet shop environment. * Strong CNC knowledge and hands\-on experience with tooling, cut sequences, and nesting optimization. * Strong IT and computer skills — comfortable with Windows, file management, backups, and troubleshooting routine software and hardware issues on your own. * Comfortable conducting client, designer, and vendor meetings over Zoom and other video conferencing platforms (Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, etc.). * Strong understanding of luxury residential custom cabinetry — from shop fabrication through on\-site installation — with the ability to reverse\-engineer designs for installation success. * Detail\-oriented, organized, and able to self\-manage a project queue and meet deadlines. * Able to read architectural plans and job\-site measurements accurately. ***Preferred:*** * 5\+ years of Mozaik experience. * Prior experience in a high\-end residential custom shop (not production tract work). * Experience with hardwood millwork, complex hardware (pocket doors, sliding systems, specialty hinges), and finished\-face details. * Familiarity with industry\-standard CAD tools in addition to Mozaik. * V\-carve experience. * SketchUp experience. **Compensation \& Benefits** * **Annual salary: $72,800** (W\-2, salaried exempt), paid on a regular bi\-weekly cycle. * **Schedule:** Full\-time, 40 hours per week minimum, Monday–Friday 7:00 AM – 3:30 PM. * **Paid holidays (8\):** New Year’s Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, Black Friday, Christmas Eve, and Christmas Day. * **Paid year\-end closure:** The office is closed from Christmas Eve through New Year’s Day — a full paid week. * **Paid Time Off:** One (1\) week of PTO per year, in addition to the paid holidays and year\-end closure. * **Workers’ Compensation:** Coverage provided under company policy. **Location** This is an on\-site role at our Richland Hills, Texas shop. This is not a remote position. **How to Apply** Send a brief note about your Mozaik and custom cabinetry background, along with: * Examples of previous work — shop drawings, finished projects, CNC files, or screenshots. * Your years of Mozaik experience and the type of shops you’ve worked in. * Your availability and target start date. **Apply to:** judson@kerfside.com Pay: $72,800\.00 per year Benefits: * Paid time off Work Location: In person

jobs.title: AI Software Developer

The ideal candidate will combine strong software engineering fundamentals with practical AI development skills to build scalable applications, integrate AI models, and solve real\-world business challenges. In this role, you will collaborate with software engineers, data specialists, and product teams to develop AI\-powered applications, intelligent automation tools, and production\-ready software systems. You will contribute to the full development lifecycle, from technical design and prototyping to deployment, testing, and ongoing optimization. Responsibilities * Design, develop, test, and maintain AI\-powered software applications. * Build and integrate AI models, large language models, and machine learning services into existing applications. * Develop backend services, APIs, and scalable software components. * Use Python and modern development frameworks to implement AI functionality. * Work with databases, data pipelines, and cloud\-based infrastructure. * Develop solutions involving natural language processing, generative AI, and intelligent automation. * Evaluate AI model performance, accuracy, reliability, and response quality. * Troubleshoot technical issues and optimize application performance. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions. * Maintain code quality, testing standards, documentation, and software security practices. * Support deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement of production AI systems. Requirements * Experience in software development, AI engineering, or machine learning application development. * Proficiency in Python and familiarity with common software development practices. * Understanding of REST APIs, backend development, databases, and application architecture. * Knowledge of machine learning concepts and AI model integration. * Familiarity with large language models, generative AI, or natural language processing. * Experience with Git, debugging, software testing, and code reviews. * Understanding of cloud platforms and production deployment workflows. * Strong analytical thinking, communication, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to collaborate with technical teams and manage development priorities. About the Company Kodexo Labs is an AI\-focused software development company headquartered in Austin, Texas, with a presence in Los Angeles and other markets. jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: **Who are we?** Komodor is an Agentic Operations Platform for mission\-critical production environments.We help enterprises to build custom agents under shared governance and context, and orchestrate them in end\-to\-end workflows for AI SRE, AI Software Operations, and Cost Optimization. With $90M in funding we're leading the autonomous infrastructure shift. **About the Role** We are looking for a Product Engineer to join our Product organization and become the bridge between our customers and our product. In this role, you will lead a major strategic initiative: driving the expansion of our customers from our Kubernetes management platform to a next\-generation platform designed to build, manage, monitor, and operate custom\-built internal agents running on production\-grade services. You will directly own the success of this flagship rollout \- ensuring seamless customer onboarding, active platform adoption, and enabling teams to successfully create and manage production\-grade agents. In addition to leading this core migration, you will work closely with a portfolio of customers, becoming a trusted partner within their teams and helping them get maximum value from Komodor. At the same time, you’ll bring the customer voice back into Product \- sharing feedback, identifying recurring needs, and collaborating with Engineering and Product teams to continuously refine the platform. This is a highly hands\-on role that combines technical expertise in cloud\-native platforms, project management, customer\-facing skills, and strong cross\-functional execution. This remote role will be based in the East US (EST). **What You'll Do** * Lead the core migration \& deployment initiative: Own the end\-to\-end rollout and customer migration from our older Kubernetes management system to our new agent\-centric platform. * Drive product\-led customer adoption and value: Lead customer success from the product side by guiding customers through building, managing, monitoring, and operating their custom\-built agents on production\-grade infrastructure. * Measure and deliver key success outcomes: Take accountability for key performance metrics including migration completion, overall platform adoption, and customer success in deploying and operating production\-grade internal agents. * Become part of the customer’s team: Understand their organization, technical environment, workflows, and challenges, providing guidance on how they can best build and run custom agents within the new environment. * Drive implementations: Lead hands\-on technical onboarding and implementations to ensure customers move smoothly from initial adoption to sustainable, production\-grade usage. * Identify expansion opportunities: Map customer organizations, identify new use cases for internal agent creation, and expand platform usage across teams and business units. * Connect customers with Product \& Engineering: Act as the voice of the customer internally, translating complex technical feedback, agent deployment bottlenecks, and feature requests into actionable product updates. * Work cross\-functionally: Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success (CS) to maintain alignment and ensure a unified rollout strategy. * Be hands\-on: Combine deep technical understanding, project management, and execution skills to solve complex customer challenges and make things happen. Requirements: * Strong technical background in areas such as DevOps, SRE, infrastructure, cloud\-native platforms, Kubernetes, or platform engineering. * Proven track record in leading complex technical migrations, rollout initiatives, or platform transitions for customer environments. * Experience working for a start\-up, self\-starter mentality who can work independently, and passionate about the customer's success. * Experience working directly with customers in a Solutions Architect, Solutions Engineer, Technical Account Manager, DevOps, or similar technical customer\-facing role. * Deep understanding of Kubernetes, containerization, modern cloud\-native architectures, and production\-grade service infrastructure. * Familiarity or strong interest in AI/internal agent creation, execution environments, and operational monitoring framework. * Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills, with a creative and practical approach to solving migration and adoption challenges. * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and work effectively with both internal teams and external customer stakeholders. * Strong project management skills and the ability to take ownership, coordinate multiple internal cross\-functional stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Sales, and CS), and drive complex deployments through to completion. * High emotional intelligence and the ability to navigate complex customer environments and organizational change management. * A hands\-on mindset \- someone who enjoys getting into technical details, troubleshooting complex architectures, and driving execution. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: Full\-Time In Person Hybrid (2\-4 days/week): Boston, MA Headquarters *Set the technical direction for the engine behind grid intelligence, from raw sensor data to the ratings that utilities act on.* We are seeking a **Staff Software Engineer** to join our LineRate team and set the architecture and technical strategy for the systems that turn massive time\-series sensor data into the ratings our utility customers rely on. You will work across the ratings generation library, our customer\-deployable product, weather modeling tools, and the front end visualizations that surface it all, and you will raise the technical bar for the engineers around you. If you want to own technical problems across teams and help shape how utilities get affordable, reliable power onto the grid, join us at **LineVision**, *Built In Boston Best Places to Work*! ### **What will you do?** **Core Responsibilities and Key Performance Objectives** * Develop the technical architecture for the ratings generation library and its microservice, the slimmed\-down customer\-deployable product, weather modeling tools, and front end visualizations, and keep those codebases coherent as they grow. * Partner with data scientists to set the path from research code to reliable, scalable production services, and develop reusable frameworks that make that path faster for the whole team. * Work with UI/UX and Product to design the APIs and data contracts that surface the right data at the right time. * Design storage and retrieval strategies for massive time\-series data sets, and own the tradeoffs on cost, latency and accuracy. * Lead complex, multi\-team technical initiatives from scoping through delivery, and guide teams through execution. * Influence roadmap priorities with Product and Engineering leadership, weighing customer benefit against time to implement and long\-term technical cost. * Coach engineers through design reviews, code review and pairing, and build programs that grow the team’s technical capability. * This role requires participation in a compensated rotational on\-call schedule. On\-call responsibilities are a condition of employment for this position. **Within the first 3 months:** * Learn how the ratings library, customer product, weather modeling and front end connect, and ship a meaningful contribution to at least one of them. * Build working relationships with Data Science, UI/UX, Product and engineering peers. * Deliver a written assessment of current architecture, with the top technical risks and opportunities ranked by customer impact. **Within the first 6 months:** * Lead the design and delivery of an initiative that spans multiple codebases or teams. * Propose and drive a concrete improvement to how we store or retrieve time\-series data at scale. * Bring a clear technical point of view to roadmap discussions and influence the decisions that come out of them. **Within the first year:** * Be the recognized technical authority for at least one core codebase and make the architectural decisions that others build on. * Lead a cross\-functional initiative with Data Science, UI/UX or Product from scoping through delivery, and answer for its outcome. * Coach multiple engineers, and put in place at least one practice or program (design review process, onboarding guide, shared frameworks) that raises how the whole team works. ### **How to succeed in this role** **Key Competencies** * **Critical Thinking:** Develop frameworks for solving complex problems in ratings generation, weather modeling and time\-series storage, and mentor others in applying them. Approach new problems with curiosity. * **Delivering Innovative Solutions:** Develop innovative technical strategies and guide teams in executing them. Embrace ambiguity and iterate with a growth mindset. * **Taking Ownership:** Coach others to take ownership and drive accountability across teams. Communicate proactively when scope or technical constraints shift. * **Follow Through \- Execution:** Deliver quality work on time across teams and projects. Resolve open questions with stakeholders and hold yourself and others accountable to commitments. * **Empowering Others:** Develop programs and initiatives that grow other engineers. Share knowledge freely and foster a supportive team environment where outcomes matter more than individual output. * **Stakeholder Management:** Develop strategies for working with Data Science, UI/UX, Product and customer\-facing teams, and influence decision\-making on priorities and tradeoffs. **Essential Skills** * Expert proficiency in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript, with strong experience in React. * Proven experience designing and evolving systems with at least one relational database and one NoSQL database. * Experience deploying and operating production systems on a major cloud platform. * Track record of setting architecture across the stack, from data storage through APIs to UI. * Experience leading technical initiatives across multiple engineers or teams, and mentoring other engineers. **What Sets the Best Candidates Apart** * Experience with Kubernetes. * Experience with Rust. * Experience designing large\-scale time\-series data systems. * Background working closely with data science or applied science teams to productionize research code. * Experience building engineering practices or programs that scaled beyond your own team. **Reporting \& Team Structure** * Reports to the **Senior Software Engineering Manager** * Collaborates closely with Data Science, UI/UX, and Product teams, and acts as a technical lead and mentor for engineers on the LineRate team. **Interview Process** * Apply Online. * Round 1: Phone screen (Recruiter) * Round 2: Hiring Manager Interview * Round 3: Panel Interviews + Panel 1: Technical competency, architecture and system design + Panel 2: Technical leadership, collaboration and communication * Final Round: Leadership Team \& Hiring Manager Sign\-Off (onsite) ### **What does joining LineVision mean for you?** * **Impact.** Your talent, time, and energy will critically impact our success in accelerating our mission of providing utilities with grid intelligence to enable affordable, reliable power. * **Ownership.** You will hold broad responsibilities with high autonomy and trust in a communicative, collaborative, and fast\-paced environment. * **Flexibility.** You will be empowered to maintain work\-life balance with trust\-based PTO and a flexible hybrid work schedule. * **Real World Innovation.** You will join a motivated and high\-performing team working with cutting edge, patented technology to help solve key obstacles to meet the demands of an AI\-powered future. ### **Who we are...** LineVision is a grid\-enhancing technology company enabling electric utilities to deliver affordable, reliable power and accelerate the electrification of the global economy. Our grid intelligence platform delivers the most accurate, network\-wide dynamic line ratings and enables safer, more reliable grid operations with a combination of optical sensors and advanced environmental modeling. LineVision's global customer base includes eight of the ten largest US utilities, including National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon. We are LineVisionaries: * **We are Innovators:** we light the way with tenacious creativity and do good work. * **We are Empowered:** With high trust and high autonomy, the floor is yours, and the opportunity is ours. * **We are Welcoming**: Come as you are, our doors are open. We are better together. * **We are Trusted Partners:** We elevate our customer champions through shared thought leadership. We deliver on commitments. * **We are All In**: We are building a community of passionate individuals who want to dent the universe. At LineVision there's no such thing as a "perfect" candidate. We are looking for exceptional people who want to make a positive impact through their work and facilitate an organization where everyone can thrive. So whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this role would make you excited to come to work every day. LineVision embraces AI, and we understand leveraging AI in your job search. As an actual member of LineVision's hiring team reviews every application, we kindly ask that any final materials you submit reflect your own voice and authentic human experience. Meet our team, and understand our mission: https://www.linevisioninc.com/about\-us

jobs.title: Technical Instructor – Emerging Technologies, Python, Data Engineering & AI Development
jobs.description: About Leading Edge Skills Leading Edge Skills LLC (LES) is an established California\-based organization and federal contractor delivering **leadership development, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, data analytics, technology training, and consulting** to defense agencies, civilian government organizations, and commercial clients. Driven by our commitment to giving back to the communities we serve, Leading Edge Skills (LES) is dedicated to making high\-quality education accessible to talented and motivated individuals, regardless of their financial circumstances, educational background, or geographical location. Over the past three years, **LES has offered more than 200 scholarships** to financially disadvantaged students, helping aspiring professionals access technical education and pursue meaningful careers. Building on our cybersecurity and data analytics scholarship initiative, we are launching the **Emerging Technologies \& AI Career Readiness Program**, a 12\-week, hands\-on training experience designed to equip students with marketable technical skills. **Our mission is simple: Give back to the community by passing valuable, often expensive technical knowledge to talented individuals who might otherwise never have the opportunity to access it.** Position Overview We are seeking an experienced and passionate technical instructor with strong industry expertise in Python, data analytics, modern cloud data platforms, and artificial intelligence application development. The ideal candidate is more than a technical expert. We are looking for someone who **genuinely enjoys teaching, mentoring, and sharing knowledge**, particularly with individuals facing financial or educational barriers. Our students will include veterans, military reservists, high school students, career changers, recent graduates, and professionals from diverse academic backgrounds. Many will receive scholarships. The instructor will help students progress from foundational technical knowledge to practical, job\-oriented competencies through live demonstrations, industry\-relevant examples, and project\-based instruction. The objective is not simply to teach technologies, but to prepare students to demonstrate their skills to potential employers. Required Technical Expertise **1\. Python Programming – Intermediate to Advanced** * Strong practical experience with Python, including data structures, functions, modules, object\-oriented programming, APIs, exception handling, and debugging. * Proficiency with Pandas, NumPy, data manipulation, automation, and practical application development. * Ability to teach coding concepts to learners without computer science degrees. **2\. Excel, Data Analytics \& SQL** * Advanced Excel capabilities, including PivotTables, XLOOKUP, data cleaning, reporting, and analytical models. * Working knowledge of SQL, relational databases, querying, and data transformation. * Ability to connect Excel, Python, and SQL to real business problems. **3\. Cloud Data Platforms \& Data Engineering** * Practical knowledge of Databricks, Snowflake, or comparable modern data platforms. * Understanding of data warehouses, data lakes, lakehouse architecture, ETL/ELT processes, and data pipelines. * Ability to design realistic exercises using accessible training environments and sample datasets. **4\. Artificial Intelligence \& AI Application Development** * Strong understanding of machine learning fundamentals, generative AI, and large language models. * Hands\-on experience integrating AI APIs into Python applications. * Familiarity with prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and AI agents. * Ability to demonstrate practical AI applications, basic deployment, testing, and responsible AI practices. **5\.
