jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.description: **Solutions Architect** ======================= **About us** ------------ Monk is an AI\-native accounts receivable (AR) platform for B2B companies helping businesses get paid fast. The AR stack is broken. Finance teams still chase payments with spreadsheets, reconcile AR in spreadsheets and use software that was built a decade ago. We think this is one of the largest, most ignored problems in B2B software. Trillions of dollars sit in outstanding invoices and the tools to unlock cashflow are stuck in the past. We are rebuilding Monk with AI, speed, and real craftsmanship. We are already doing this for over $1B of accounts receivables. We are backed by leading investors and our founders bring significant experience to our company (more here). We are early, the upside is enormous, and the hardest, but also the most rewarding work is ahead of us. **About the role** ------------------ Own the customer’s solution from discovery through go\-live. Understand how their finance team works, design how Monk’s AI agents fit into their operations, and work with Engineering and CX for delivery. AR is full of work that requires context, judgment, and follow\-through: chasing payments, resolving disputes, navigating buyer portals, and matching cash to invoices. You will help Customers identify where agents can take on that work and translate the opportunity into working solutions with measurable results. You will work directly with Customers, GTM, Product, Engineering, and founders. Your work will help win strategic deals, accelerate launches, and shape what Monk builds next. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Map the customer’s AR workflows, systems, data, business rules, and exceptions. Identify where agents can reduce manual work and accelerate payment. * Define how Monk connects with ERPs, accounting platforms, payment providers, inboxes, files, and APIs, and permissible agent actions, permissions, approval rules, and human handoffs. * Use representative customer workflows and data to prove the solution works. Agree on success criteria and connect the results to business value. * Qualify opportunities with GTM, lead technical conversations, and resolve blockers early. Be precise about current capabilities and work required. * Turn discovery into clear requirements, integration plans, acceptance criteria, and responsibilities. Work with Engineering and CX through launch and handoff. * Bring recurring customer needs to Product and Engineering with concrete examples, business impact, and proposed solutions. * Build reusable POC environments, agent workflow designs, integration guides, and implementation playbooks. **Example projects** -------------------- * **Validate an agentic collections workflow.** Build a POC around a customer’s overdue accounts: review account history, prioritize follow\-ups, draft contextual outreach, and route disputes or payment commitments to the right person. Define approval rules and measure manual work saved. * **Design an agent that resolves payment blockers.** Map how invoice requests, missing purchase orders, supporting documents, and buyer portal requirements delay payment. Build a POC for an enterprise workflow, defining the integrations, permissions, and human handoffs needed to move invoices toward payment. * **Scope an agentic cash application workflow.** Trace how remittance emails, payment notifications, bank transactions, and open invoices fit together. Build a POC that investigates potential matches and proposes allocations, with finance approval for ambiguous cases. **What you’ll bring** --------------------- * Experience in solutions architecture, solutions consulting, solutions engineering, or enterprise software implementation, with ownership of complex customer engagements. * Confidence working with finance leaders, operators, IT, and engineering teams. You ask good questions and earn trust through clear answers. * Ability to translate enterprise workflows into practical solution designs, POCs, and implementation plans. * Working knowledge of APIs, data flows, authentication, permissions, and integrations. You can read documentation, investigate data issues, and work through technical decisions with engineers. * Strong written and verbal communication. You make requirements, tradeoffs, decisions, and next steps easy to understand. * Commercial judgment. You connect product capabilities to business value and set expectations the team can deliver. * High agency and follow\-through. You find missing information, resolve ambiguity, and keep work moving. * Daily use of AI tools and ability to automate your work. **Bonus points if…** -------------------- * You have worked with AR, accounting, billing, payments, or ERP systems. * You have helped Customers deploy AI workflows, including defining evaluations, human review, exception handling, and success criteria. * You are comfortable with SQL, data modeling, or lightweight scripting. * You have worked at an early\-stage company where you helped define how Customers were sold, onboarded, and supported. **How we work** --------------- * **Ownership and craft:** We own our work end to end and obsess over getting the details right. We believe that our Customers deserve the best possible outcomes and we strive to produce work that would get a 12/10 reaction from either our Customers or members of our team. Ownership is also knowing when to go deep on a problem and when to move fast. And when the v1 is live \- we own all follow\-through until it is perfect * **Speed and urgency:** We ship daily. We act now. Not tomorrow and not the end of the week, but today \- this hour. We love shipping fast to delight our Customers * **Radical clarity:** We believe in getting to the truth. It is important that all of us reason from the same version of reality (the truth) so that we can get the best result. We strive to get the truth by any means necessary. This means being open to feedback, obsessing over improving from our mistakes and clear communication **Why this market** ------------------- * A broken market and a real shot at owning it. AR is huge, ignored, and ready to be rebuilt. We're early and the surface area is enormous * $T\+ market and max EV from a single AR wedge * No clear winner has emerged in this massive category. It can be us * Insulated from labs. This workflow is complex, too many integrations are required and the last mile in AR is too bespoke for general purpose models * Hard problem worth solving. Revenue intelligence is challenging and inherently unsexy. Frankly, there are fewer strong companies in our space and we are building the most talent\-dense team * Undeniable $ROI that allows us to clearly illustrate value to Customers, and embeds us into integral workflows * Our unfair advantage: We have ex\-finance founders that have previously exited, scars and learnings from those experiences, an eng\-first culture and late\-mover advantage **Why join Monk** ----------------- * You want to be a founder someday. We are sharing everything we’ve learned building our past companies (25% of the team are 2nd time founders). One of our primary goals is to help you become a founder and create a place where you do your life’s best work (see more here) * Real ownership and an opportunity to 10x your learning curve. You will see your work go to production and deliver results for Customers, fast. Your own experience is the greatest teacher and at Monk we are maximizing the \# of times you get to have valuable experiences * Build at the frontier of applied AI and solve hard problems. You are curious about AI and do not want to miss this moment building at the frontier * Experienced founders that have exited before and a motivated team that is all\-in * Competitive salary and meaningful equity * Medical/dental/vision, flexible paid time off and dinner stipend * Beautiful office in Flatiron, New York Category defining companies are built with exceptional people. Our team is one of the products we're shipping \= come help build it.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager, AI Kernels & Performance Optimization — MTIA Software
jobs.description: Meta designs and deploys its own AI systems. MTIA — the Meta Training and Inference Accelerator — is Meta's family of in\-house AI accelerator ASICs, running recommendation and ranking workloads in production across Meta's data centers today and expanding into generative AI inference and training as successive silicon generations land.The MTIA Software team is part of the AI \& Compute Foundation (ACF) organization within Meta Infrastructure. We build the entire stack a chip vendor would normally supply — compiler and LLVM toolchain, runtime, kernel authoring frameworks and libraries, developer tooling, and deep PyTorch integration — co\-designing it with the silicon teams generation over generation.Within that stack, the AI Kernels and Performance Optimization team (KORE) owns the layer where silicon architecture meets arithmetic. Our mission is roofline\-level performance and programmability at scale: we design and implement high\-performance compute and communication kernels (GEMM, attention variants, normalization, collectives, elementwise and reduction fusions, sparse and quantized paths) against novel architectural features including matrix engines, on\-chip reduction fabrics, and software\-managed memory hierarchies. We ship kernel libraries with broad PyTorch operator coverage, build C\+\+ and Python kernel authoring frameworks and DSL surfaces, and write production kernels against new architectures long before first silicon — turning hardware proposals into measured roofline evidence while the design can still change.We are seeking a Software Engineering Manager to lead a team of kernel and performance engineers doing this work. You will own the performance of workloads that serve billions of people, drive technical strategy for kernel development and optimization, and build a team that can deliver roofline\-level performance on MTIA accelerators. Your team will profile and root\-cause performance across the full stack — instruction scheduling, memory hierarchy and DMA behavior, on\-chip interconnect, multi\-device collectives — and drive fixes to the right layer, whether that is the kernel, compiler, runtime, or hardware. You will partner closely with silicon architecture teams on hardware/software co\-design, quantifying the value of proposed features with real kernels and advocating for the changes the software stack needs. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role where you will contribute directly to architectural decisions while enabling your team to move with speed and clarity. ### **Software Engineering Manager, jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, AI Platform & Infrastructure
jobs.description: **Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human** Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. #### **The Software Engineer Opportunity** The team that built Jeeva AI is building Digital Workers, a new suite of autonomous agents for identity operations and security inside Okta. The team works directly with Todd McKinnon, Okta's co\-founder and CEO, with the opportunity to bring this product to Okta's 20,000\+ customers. You will help shape the product with the ownership and pace of a startup and the resources of a public company. You will build the backend and AWS platform that keep these workers running around the clock. The team owns services, connectors, workflow execution, data and production reliability. You will write Python services and infrastructure code that let workers make approved changes and preserve evidence. #### **About You** **Reliable builder:** You design for failure and prove that recovery works. **Hands\-on engineer:** You write production services and improve the tools engineers use every day. **Strong owner:** You follow changes through deployment, monitoring and production support. #### **What you will be doing** * Build Python FastAPI services, data models and reusable connectors for Okta, AWS, ServiceNow and enterprise applications. * Implement durable execution with Step Functions, SQS and EventBridge. Handle approval waits, rate limits, duplicate events and safe retries. * Manage PostgreSQL schemas, indexes, query performance and pgvector retrieval. Enforce tenant isolation across APIs, storage and credentials. * Build model API access for OpenAI, Anthropic and supported AWS paths, including credentials, quotas, timeouts and cost controls. * Add an analytics pipeline for worker events, traces, tokens, findings and verified outcomes. Evaluate ClickHouse and comparable systems such as BigQuery. * Create reliable usage records and reconciliation. Prevent retries, duplicate findings and incomplete work from being counted as new outcomes. * Build deployment pipelines, infrastructure as code, observability and safe release controls across development, staging and production. * Implement scoped write services, kill switches, audit retention and backup recovery. Test failures and verify that sensitive changes actually took effect. #### **What you will bring to the role** * Experience building and operating production backend or distributed systems, with strong coding skills in Python or a comparable language. * Hands\-on AWS experience with APIs, queues, containers, networking, IAM and databases. * Strong SQL and data modeling skills. Experience diagnosing database performance and asynchronous system failures. * Experience with infrastructure as code, deployment automation, observability and production incident response. * Sound judgment about customer data, tenant isolation, credentials and safe changes to external systems. #### **Scope by level** **Senior:** Own a backend or platform component, including deployment, tests and production operation. **Staff:** Lead a domain such as execution, tenant security, data infrastructure or reliability across teams. **Principal:** Set shared backend and platform contracts, resolve system tradeoffs and implement foundational services. #### **Our stack** Python FastAPI, AWS Step Functions, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway and containers. Data and security use RDS PostgreSQL, pgvector, S3 Object Lock, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch and CloudTrail. The frontend uses React and AWS Amplify. OpenAI and Anthropic model integrations are planned. We are also adding an agent harness and dedicated analytics. ClickHouse is a hiring focus for analytics, and BigQuery or equivalent experience is relevant. The harness and analytics choices remain open. #### **And extra credit for** * ClickHouse, BigQuery or comparable analytics systems, event ingestion and usage metering. * Multi\-tenant SaaS, OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SCIM or enterprise connector development. * Deploying agent frameworks, including Claude Agent SDK, Codex SDK, Strands Agents, Deep Agents or LangGraph. Prior identity experience is optional. P26068\_3596525 \#LI\-RWI **The Okta Experience** * Supporting Your Well\-Being * Driving Social Impact * Developing Talent and Fostering Connection \+ Community We are intentional about connection. Our global community, spanning over 20 offices worldwide, is united by a drive to innovate. Your journey begins with an immersive, in\-person onboarding experience designed to accelerate your impact and connect you to our mission and team from day one. Okta is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, marital status, age, physical or mental disability, or status as a protected veteran. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and convictions records, consistent with applicable laws. If reasonable accommodation is needed to complete any part of the job application, interview process, or onboarding please use this Form to request an accommodation. jobs.title: Director of Estimating - Data Center Fit-Out Cost Strategy (Nashville, TN)
jobs.description: The Global Program Controls organization provides governance, reporting, controls processes, cost management support, and portfolio visibility to help Oracle Cloud Infrastructure deliver global data center programs with greater consistency, transparency, and execution discipline. Oracle is seeking a Director of Estimating to build and lead an owner\-side cost\-intelligence function for data\-center tenant fit\-out and technology infrastructure. This is not a contractor bidding or business\-development role. The Director will establish independent, should\-cost estimates and market benchmarks that allow us to assess, challenge, and negotiate pricing submitted by co\-location providers and low\-voltage contractors. The role will also partner closely with Engineering to ensure our design standards deliver the required performance without creating unnecessary cost. The right candidate combines deep experience in low\-voltage and technology\- infrastructure estimating with strong commercial judgment, data\-center awareness, and a practical vision for automating estimating through AI. **What You’ll Do** * Build an owner\-side estimating capability that establishes independent should\-cost estimates for our recurring data\-center tenant fit\-out build types. * Develop benchmark pricing, unit\-cost libraries, labor assumptions, productivity factors, and market intelligence for low\-voltage, technology\-infrastructure , power, and pathway scopes. * Review co\-location provider fit\-out proposals and low\-voltage contractor pricing; identify gaps, unsupported allowances, scope overlap, risk premiums, and opportunities to negotiate. * Provide leadership with clear, defensible cost positions before and during commercial negotiations. * Create repeatable, bid\-ready assumptions and scope packages for each build type, allowing co\-location providers to price against a common baseline. * Establish an assumption\-management process so that, as designs mature, the team can clearly identify what has changed and whether pricing should increase or decrease. * Turn incomplete provider proposals into transparent comparisons by documenting the assumptions, inclusions, exclusions, quantities, and basis of estimate required for a reliable decision. * Partner with Engineering and design teams to review design standards and challenge requirements that add cost without being necessary for data\-center functionality, reliability, capacity, or operational needs. * Help define cost\-aware design standards, alternates, and decision frameworks that balance performance, speed, scalability, and capital efficiency. * Interface with co\-location providers, general contractors, low\-voltage contractors, engineers, and internal stakeholders to resolve scope and pricing ambiguity early. * Develop consistent reporting for estimate variance, cost drivers, market trends, negotiation outcomes, and lessons learned across projects. * Lead the implementation of AI and automation in estimating, including rapid concept estimates, scope extraction, proposal analysis, benchmark comparisons, assumption tracking, and historical\-cost intelligence. **Technical Scope** The Director will have working knowledge across the technology and supporting\-infrastructure package required for data\-center tenant fit\-outs, including: * Structured cabling, fiber, network infrastructure, and interconnection requirements * Technology rooms, IDFs/MDFs, racks, cabinets, containment, grounding/bonding, and equipment support * AV, security, access control, CCTV, wireless, DAS, and related technology systems, where applicable * Cable tray, ladder rack, conduit, sleeves, J\-hooks, pathways, firestopping, backboards, and physical infrastructure * Electrical power serving technology environments, including dedicated circuits, branch power, receptacles, whips, UPS support, and coordination with electrical\-trade partners * Testing, commissioning, turnover documentation, and other delivery requirements that affect cost and schedule **What** **We’re Looking For** * Significant experience estimating low\-voltage, technology\-infrastructure, and supporting power/pathway scopes. * Strong experience in commercial tenant improvement, interior fit\-out, data\-center fit\-out, mission\-critical, or similarly complex environments. * Experience developing budgets, independent estimates, benchmarks, or owner\-side cost models—not solely contractor bid estimates. * The ability to translate incomplete design or proposal information into a credible, transparent basis of estimate. * Strong understanding of how design decisions, standards, phasing, schedule, procurement, labor availability, and scope definition affect cost. * Experience working effectively with engineers, designers, contractors, and senior business stakeholders. * Strong analytical judgment and the confidence to challenge pricing, assumptions, and design requirements constructively. * A demonstrated interest in AI, automation, and scalable estimating processes, with the ability to convert ideas into practical workflows. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex cost issues simply and credibly. **Preferred Qualifications** * Data\-center , co\-location, hyperscale, mission\-critical, or critical\-infrastructure experience. * Experience with owner’s\-representative , developer, enterprise\-owner, or procurement\-side estimating . * Experience building a cost database, benchmark model, standardized scope package, or design\-to\-cost program. * Familiarity with low\-voltage and technology standards, Division 27/28 systems, and their coordination with power and pathways. * Experience implementing estimating platforms, data tools, automation, or AI\-enabled workflows. **What Success Looks Like** Within the first year, this leader will have created a trusted should\-cost model for our primary build types; established common pricing assumptions for co\-location\-provider proposals; improved visibility into scope, cost drivers, and estimate variance; strengthened our negotiating position with providers and contractors; and launched AI\-enabled workflows that allow the team to evaluate pricing quickly without sacrificing rigor.

jobs.title: Enterprise Automation Developer
jobs.description: About Prime: Established in 2004, Prime Controls, L.P. is a family\-owned Systems Integration and I\&C Construction firm dedicated to meeting clients’ industrial automation and control requirements. As a Main Automation Contractor, we offer comprehensive solutions, supported by our size, expertise, and extensive experience. With a professional team of 1000\+ employees, Prime Controls serves customers nationwide from our Dallas, Texas headquarters and offices throughout the United States. Our mission is to deliver the highest quality professional services while prioritizing our employees’ well\-being and fostering an exceptional workplace environment. Overview: **About Prime Controls** Established in 2004, Prime Controls, L.P. is a family\-owned Systems Integration and I\&C Construction firm dedicated to meeting clients’ industrial automation and control requirements. As a Main Automation Contractor, we offer comprehensive solutions, supported by our size, expertise, and extensive experience. With a professional team of 1000\+ employees, Prime Controls serves customers nationwide from our Dallas, Texas headquarters and offices throughout the United States. Our mission is to deliver the highest quality professional services while prioritizing our employees’ well\-being and fostering an exceptional workplace environment. **Position Summary** Prime Controls is hiring an Associate Developer to build the APIs, integrations, automations, and AI agents that connect our business and engineering systems. This role is designed for an early\-career developer, including a recent computer science or software engineering graduate, who is genuinely fast with modern AI development tooling and uses it to produce working, supportable software rather than one\-off scripts. The work is real and immediate. Prime is standing up API endpoints against internal engineering data, moving field\-facing tools off spreadsheets and manual handoffs, and building AI agents that take repetitive work out of estimating, project controls, purchasing, and document handling. The Associate Developer will write that code, test it, document it, and hand it off in a state someone else can maintain. This is not a help desk role and it is not an infrastructure role. Day\-to\-day support, identity, endpoint management, and network operations stay with Information Technology. This role sits in the Business Technology Group and partners closely with Engineering, IT, platform owners, and the business groups whose processes the work is meant to improve. We expect the person in this role to grow. The intent is to add senior development leadership over time and build a small development function around it, so appetite for mentorship, code review, and rising standards matters more than a polished resume. **Key Responsibilities** **API and Integration Development** * Build and maintain REST API endpoints that expose project and asset data from internal engineering systems to the tools that need it, including project asset lists consumed by field\-facing applications. * Implement authentication and authorization for internal and externally reachable applications using approved patterns such as JWT, Microsoft Entra ID, or issued API keys, following the standard selected with IT and BTG rather than inventing a new one per project. * Develop integrations between enterprise platforms including ERP/MRP, engineering data systems, construction tracking platforms, Microsoft 365, and internal tools, using vendor APIs, file exchanges, and scheduled data movement. * Write integration code that fails visibly and recoverably, including logging, error handling, retries, and alerting that tells someone when data stopped moving. * Document endpoints, payloads, dependencies, and support expectations so integrations are transferable and not owner dependent. **AI Agent and Automation Development** * Build AI agents and assisted workflows against approved platforms, including Claude and the Microsoft AI stack, for defined business processes such as document review, data extraction, exception handling, and routine reporting. * Turn manual and repetitive business processes into automations using Power Automate, Python, PowerShell, scripted jobs, and platform\-native capability, selecting the lightest tool that will hold up. * Define and test guardrails on any agent that touches business data: what it can access, what it can write, what it must escalate to a person, and how its output is verified. * Measure what the automation actually changed. Every agent or automation is expected to carry a before\-and\-after number such as time per transaction, keying error rate, or cycle time. * Evaluate native platform capability before building custom, consistent with BTG governance. **Internal Application Development and Support** * Contribute to internal applications, including JavaScript\-based field and project tools, with a focus on refinement, integration, and stability rather than rebuild * Familiarity with relational databases and SQL sufficient to read a schema, write queries, and reason about data relationships. * Demonstrated hands\-on use of AI development tools to produce working software, with the ability to explain what the tool produced and why it is correct. * Evidence of initiative: projects started and finished without being assigned, problems pursued past the first obstacle, and work shipped rather than shelved. * Ability to communicate clearly with people who are not developers, including field and office staff describing a problem in their own terms. * Willingness to work onsite at the Lewisville headquarters, with occasional travel to regional offices or project sites. **Preferred** * Internship, co\-op, or project experience building or consuming production APIs. * Experience with Git\-based version control and collaborative code review. * Exposure to the Microsoft stack, including Power Platform, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, or Entra ID. * Exposure to cloud services, containerization, or CI/CD pipelines. * Coursework or project work in machine learning, natural language processing, or agent frameworks. * Interest in construction, industrial automation, controls, or manufacturing environments. * Any experience turning a manual process into an automated one, at any scale. **Initial 90\-Day Priorities** * Complete onboarding to Prime's development environment, source control, AI tooling, and AI governance policy, and understand what data may be used where. * Learn the current system landscape: ERP/MRP, engineering data platforms, internal tools, construction tracking pilots, and the integration points already in place. * Deliver one production API endpoint end to end, including authentication, documentation, and testing, under the direction of the assigned technical owner. * Take ownership of one existing internal application component and close a defined backlog of defects and usability items. * Build one AI agent or automation against a real business process with a measured before\-and\-after result. * Produce documentation for everything touched in the first ninety days, to the standard that lets another developer pick it up. * Identify two additional automation candidates from direct observation of how the business works, with an estimate of effort and expected benefit. Benefits: **What We Offer** We value our employees and offer full\-time team members a benefits package designed to support their health, financial well\-being, and work\-life balance, including: * Health, Dental, and Vision coverage * Flexible Spending Account(s) * Generous PTO * ESOP Program * Numerous company events * 401(k) matching and more! Work Environment \& Physical Demands (Text Only): This role is primarily performed in a professional office environment at the Lewisville headquarters and involves extended periods of sitting and working at a computer. The position requires regular communication and collaboration with office and field personnel and may include occasional travel to regional offices or project sites. Site visits may involve walking, standing, exposure to active construction or industrial environments, and use of required personal protective equipment. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. EEO: Prime Controls is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Affirmative Action/Veteran/Disabled employer. As a federal contractor, Prime Controls is required to participate in the federal government’s E\-Verify program, which confirms employment authorization of all newly hired employees and most existing employees through an electronic database maintained by the Social Security Administration and Department of Homeland Security. For new hires, the E\-Verify process is completed in conjunction with the Form I\-9 Employment Eligibility Verification on or before the first day of work. E\-Verify is not used as a tool to pre\-screen candidates.

jobs.title: Software Developer III - Audio
jobs.description: **Job** **Summary** ------------------- Provide expert\-level design and development expertise across the full stack: front\-end, back\-end, APIs, databases, and integrations. Create and maintain software products including applications, web pages, client portals, reports and queries, and other products as requested. Leverage modern AI\-assisted and agentic development tools to accelerate delivery, while bringing the engineering depth to review, validate, and stand behind everything that ships, whether written by a person or generated by AI. Interface with clients, customers, and internal users to gather requirements, troubleshoot issues, and deploy solutions. Train other team members and provide technical leadership in design and development matters. Help develop and support software development best practices. A significant focus of this role is building real\-time audio and telephony systems—capturing, processing, and delivering live call traffic—so experience with VoIP/telephony or audio\-streaming systems is highly valued. This role operates on a hybrid work model. **Major** **Responsibilities** ------------------------------ * Design and develop scalable, reusable, secure, and maintainable software solutions. * Lead the implementation of complex features and resolve high\-impact technical issues. * Define and enforce coding standards, best practices, and design principles. * Optimize system performance and scalability through code and architecture improvements. * Work closely with product managers, business analysts, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions. * Participate in architectural discussions and contribute to technical decision\-making. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including QA and UX/UI. * Guide and mentor junior and mid\-level developers through technical challenges. * Conduct thorough code reviews to ensure quality and adherence to standards. * Leverage agentic AI development tools (e.g., Claude, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, OpenCode, etc.) to design, build, and refactor software, and rigorously review and validate AI\-generated code for correctness, security, and maintainability. * Share knowledge and promote continuous learning within the team. * Take ownership of technical aspects of projects, ensuring timely and successful delivery. * Break down complex tasks into smaller, manageable components for the team. * Identify risks and propose solutions to mitigate them during project planning. * Stay updated on emerging technologies and industry trends. * Propose and implement innovative solutions to improve processes, tools, and overall codebase quality. * Promote the adoption of new tools, frameworks, or methodologies to enhance development efficiency. * Design, build, and maintain software that captures and processes mirrored SIP trunk traffic (via switch SPAN/port\-mirror), including SIP signaling parsing and RTP stream reconstruction into call audio. * Develop audio\-handling components, including codec decoding/encoding (e.g., G.711\), audio file formats, and the extraction and storage of call metadata. * Implement real\-time delivery mechanisms (e.g., WebSockets, gRPC, WebRTC) for live audio consumption. * Other duties as assigned. **Education and/or** **Experience** ----------------------------------- * Strong back\-end development expertise in C\# (.NET / ASP.NET Core) and Python (e.g., FastAPI, Django), with the ability to design and build robust, secure APIs and services. Equivalent depth in another modern back\-end stack will also be considered. * Solid understanding of database and data\-layer design, including relational databases, data modeling, and writing efficient, well\-structured queries. * Proficiency with a modern JavaScript/TypeScript front\-end framework (such as React, Next.js, Angular, or Vue), including component architecture, state management, routing, server\-side rendering, and data fetching and caching patterns. * Skilled at building responsive, accessible UI from design specifications (e.g., Figma), with strong attention to cross\-device compatibility, performance, and usability. * Experienced in full\-stack architecture and design—structuring code and data flow and building scalable, reusable, and maintainable systems end to end. * Strong experience with cloud\-based deployment and integration across Azure, AWS, and/or Google Cloud, including CI/CD pipeline implementation and environment configuration. * Hands\-on experience using AI\-assisted and agentic development tools (e.g., Claude, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, OpenCode, etc.) in a daily workflow, paired with the engineering depth to critically review, test, and validate AI\-generated code rather than accepting it at face value. * Provided technical mentorship to mid\- and junior\-level developers, fostering growth through guidance, feedback, and collaborative development practices. * Version Control: Expertise with Git and branching strategies. * Testing: Proficient in unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing and modern testing frameworks. * Telephony/Audio: Experience with VoIP/telephony protocols and systems—SIP, RTP/RTCP, and SDP—or equivalent phone\-system, PBX, or call\-center platform experience (e.g., Asterisk, FreeSWITCH, Cisco, Avaya, or NICE/Verint recording). * 6\+ years of professional software development experience, with a proven track record of delivering complex projects. * Experience leading teams or managing technical projects. * Strong leadership and mentoring capabilities. * Excellent problem\-solving and analytical thinking skills. * Clear and effective communication skills, both verbal and written. * Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team. * Strong organizational skills to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience, including relevant boot camps and industry certifications). **Physical Requirements/Essential Job** **Functions** ----------------------------------------------------- * Coding, collaborating, developing prototypes and projects from start to final product * Ability to multi\-task technical problems efficiently. * Frequent computer use. * Sitting for long periods of time. * Concentrating for long periods of time. * Work with minimal supervision * Able to effectively estimate and manage time **Our Company:** Priority Dispatch Corp. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are a small, fast\-growing provider of consulting, training, and software products for the public safety market. Priority Dispatch is based in the U.S. in downtown Salt Lake City, Utah. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and matching 401(k) programs, etc. Priority Dispatch Corp. (PDC) provides comprehensive, integrated solutions for Police, Fire, and Medical emergency dispatching. We incorporate the Emergency Priority Dispatch System® approved by the International Academies of Emergency Dispatch in all our products. PDC offers multi\-agency emergency dispatching ProQA® software, as well as a card\-set version, AQUA® quality improvement software, training, consulting, and Academy accreditation support. www.prioritydispatch.net

jobs.description: **Company:** ------------ Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. **Job Area:** ------------- Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Software Applications Engineering **General Summary:** Qualcomm is a company of inventors that unlocked 5G, ushering in an age of rapid acceleration in connectivity and new possibilities that will transform industries, create jobs, and enrich lives. But this is just the beginning. It takes inventive minds with diverse skills, backgrounds, and cultures to transform 5G’s potential into world\-changing technologies and products. This is the Invention Age, and this is where you come in. OR PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field. * 1\+ year of any combination of academic and/or work experience with Programming Language such as C, C\+\+, Java, Python, etc. * 1\+ year of any combination of academic and/or work experience with debugging techniques. **Responsibilities Shall Include the Following** * Design, integration, and validation of embedded systems based on Qualcomm's Automotive Infotainment, ADAS, and Robotics SoCs and platforms. * Collaborate with product owners, customers, and domain/technology experts to define requirements and implement technical solutions for customer programs. * Support Automotive OEMs, Tier\-1s , Robotics customers, and ecosystem partners in the integration and deployment of solutions based on Qualcomm platforms. * Debug and resolve system\-level issues involving camera sensors, ISP, multimedia pipelines, synchronization, performance, stability, and software integration. * Support cameras bring\-up, image quality tuning, multimedia integration, and performance optimization on Qualcomm platforms. * Work closely with software, hardware, systems, and product teams to analyze, debug, and resolve customer\-reported issues. * Develop technical documentation, integration guides, and troubleshooting materials to support customer development and deployment activities. **Minimum Qualifications** * 4\+ years of experience in Embedded Systems, Automotive, Camera, Multimedia, Robotics, or related domains. * Strong proficiency in C/C\+\+ programming and software architecture design. * Familiarity with camera interfaces and protocols including MIPI CSI\-2, I2C, GPIO, V4L2, GMSL, FPD\-Link, and SerDes technologies. * Experience with embedded software development, integration, system bring\-up, validation, debugging, and optimization of complex embedded systems, including development in compliance with industry standards such as ISO 26262 and ASPICE. * Strong understanding of camera systems, camera architectures, Camera ISP, image processing, image quality (IQ), and video pipelines. * Experience with camera sensor bring\-up, sensor drivers, camera framework integration, and end\-to\-end camera software debugging. * Experience with 3A algorithms (Auto Exposure, Auto Focus, Auto White Balance), image quality tuning, analysis, debugging, and optimization. * Strong system\-level understanding of camera and multimedia pipelines, with experience in performance analysis, latency optimization, bandwidth optimization, resource utilization analysis, and end\-to\-end system debugging. * Experience with automotive camera systems, multi\-camera architectures, camera synchronization, frame synchronization, video processing, and time\-aligned data acquisition across heterogeneous sensing systems, including Cameras, LiDAR, Radar, IMU, and other ADAS or Robotics perception sensors. * Strong analytical, issue triage, root cause analysis, and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent communication skills (written and verbal), strong customer engagement skills, and the ability to work effectively in cross\-functional and geographically distributed teams. * Quick adaptability to work with new technologies. **Additional / Preferred Qualifications** * Working knowledge of operating systems such as QNX, Linux, Android, and other RTOSs. * Experience with Android Camera Framework, Camera HAL, Media Framework, IPC Mechanisms, and Vehicle HAL interface. * Knowledge of Linux Device Drivers, Embedded Linux, RTOS, Process \& Memory Management. * Strong skills in analyzing performance of software/hardware solutions on multi\-core architectures; understanding of multi\-core architecture fundamentals (core, cache, memory, bus, PCIe, etc.). * Experience using debugging tools such as JTAG, Trace32, and oscilloscope/logic analyzer. * Exposure to Automotive, ADAS, and Robotics product development. * Exposure to Hypervisors and Virtualization. * Experience working with Qualcomm Snapdragon Automotive, ADAS, Robotics, Camera ISP, or Multimedia software stacks. * Familiarity with Computer Vision, OpenCV, AI/ML frameworks, and image\-processing applications for automotive and robotics systems. Qualcomm is an equal opportunity employer. If you are an individual with a disability and need an accommodation during the application/hiring process, rest assured that Qualcomm is committed to providing an accessible process. You may e\-mail disability\-accomodations@qualcomm.com or call Qualcomm's toll\-free number found here . (Keep in mind that this email address is used to provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities. We will not respond here to requests for updates on applications or resume inquiries). **To all Staffing and Recruiting Agencies** : Our Careers Site is only for individuals seeking a job at Qualcomm. Staffing and recruiting agencies and individuals being represented by an agency are not authorized to use this site or to submit profiles, applications or resumes, and any such submissions will be considered unsolicited. Qualcomm does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Qualcomm employees or any other company location. Qualcomm is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/applications. **EEO Employer: Qualcomm is an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, Veteran status, or any other protected classification.** Qualcomm expects its employees to abide by all applicable policies and procedures, including but not limited to security and other requirements regarding protection of Company confidential information and other confidential and/or proprietary information, to the extent those requirements are permissible under applicable law. **Pay range** **and Other Compensation \& Benefits** **:** $125,400\.00 \- $188,200\.00 The above pay scale reflects the broad, minimum to maximum, pay scale for this job code for the location for which it has been posted. Even more importantly, please note that salary is only one component of total compensation at Qualcomm. We also offer a competitive annual discretionary bonus program and opportunity for annual RSU grants (employees on sales\-incentive plans are not eligible for our annual bonus). In addition, our highly competitive benefits package is designed to support your success at work, at home, and at play. Your recruiter will be happy to discuss all that Qualcomm has to offer – and you can review more details about our US benefits at this link . If you would like more information about this role, please contact Qualcomm Careers .

jobs.description: **About the Opportunity** We are looking for a versatile, highly skilled technical powerhouse who thrives across the entire computing stack—from physical assembly to full\-scale software and application development. This role is perfect for a multi\-talented developer, engineer, and tech expert who is equally comfortable building high\-end computers, setting up network servers, launching websites, and writing custom applications. This position begins as a temporary, part\-time role on an as\-needed basis, starting with immediate hands\-on milestones. All components, professional tools, and software licenses are provided. an ongoing pipeline of advanced app development and systems engineering work. **Scope of Work \& Project Details** * **Hardware \& Infrastructure:** Complete hardware assembly of a custom PC from scratch (requiring immaculate cable management), followed by configuring a home server network and network\-attached storage (NAS) / home lab environments. * **App \& Software Development:** Build new software applications from scratch and actively modify, optimize, or debug existing app codebases to add new features. * **Web Engineering:** Create, deploy, and maintain functional websites, handling both backend logic and frontend layouts. * **Systems Deployment:** Manage secure operating system installations, driver configurations, local network mapping, and automated infrastructure scripts. **Required Technical Skills \& Traits** * **Application \& Web Development:** Proven experience developing functional apps, modifying software code, and creating websites. * **Hardware Craftsmanship:** Hands\-on experience building custom computers with elite attention to detail, component safety, and clean aesthetics. * **Server \& Network Administration:** Prior experience setting up home labs, managing network routing, and establishing secure local storage. * **Work Style:** Exceptionally reliable, organized, highly careful with expensive hardware components, and able to experience with custom PC builds, server setups, or physical hardware troubleshooting. * Your current academic or professional availability over the coming weeks near the University of Houston campus. Pay: From $20\.00 per hour Work Location: Hybrid remote in Houston, TX 77204

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Red Platform
jobs.description: Healthcare is complex. We're here to change that. RVO Health is a health technology company on a mission to make health easier to navigate, more accessible, and more affordable for everyone. Here, you'll help over 40 million people every month, with a team that genuinely cares about the work and each other. **AT A GLANCE** --------------- The Software Engineer is a crucial role within our organization, requiring work in various capacities and adaptation to different work arrangements based on the needs set by the business. The successful candidate will be responsible for fulfilling their job duties in the following work situations: **Where You'll Be** ------------------- **Location: Charlotte Metro Area (Fort Mill, SC) \| Hybrid** We believe great collaboration happens when we're together, solving problems, learning from each other, and connecting as a team. That's why we're in our offices Tuesday through Thursday each week. You are welcome to work remotely Mondays and Fridays if you wish. *Office Address: 1101 Red Ventures Dr Fort Mill, SC 29707* **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Lead the end\-to\-end design, development, and implementation of sophisticated software applications and systems aligned with business goals. * Collaborate closely with stakeholders including product managers, designers, and other engineers to gather requirements and translate them into robust technical designs and solutions. * Write high\-quality, efficient, maintainable, and scalable code adhering to best practices and company standards. * Debug, analyze, and resolve complex software defects and performance bottlenecks to ensure optimal system reliability and user experience. * Conduct comprehensive testing and validation including unit, integration, and performance testing to guarantee software quality. * Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior and mid\-level engineers, fostering professional growth and knowledge sharing. * Perform thorough code reviews to maintain high code quality, enforce coding standards, and promote best practices across the team. * Continuously improve software development processes, tools, and methodologies. * Stay updated on emerging technologies, frameworks, and industry trends to inform technology strategy and innovation. * Collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams to meet project deadlines and deliverables. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- **Required:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, a related field; or equivalent experience * 3\+ years experience in software development, with a focus on large\-scale applications. * 3\+ years of expert level experience with Go and hands\-on experience with other programming languages such as Python and Typescript * 2\+ years of experience with event driven architecture such as Kafka; Datastores such as Postgres, Dynamo, Nebula; as well as working knowledge of CI/CD and Infrastructure as code (IaC) * Deep understanding of software development methodologies and best practices. * Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills. Even stronger interpersonal and communication skills. * Experience with software testing. * Experience using AI for code generation. **Preferred:** * Master's degree in computer science, software engineering, a related field, or equivalent experience. * Previous experience with healthcare regulations and compliance requirements. * Previous experience with Customer Data Platforms * Full stack programming experience using modern technologies including Node.js \+ TypeScript, RBDs such as Postgres, REST APIs, NoSQL, etc. **Pursuant to various state Fair Pay Acts, below is a summary of compensation elements for this role at the company. The following benefits are provided by RVO Health, subject to eligibility requirements.** * Starting Salary: $97,000 \- $120,000\* + *Note actual salary is based on geographic location, qualifications and experience* * Health Insurance Coverage (medical, dental, and vision) * Life Insurance * Short and Long\-Term Disability Insurance * Flexible Spending Accounts * Paid Time Off * Holiday Pay * 401(k) with match * Employee Assistance Program * Paid Parental Bonding Benefit Program * Pharmacy Benefits * Income Protection Plans * Pet Services Plans * Mental Health Support * Wellness Coaching * HSA\- Health Savings Account * Commuter Benefits * Gym \& Fitness Center Discount Program **Who We Are:** Founded in 2022, RVO Health is a new healthcare platform of digital media brands, services and technologies focused on building relationships with people throughout their health \& wellness journey. We meet people where they are in their personal health journeys and connect them with both the information and the care they need. RVO Health was created by joining teams from both Red Ventures and UnitedHealth Group's Optum Health. Together we're focused on delivering on our vision of a stronger and healthier world. RVO Health is comprised of Healthline Media (Healthline, Medical News Today, Psych Central, Greatist and Bezzy), Healthgrades, FindCare and PlateJoy; Optum Perks, and the virtual coaching platforms Real Appeal, Wellness Coaching, and QuitForLife. We offer competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits program for full\-time employees, including medical, dental and vision coverage, paid time off, life insurance, disability coverage, employee assistance program, 401(k) plan and a paid parental leave program. RVO Health is an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or any other basis protected by law. Employment at RVO Health is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with disabilities. Should you require a reasonable accommodation to apply or participate in the job application or interview process, please contact accommodations@rvohealth.com. **We do not provide visa sponsorship for this role at this time.** \#LI\-Hybrid RVO Health Privacy Policy: https://rvohealth.com/legal/privacy

jobs.title: Lead Engineer — AI Developer Platform
jobs.description: **Job Description Summary** Note: This position follows our hybrid\-friendly schedule, so you get the best of both worlds – flexibility and collaboration. In office days are 3 days per week (including a Monday or Friday), in our St Petersburg, FL Corporate Office. This role is not eligible for Work Visa sponsorship, either currently or in the future. **Job Description** **About the Role:** We are seeking a hands\-on Lead Engineer to drive the technical vision and function as a process engineer utilizing our internal AI systems, platforms, and frameworks. Already adopted by multiple engineering teams, our internal platform is expanding across the firm. We are focused on improving scalability, reliability, ease of adoption, and flexibility as AI technologies rapidly evolve. This role will lead the platform architecture, establish engineering standards, and deliver high\-impact technical solutions. You will spend your time coding, reviewing designs and pull requests, solving complex technical challenges, supporting production environments, and shaping long\-term platform strategy. This is an ideal opportunity for a technical leader passionate about building tools that enable engineers to work smarter and faster. **What You'll Do:** Set the Technical Direction * Define and evolve the platform architecture, ensuring scalability, extensibility, and maintainability. * Design solutions that remain compatible across multiple AI providers, coding tools, and operating systems. Establish engineering patterns and best practices for the broader team. * Deliver High\-Impact Solutions Lead and contribute directly to key platform initiatives, including: * Streamlining platform installation and onboarding across Windows and macOS. * Building telemetry and reporting capabilities to provide visibility into AI usage, costs, and adoption. * Developing secure, sandboxed environments for AI\-assisted development and testing. Expanding AI agent capabilities, enterprise integrations, and business\-domain knowledge resources. * Maintain AI Platform Agility * Continuously assess emerging AI models, developer tools, and orchestration technologies. * Recommend and implement new capabilities while avoiding unnecessary vendor dependency. Partner with product leadership to evaluate capabilities and define future roadmap priorities. * Raise the Engineering Bar * Ensure high standards for code quality, testing, reliability, and operational excellence. * Lead code reviews and architectural reviews for core platform components. Support incident response and continuous platform improvements. * Lead Through Influence * Provide technical leadership across a distributed contributor model. * Facilitate design reviews, solve complex technical challenges, and mentor engineers. Foster collaboration across engineering teams contributing to the platform. * Partner with Platform Users * Engage regularly with engineering teams using the platform. * Gather feedback, identify pain points, and translate insights into platform enhancements. Collaborate with stakeholders to prioritize investments and improve developer experience. * **What You Bring:** * 8\+ years of senior engineering experience building enterprise\-grade software that other engineers or business teams depend on — internal platforms, large\-scale services, developer tooling, SDKs, or similar systems. * At least 2 years of hands\-on experience building solutions powered by large language models (LLMs) or AI agent frameworks. * Prior experience building or extending agentic coding tools like Claude Code or OpenAI Codex, and IDEs like VS Code — or comparable tools. * Strong proficiency in Python and working knowledge of Node.js and TypeScript. * Direct experience designing or substantially extending integrations between AI coding tools and external systems (any of: Model Context Protocol servers, custom LangChain/LangGraph tools, Copilot extensions, JetBrains AI plugins, Cursor / Continue / Aider integrations). * A working point of view on at least one production AI coding tool — enough to reason intelligently about prompt design, tool\-use loops, context window economics, and where these systems tend to fail. * Experience with more than one LLM provider and a clear position on building provider\-agnostic abstractions so the platform isn't trapped on a single vendor's roadmap. * Cross\-platform engineering experience across Windows, macOS, and Linux, including the realities of installers, path handling, shells, and credential storage on each. * Background in one or more of the technology stacks our application teams use (Python, Java/Spring, Angular, React, .NET, Oracle, Redshift, SQL Server) — enough to be credible reviewing stack\-specific contributions. * A track record of shipping infrastructure that other engineers depend on every day, and being accountable when it breaks. * Comfort working in a regulated environment — financial services — with the discipline that implies around secrets, data classification, change management, and auditability, and practical experience with the security and data\-protection concerns specific to LLM systems: prompt\-injection mitigation, secret\-leak prevention through prompts and tool outputs, PII redaction, and trust boundaries around model output. * Deep, hands\-on knowledge of the software development lifecycle and modern engineering methodologies — agile, trunk\-based development, code review, CI/CD, and observability\-driven operations — and experience operating in a mature CI/CD and observability environment (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jenkins, SonarQube, and a log or APM platform such as Splunk, Datadog, or Dynatrace). * Demonstrated technical leadership without direct authority — you have written architecture decision records that drove real consensus, presented technical direction to senior engineering and business leadership, and mentored other senior engineers (not just juniors) into stronger work. * Prior work on agent evaluation — golden task sets, regression suites, judge models, or other ways of measuring whether an AI workflow is actually getting better over time. Active engagement with the developer\-tools, AI agents, or AI/ML open\-source community — substantive contributions, conference talks, or published writing that demonstrates depth and a public point of view. * **Licenses/Certifications:** * None required. **Education** Bachelor’s \- Completed: Computer and Information Science, High School (HS) \- Completed (Required) **Work Experience** General Experience \- 3 to 6 years **Certifications** **Travel** Less than 25% **Workstyle** Hybrid The total compensation for this position includes base salary or wages, and may include components such as additional compensation (cash or equity), discretionary bonuses, or commissions. This position is eligible for a benefits package that may include medical, dental, and vision; life insurance; critical illness insurance and accident insurance; disability benefits; retirement savings; paid time off (including vacation, holidays, and sick leave); and parental leave. Eligibility for benefits and specific offerings may vary based on position and employment status. To view more details of the benefits offered, visit Myrjbenefits.com. We expect our associates at all levels to: * Grow professionally and inspire others to do the same * Work with and through others to achieve desired outcomes * Make prompt, pragmatic choices and act with the client in mind * Take ownership and hold themselves and others accountable for delivering results that matter * Contribute to the continuous evolution of the firm At Raymond James – as part of our people\-first culture, we honor, value, and respect the uniqueness, experiences, and backgrounds of all of our Associates. When associates bring their best authentic selves, our organization, clients, and communities thrive. The Company is an equal opportunity employer and makes all employment decisions on the basis of merit and business needs. \#LI\-NM1

This role requires regular on\-site work in either Houston, TX or Glen Burnie, MD. in a cross\-functional team on the design, development, manufacture, test, and on\-orbit operation of flight and ground support software for the lunar portfolio. * Real\-time flight software You’ll Need:** **Required Skills \& Experience** * MS in Aerospace Engineering or related field with 5\+ years of experience preferred * Experience with C, C\+\+, and Python * Experience with adherence, and realized savings. **Key involvement in Decision Making process:** * People management: Talent selection,  leadership, contractor management, financial stewardship, and cross\-functional program leadership. * Working knowledge of cGMP, data integrity, change control, deviations and CAPAs, commissioning and qualification, maintenance work management, permits, energy isolation, and LOTO. * Ability to communicate technical risk, sustainability performance, priorities, decisions, and investment needs clearly to technical teams and site leadership. * Experience in biopharmaceutical, pharmaceutical, or other highly regulated manufacturing, including utility support for biologics or single\-use manufacturing operations. * Experience with clean utilities such as purified water, water\-for\-injection, clean steam, process gases, and associated generation, storage, distribution, sanitization, monitoring, and control systems. * Knowledge of industrial utilities, including electrical distribution, natural gas, steam, chilled water, cooling water, compressed air, HVAC interfaces, wastewater, and utility metering. * Experience developing decarbonization, energy, water, waste, or biodiversity roadmaps and delivering projects from feasibility through benefits verification. * Experience with CMMS/EAM, BMS, SCADA or automation platforms, historian and ISO 14001 experience, or an equivalent professional credential. **Expected Skills:** * Strategic thinking and utility lifecycle planning * Clean utility technical leadership * cGMP compliance and healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender\-neutral parental leave. * Shape the future of medicine and vaccine delivery with cutting\-edge technology, ensuring seamless launches and a resilient global supply. * Power industry\-leading performance by leveraging digital, data, and AI\-driven innovation at speed and scale * Transform lives worldwide by delivering life\-changing treatments anywhere, anytime. Create dashboards, reports, and analytical tools that improve business visibility and decision\-making. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Data Platform — Data Trust & AI Context
jobs.description: **Employee Applicant Privacy Notice** **Who we are:** Shape a brighter financial future with us. Together with our members, we're changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance. We're a next\-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile\-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we're at the forefront. We're proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people's lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. **Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.** **The Role:** SoFi's ability to deliver trusted member experiences, manage risk, meet regulatory obligations, and scale enterprise AI depends on data that is reliable, governed, understandable, and available when it is needed. As a Principal Software Engineer in the Data Platform Group, you will provide hands\-on technical leadership within the Data Trust pillar. Working alongside the Senior Manager and other Principal Engineers, you will design, build, and operate the distributed systems and reusable platform primitives that make data quality, privacy, metadata, lineage, access, and reliability enforceable by construction across the enterprise. Your work will span three connected areas: establishing shared Data Trust capabilities, raising the reliability of data across batch and low\-latency environments, and applying those foundations to a semantic context layer for trusted analytics and AI. By making business meaning, ownership, provenance, quality, freshness, and access policies machine\-readable, you will help end users and AI systems work from consistent, governed context. This is an individual contributor role with broad organizational impact. You will personally contribute code, prototypes, architecture, and operational improvements while setting technical direction across engineering, data, security, privacy, legal, risk, analytics, and product teams. You will build reusable enterprise capabilities and reference patterns that partner teams can adopt, while domain teams retain ownership of their application\-specific use cases and serving paths. **What you will own:** * **Data Trust architecture and strategy:** Define and execute the technical direction for data contracts, metadata and catalog modernization, lineage, data quality, privacy, and access controls. Translate business, regulatory, and engineering requirements into a coherent platform strategy and sequence investments for long\-term impact. * **Declarative enforcement primitives:** Build platform services, libraries, and reference patterns that make contracts, quality rules, privacy policies, and access requirements versioned, testable, observable, and automatically enforceable across the data lifecycle. * **Semantic context for analytics and AI:** Establish the technical foundations for a governed semantic context layer that connects business definitions, metadata, lineage, ownership, quality, freshness, and access policy. Enable trusted discovery, analytics, and AI\-assisted or agentic experiences without turning this role into a model\-development function. * **Reliability across batch and streaming data:** Lead the evolution of Data Trust capabilities across Snowflake, AWS data services, Kafka\-based ingestion, and other batch or low\-latency environments. Establish explicit SLOs, failure modes, correction paths, and operational ownership, supported by automated detection, containment, remediation, and recovery. * **Mission\-critical operational rigor:** Raise the standard for production data systems through observability, integrity checks, audit evidence, incident learning, and safe automation. Help move the organization from reactive troubleshooting and manual compliance activity toward proactive, measurable control. * **Cross\-organizational technical leadership:** Drive multi\-quarter initiatives across teams and functions, earning alignment on difficult architectural tradeoffs and investment decisions. Serve as a trusted technical authority for Data Trust while mentoring senior engineers, strengthening design and implementation practices, and raising the broader engineering bar. #### **What success looks like in the first 12–18 months:** * A clear enterprise architecture and delivery path exists for Data Trust primitives spanning contracts, metadata, lineage, quality, privacy, and reliability. * Priority data domains have materially improved coverage, observability, SLOs, and automated enforcement. * The platform provides production\-ready patterns for governing data in both batch and low\-latency environments. * Initial semantic context capabilities are operating in production and provide more reliable, traceable context for analytics and AI use cases. * Manual investigation, recurring data failures, and compliance evidence\-gathering are measurably reduced re Expertise:** Deep experience designing horizontal, multi\-tenant platform services that other engineering teams depend on. You understand the failure modes of distributed systems, eventual consistency, and how to balance latency, availability, and cost. * **Data Trust \& Governance Depth:** Practical, battle\-tested experience building or managing components of the modern data trust stack, such as data contracts, metadata catalogs, data quality frameworks, end\-to\-end lineage, and fine\-grained access control (RBAC/ABAC). * **Batch \& Streaming Mastery:** Advanced knowledge of modern data ecosystems, specifically Snowflake, Kafka (or similar streaming platforms), and AWS data services. You know how to govern data in motion just as effectively as data at rest. * **Hands\-On Engineering:** Mastery of one or more core programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go) and advanced SQL. You are comfortable writing production\-grade code, conducting rigorous code reviews, and building declarative infrastructure (Terraform, CI/CD). * **Cross\-Organizational Leadership:** A history of successfully driving multi\-team, cross\-functional technical initiatives. You know how to build consensus across Engineering, Security, Privacy, and Product teams, translating compliance and risk requirements into frictionless engineering primitives. * **Operational Rigor:** Experience managing Tier\-0/mission\-critical infrastructure. You build systems with a "trust but verify" mindset—relying on automated testing, drift detection, and circuit breakers rather than manual processes. **Nice to have:** * **FinTech / Regulated Industry Experience:** Prior experience operating in a highly regulated environment where auditability, data privacy (CCPA/GDPR), and data integrity are architectural requirements, not afterthoughts. * **AI Infrastructure Exposure:** Experience building semantic layers, knowledge graphs, or context engines that ground LLMs and autonomous agents in governed enterprise data. * **Open Source Contributions:** Contributions to relevant open\-source data or metadata projects (e.g., Apache Iceberg, OpenMetadata, DataHub, Amundsen). **Compensation and Benefits** The base pay range for this role is listed below.
