jobs.description: **Employee Applicant Privacy Notice** **Who we are:** Shape a brighter financial future with us. Together with our members, we're changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance. We're a next\-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile\-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we're at the forefront. We're proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people's lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. **Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.** **The Role:** SoFi's ability to deliver trusted member experiences, manage risk, meet regulatory obligations, and scale enterprise AI depends on data that is reliable, governed, understandable, and available when it is needed. As a Principal Software Engineer in the Data Platform Group, you will provide hands\-on technical leadership within the Data Trust pillar. Working alongside the Senior Manager and other Principal Engineers, you will design, build, and operate the distributed systems and reusable platform primitives that make data quality, privacy, metadata, lineage, access, and reliability enforceable by construction across the enterprise. Your work will span three connected areas: establishing shared Data Trust capabilities, raising the reliability of data across batch and low\-latency environments, and applying those foundations to a semantic context layer for trusted analytics and AI. By making business meaning, ownership, provenance, quality, freshness, and access policies machine\-readable, you will help end users and AI systems work from consistent, governed context. This is an individual contributor role with broad organizational impact. You will personally contribute code, prototypes, architecture, and operational improvements while setting technical direction across engineering, data, security, privacy, legal, risk, analytics, and product teams. You will build reusable enterprise capabilities and reference patterns that partner teams can adopt, while domain teams retain ownership of their application\-specific use cases and serving paths. **What you will own:** * **Data Trust architecture and strategy:** Define and execute the technical direction for data contracts, metadata and catalog modernization, lineage, data quality, privacy, and access controls. Translate business, regulatory, and engineering requirements into a coherent platform strategy and sequence investments for long\-term impact. * **Declarative enforcement primitives:** Build platform services, libraries, and reference patterns that make contracts, quality rules, privacy policies, and access requirements versioned, testable, observable, and automatically enforceable across the data lifecycle. * **Semantic context for analytics and AI:** Establish the technical foundations for a governed semantic context layer that connects business definitions, metadata, lineage, ownership, quality, freshness, and access policy. Enable trusted discovery, analytics, and AI\-assisted or agentic experiences without turning this role into a model\-development function. * **Reliability across batch and streaming data:** Lead the evolution of Data Trust capabilities across Snowflake, AWS data services, Kafka\-based ingestion, and other batch or low\-latency environments. Establish explicit SLOs, failure modes, correction paths, and operational ownership, supported by automated detection, containment, remediation, and recovery. * **Mission\-critical operational rigor:** Raise the standard for production data systems through observability, integrity checks, audit evidence, incident learning, and safe automation. Help move the organization from reactive troubleshooting and manual compliance activity toward proactive, measurable control. * **Cross\-organizational technical leadership:** Drive multi\-quarter initiatives across teams and functions, earning alignment on difficult architectural tradeoffs and investment decisions. Serve as a trusted technical authority for Data Trust while mentoring senior engineers, strengthening design and implementation practices, and raising the broader engineering bar. #### **What success looks like in the first 12–18 months:** * A clear enterprise architecture and delivery path exists for Data Trust primitives spanning contracts, metadata, lineage, quality, privacy, and reliability. * Priority data domains have materially improved coverage, observability, SLOs, and automated enforcement. * The platform provides production\-ready patterns for governing data in both batch and low\-latency environments. * Initial semantic context capabilities are operating in production and provide more reliable, traceable context for analytics and AI use cases. * Manual investigation, recurring data failures, and compliance evidence\-gathering are measurably reduced re Expertise:** Deep experience designing horizontal, multi\-tenant platform services that other engineering teams depend on. You understand the failure modes of distributed systems, eventual consistency, and how to balance latency, availability, and cost. * **Data Trust \& Governance Depth:** Practical, battle\-tested experience building or managing components of the modern data trust stack, such as data contracts, metadata catalogs, data quality frameworks, end\-to\-end lineage, and fine\-grained access control (RBAC/ABAC). * **Batch \& Streaming Mastery:** Advanced knowledge of modern data ecosystems, specifically Snowflake, Kafka (or similar streaming platforms), and AWS data services. You know how to govern data in motion just as effectively as data at rest. * **Hands\-On Engineering:** Mastery of one or more core programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go) and advanced SQL. You are comfortable writing production\-grade code, conducting rigorous code reviews, and building declarative infrastructure (Terraform, CI/CD). * **Cross\-Organizational Leadership:** A history of successfully driving multi\-team, cross\-functional technical initiatives. You know how to build consensus across Engineering, Security, Privacy, and Product teams, translating compliance and risk requirements into frictionless engineering primitives. * **Operational Rigor:** Experience managing Tier\-0/mission\-critical infrastructure. You build systems with a "trust but verify" mindset—relying on automated testing, drift detection, and circuit breakers rather than manual processes. **Nice to have:** * **FinTech / Regulated Industry Experience:** Prior experience operating in a highly regulated environment where auditability, data privacy (CCPA/GDPR), and data integrity are architectural requirements, not afterthoughts. * **AI Infrastructure Exposure:** Experience building semantic layers, knowledge graphs, or context engines that ground LLMs and autonomous agents in governed enterprise data. * **Open Source Contributions:** Contributions to relevant open\-source data or metadata projects (e.g., Apache Iceberg, OpenMetadata, DataHub, Amundsen). **Compensation and Benefits** The base pay range for this role is listed below. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: The Software Engineer is a member of Special\-Lite’s IT Delivery team, responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the software that allows customers and sales teams to configure, visualize, and price Special\-Lite products. For approximately the first six months, the role will focus on developing and maintaining our custom product extension in Configura’s CET Designer, written in CM (Configura’s proprietary object\-oriented language), which represents products in 2D and 3D with costing, business logic, and error prevention. As Special\-Lite implements Tacton as its next CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) platform, the role will expand to building and maintaining design automation that connects Tacton to Autodesk Inventor, coding parametric 3D models and drawings so they are generated automatically from configured products. #### **Essential Functions:** * Design, develop, test, and deploy enhancements to SpecialLite’s CET Designer extension, including products represented in 2D and/or 3D with costing, business logic, and error prevention. * Maintain and improve the existing CET code base, ensuring reliability, accuracy, and user satisfaction. * Develop and maintain Autodesk Inventor addins (VB.NET/C\#) that use the Inventor API to drive parametric 3D models and production drawings from Tacton CPQ configurations. * Build and maintain automationready Inventor models, rebuilding flexible/parametric components (e.g., frames of variable height) and reusing static components where appropriate. * Support integrations between Tacton CPQ, Autodesk Inventor, and other business systems using REST APIs and XML/JSON data exchange. * Inherit, understand, and extend code written by others, including thirdparty implementation partners, and write clean, documented, maintainable code for future developers. * Collaborate with sales, engineering, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions. * Manage source code and automation assets under version control (Git; Autodesk Vault for CAD assets) and track work in Jira as part of an Agile team. * Troubleshoot and resolve application issues, escalating when necessary. * Create documentation and assist with user training for supported applications. * Apply best practices in security, maintainability, and performance, and contribute toward continuous improvement in both code and process. #### **Position Requirements:** * Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or equivalent experience. * Must have experience in C\#, VB.NET, C\+\+, Java or any other objectoriented language. * Excellent grasp of objectoriented concepts and experience in using them to build applications. * Willingness to learn proprietary languages and platforms, including Configura’s CM language and CET Designer. * Experience using source control (such as Git) and tasktracking tools (such as Jira). * Basic familiarity with REST APIs and XML/JSON data formats. * Must be passionate about programming. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Excellent analytical and problemsolving skills. * Must be a selfstarter and have the ability to work independently on diverse problems. * Must have the ability to gather requirements, consider and explore multiple approaches and suggest effective solutions. #### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with the Autodesk Inventor API, including part/assembly modeling and drawing automation, addin development, or iLogic. * Handson Autodesk Inventor modeling experience, including parametric part and assembly modeling. * NET development experience, particularly VB.NET or C\#, using Visual Studio. * Experience with Configura CET Designer and/or the CM programming language. * Experience with CPQ or product configuration platforms, especially Tacton. * Experience with Autodesk Vault or other PDM systems. * Understanding of 3D geometry and coordinate systems. * Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment. #### **Physical Requirements:** * Frequently required to use hands and fingers to handle, feel or operate office equipment, and reach with hands and arms. * Frequently required to talk and hear. * Frequently required to sit for long periods of time. * Required to occasionally stand and walk. * Occasionally required to lift, push, pull and/or move up to 10pounds. * Specific vision abilities required include: close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. Work Location: On\-site or Hybrid – Decatur, MI #### **Non\-Essential Functions:** * Performs other related duties, as assigned. #### **Work Environment:** * Safety glasses are required on the production floor at all times. * Hearing protection is required in designated areas. * Occasionally subject to hazards including a variety of physical conditions, such as proximity to moving mechanical parts, moving vehicles, electric current, and exposure to heat and chemicals. * Occasionally subject to conditions including one or more of the following that affect the respiratory system or the skin: fumes, odors, dust, mists, or poor ventilation. * Occasionally exposed to cold, hot, wet and/or humid shop conditions. #### **Benefits at Special\-Lite:** A competitive salary and opportunities to advance in your career are just the beginning. Special\-Lite offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you and your family, including: * Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance * ShortTerm and LongTerm Disability Coverage * 401(k) with Company Match * Performance and Holiday Bonuses * Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) * Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance and Professional Development Support * Parental Leave * Paid Vacation, Sick Time, and Holidays #### **About Special\-Lite** We manufacture custom door, frame, and interior solutions for new construction and retrofit projects across educational, commercial, institutional, industrial, and municipal applications—combining hands\-on craftsmanship with advanced technology to deliver exceptional quality, performance, and reliability. Built to last in high usage and challenging environments, our high\-quality and made\-to\-order solutions are unique in the industry. The products we build welcome, protect, and enhance spaces across the U.S. and beyond. You would probably recognize more than a few of our famous customers. As one of the largest volume producers of commercial FRP doors, you may have even already walked through one of our solutions. For more than 55 years, we have been driven to grow through relationships as strong as our products. We are committed to the success of our employees, our customers, and our communities. We stand behind our products with passion and excellent customer service. People. Passion. Performance. Visit special\-lite.com to learn more. We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, disability, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, sexual orientation, age, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. #### **About Special\-Lite, Inc.** We don’t just build doors—we build careers. For more than 50 years, we’ve been a leader in manufacturing and engineering architectural products for new construction and replacement installations. Our commercial entrance systems, restroom partitions, and interior products feature a unique blend of hands\-on craftsmanship, cutting\-edge technology, customization, and innovative design. The result? Products built to last and a life\-long career to match. When you join Special\-Lite, you become part of a team that values quality, creativity, and personal commitment. We believe in doing things the right way, not the easy way, and we take pride in building products that help make spaces safer, easier to maintain, more productive, healthier, and inspiring.

This role works closely with project managers, contractors, and IT staff to gather information, coordinate meetings, and keep project details up to date. The position helps new project requests get properly scoped and routed through the department’s governance process. jobs.description: ***The nonpartisan Legislative Affairs Agency provides objective, accurate, and timely services and products to the Alaska Legislature and Alaskans to support and inform policy making, facilitate public access to the legislative process, and preserve the legislative institution.*** ***Working in seamless partnership across sections, staff approach their tasks with professionalism, grace, and courtesy in supporting the challenging and vital work of the legislative branch.*** **GENERAL DESCRIPTION:** Legislative Affairs Agency (LAA) \- Information Technology \- Networking Team is a cross\-trained team of four; two junior and two senior positions. This Network Specialist position has the potential to flex up to a senior position. Tasks include administering the local area network (LAN) for the Legislative Affairs Agency and Alaska State Legislature. They will learn to engineer, build, deploy, and monitor performance of the LAN; from hardware to software support for routers, servers, and network attached devices. This position will also provide tier 2 support services for the LAA Help Desk. **EXAMPLES OF DUTIES:** * Design and build network servers utilizing current technologies and best practice standards. LAA uses a mix of Windows and Linux servers. * Take secondary or sometimes primary lead and cross train on a mix of services: Exchange, Cloud Services, Hyper\-V clusters, enterprise wireless, firewalls, switches, Remote Access, Microsoft Office E5 Productivity Suite, and the potential for others with approval and research. * Provide business needs analysis, research, and provide recommendations to be brought forward to the Internet Technology Subcommittee. * Monitor and review network performance; resolve detected issues. * Review security logs to fine tune and correct the network. * Troubleshoot LAA Help Desk complex trouble call or tickets and provide in\-person customer service where appropriate. * Research, review, and implement industry best security practices in all environments of the network: physical, logical, production, and test. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:** * Hands\-on network infrastructure building from the ground up – planning and designing network growth \-spec’ing devices, purchasing equipment, installing, and configuring network servers by utilizing current technologies and best practice standards. jobs.title: Senior IT Application Developer (DPS #59936)
jobs.description: Posting Details The New Mexico Department of Public Safety (DPS) is looking for an experienced application developer with knowledge and abilities in .Net Core and Angular frameworks interfacing with Oracle and Microsoft SQL servers, including APIs and Database stored procedures. DPS houses the New Mexico State Police (NMSP) and provides many services to the entire law enforcement community throughout New Mexico. DPS is the FBI designated Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) Systems Agency (CSA) for the State of New Mexico. As such, DPS is the exclusive entity in New Mexico that provides access to CJIS for all federal, state, local and tribal law enforcement agencies. The DPS ITD provides a portfolio of services to the entire law enforcement community in New Mexico in addition to being the key technology partner of NMSP and the other statewide law enforcement support divisions of DPS. The ITD Leadership Team is committed to helping everyone on our team grow professionally and personally through training, mentor ship, and challenging work assignments. DPS has one of the most complex networks in the State of New Mexico consisting of over 50 physical offices including the DPS headquarters, the NM Law Enforcement Academy, three forensic labs, three 911 communications / dispatch centers, 12 NMSP district offices, and a significant number of permanent and transitory sub\-stations in key locations throughout the state including the Governor's Mansion. In addition to these physical locations, the network consists of 650 NMSP patrol units, the NMSP helicopter and several mobile command centers. The network is accessed 24 hours per day, 7 days per week with no tolerance for downtime by DPS civilian staff, NMSP, and all federal, state, local and tribal law enforcement agencies (LEAs) to receive mission\-critical CJIS and to access many other systems. These systems are essential to law enforcement statewide. DPS ITD provides the time, resources and encouragement for its staff to participate in ongoing training and mentor ship. We are looking for employees who want to grow their skills, develop as individuals, be reliable teammates and enjoy challenging work assignments. The significant number of our employees who have been promoted into higher positions is evidence of our success. ITD enjoys a close working relationship with the NMSP, law enforcement agencies across New Mexico and our federal partners such as the FBI and the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA). ITD and its employees are valued by the leadership of DPS as an essential part of the public safety services in New Mexico. If you become a member of the DPS ITD family, you will quickly become integrated into the law enforcement community statewide. Why does the job exist? This position is integral in supporting one of the most complex organizations in the State of New Mexico. DPS houses many in\-house and vendor supported applications with back\-end Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server databases that support DPS's mission. The IT Application Developer III exists to ensure that these applications remain available 24/7/365 and perform in a manner that allows to be available to criminal justice agencies. This position may require duties for occasional nights and weekends. How does it get done? **The Senior IT Application Developer works on the functions:** * Work on Full Software Development Life cycle that analyzes system requirements and collaborate with stake holders * Design, develop, code, unit test, and deploy complex business applications independently * Accountable for application security, validation, evaluation, and implementation * Develop .Net Core, Angular, Full stack (backend, database, frontend), using Oracle and Microsoft SQL for databases * Manage server\-side logic, database scripts (T SQL), and UI components * Build and optimize MS SQL Server databases, queries, and performance and design and integrate SOAP/RESTful web services between systems for optimal Database and API Integration * Translate functional requirements into technical specs and ensure alignment with business needs * Create and maintain technical documentation, develop, execute, and document test plans, user guides * Assist QA with test execution and regression testing after deployments, provide training or assist in onboarding for new/updated systems * Set up and maintain the development, test, and production environments * Assess clients' needs utilizing a structured requirements process (gathering, analyzing, documenting, and managing changes). Analyze client operations to understand their strengths and weaknesses to uncover opportunities for improvements. * Leads or participates in project planning processes. Creates and shares development estimates and operational requirements to enable accurate planning with realistic timelines. * Writes and communicates business requirements and functional specifications for the implementation of client solutions. * E AD\-style design workshops, coordinate with ITD, business analysts, project managers, and vendors throughout project cycles, participate in release planning, backlog refinement, risk management * Review the physical design of existing systems for optimizing performance by conducting gap analysis, identifying feasible alternative solutions, and assisting in the scope of modifications * Works closely with architects to ensure all systems are in line with ITD's long\-term strategy * Work with both custom\-built systems to support internal DPS operations. * Mentor junior developers and guide them to follow the standards, review technical design specifications developed by junior analysts/developers * May work as a team leader and provide technical direction to other team members * Participate in the identification of continuity/disaster recovery risks and mitigation plans. Assist in the development of disaster recovery plans with service providers * Develop reports and presentations, as needed, engage in long\-term strategic planning * Propose, conceptualize, design, implement, and develop solutions for difficult and complex applications independently. Work on projects that may span a broad range of applications and/or require expertise in multiple technical environments and business areas. * Accountable for application security, validation, evaluation, and implementation. * Develops, executes, and documents test plans. * Sets up and maintains the test environments. * Writes and communicates business requirements and functional specifications for the implementation of client solutions. * Reviews technical design specifications developed by junior analysts/developers. * Document function and changes to new or modify modules, test activities/results, and other areas. * Provide data from repositories that can be used by customers for reports and presentations Who are the customers? DPS including NMSP and all Law Enforcement and criminal justice agencies within the state of New Mexico. Ideal Candidate DPS including NMSP and all Law Enforcement and criminal justice agencies within the state of New Mexico. Minimum Qualification Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems (MIS), Information Technology, Engineering, or similar technical degree and three (3\) years of experience in software programming. Any combination of education from an accredited college or university in a related field and/or direct experience in this occupation totaling seven (7\) years may substitute for the required education and experience. Employment Requirements Employment is subject to a pre\-employment background investigation and fingerprinting in accordance with all terms and conditions of federal and state law, rules and regulations; and is conditional pending results. Continued employment is contingent upon remaining felony free, per Section 5\.12\.1\.1 of the Criminal Justice Information Systems Security Policy. In addition, the selected candidate must possess and maintain a valid driver's license and obtain a Defensive Driving Certificate from the State of New Mexico. Working Conditions This position is classified as essential personnel within the Department of Public Safety and requires on\-site presence to maintain the security and integrity of mission\-critical database systems. Remote work is not available for this position. Work is performed primarily in an office setting with exposure to Visual/Video Display Terminal (VDT) and extensive personal computer usage with extended periods of sitting. The ability to lift to 25 lbs. Some occasional travel may be required. Supplemental Information Do you know what Total Compensation is? Click here **Agency Contact Information:** Anupama Kodali (505\) 637\-9001 Email For information on Statutory Requirements for this position, click the Classification Description link on the job advertisement. Bargaining Unit Position This position is not covered by a collective bargaining agreement.

jobs.description: **Description** --------------- **Our Mission:** Keep Washington Safe and Working! **Our Values:** Customer Focus, One L\&I, Respect, Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, Learning and Growth, Reliability **About the Division and Office** The Information Technology Division is an internal service organization responsible for providing information technology\-based products and services in support of the Department of Labor and Industries (L\&I) agency business priorities. The Maintenance and Operations Program (M\&O), under the Deputy Chief Information Officer, is responsible for the implementation and delivery of the products and services within IT and sustaining operations so that L\&I can complete business as usual with minimal delay or downtime. Within M\&O, the Applications \& Data Management (A\&DM) program is comprised of six development teams organized into multiple Agile teams that deliver advanced web capabilities to citizens and businesses within Washington State. **About the Role** As the **IT Application Development Senior/Specialist**, you will serve as the technical lead for development of Agile product teams, supporting highly visible systems with agency\-wide, state\-wide and multi\-agency impact. If selected for this role, you will use your expertise to mentor and lead staff in the area of .NET technologies, coding standards, and best practices. This position provides strategic planning for custom developed applications and Software as a Service (SaaS) solution to support the programs business functions. **\*This position is primarily seeking candidates who reside in Washington State or are willing to relocate.** **Duties** ---------- **Some of what you’ll do:** * **Technical Lead** + Develop technology roadmaps for highly complex systems that have significant statewide or multi\-agency impact and ensure they align to the agency’s technical architecture. + Design, develop, and implement solutions using Microsoft .NET technologies, Transact SQL, SQL Server databases, Java, Software as a Service (SaaS), and/or Commercial off the Shelf (COTS) so that systems are compliant with agency and industry standards. + Align application architecture, development teams, and technology solutions for the development team. + Lead development efforts to resolve technical issues and production issues quickly. + Coordinate between multiple technical teams to implement and resolve technology issues. + Serve as a technical mentor to other systems developers in resolving highly complex technical issues. + Resolve issues related to environment, platform, software and hardware to ensure timely delivery of software products. * **Application Development** + Develop and maintain software applications, application interfaces and web services. + Serve as technical advisor who is responsible for assisting management in coordinating work items for a number of applications. + Develop, maintain, and enhance applications. + Develop prototypes that enable business functionality. + Lead staff and work independently to analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve technology issues relating to applications, environment, platform, software, or hardware. + Participate in Incident Response and Problem Management teams to identify solutions. * **Application Development \- Process Documentation** + Use the software development lifecycle (SDLC) process to plan, analyze, design, develop, and test applications and application interfaces. + Ensure the delivery of technology solutions by using technology standards and procedures that are in alignment with the technology direction of L\&I. * **Application Development Research** + Research emergent technologies and make determination for use and implementation. And much more. **Qualifications** ------------------ **Required:** * **Ten (10\) years** of recent professional experience: + Developing and enhancing applications using languages and tools such as Visual Studio, C\#, VB.Net, ASP.Net, HTML, CSS, JavaScript XML, JQuery, MWM or MVC, WPF, ADO, WCF, JSON + Writing and accessing database code using T\-SQL, stored procedures, and Entity Framework + Performing unit testing + Applying development standards in a managed environment **AND** * The ability to take action to learn and grow. * The ability to take action to meet the needs of others. ***NOTE:*** *Education may substitute year for year for experience up to four (4\) years for a Bachelor’s degree and up to two (2\) years for an associate’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Programming, or a closely aligned field.* **Desired:** * One (1\) year of experience within an agile scrum team. **Supplemental Information** ---------------------------- **Things You Need To Know** To help you maintain a proper work\-life balance, teleworking is one of the work schedule options for this position. L\&I also offers flexible custom work schedules. We offer hybrid and remote work options, though we’re primarily seeking candidates who live in Washington State or a ook in your email inbox or spam as these invitations are sent by** ***CodeSignal*****.** * For positions requiring travel, you must have a valid unrestricted driver's license and have insurance if driving a privately owned vehicle on state business. * This position is represented bytheWashington Federation of State Employees (WFSE). * Candidates who are offered a job with L\&I must possess work authorization that **does not require sponsorship** by the employer for a visa now or in the future. * The Department of Labor and Industries **does not** participate in **E\-Verify**. Employment eligibility is verified solely through the I\-9 form process described below. * The Department of Labor \& Industries complies with the employment eligibility verification requirements of the federal employment eligibility verification form, I\-9\. The selected candidate must be able to provide proof of identity and eligibility to work in the United States consistent with the requirements of that form on the first day of employment. * Please note: L\&I may use this announcement to fill multiple permanent and/or non\-permanent positions. * Sign up for L\&I Job Alerts to receive information about our newest openings: GovDelivery. **Background Check Notice** Prior to a placement in this position, a background check, including criminal history record will be conducted. Information from your background check will not necessarily preclude employment but will be considered in determining your eligibility to perform the requirements of the position. **Did You Know?** Washington is America's Top State to live, play, and work, according to U.S. News (2021\). Join the L\&I team and enjoy all the Evergreen State has to offer. In addition to offering a positive balance between life and work, L\&I provides one of the most competitive benefits packages in the nation. We also believe your voice matters. We value our employees and their work\-life balance by encouraging flexible schedules. L\&I is a diverse state agency dedicated to the safety and health and security of Washington's 3 million workers. **Veterans Preference** Applicants wishing to claim Veterans Preference should attach to their application a copy of their DD\-214 (Member 4 copy), NGB 22, or signed verification of service letter from the United States Department of Veterans Affairs. Please blackout any personally identifiable data such as Social Security numbers. For further information, contact L\&I’s Jobs@lni.wa.gov. **Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Employer** L\&I employees come from all walks of life. We strive to hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. jobs.title: Senior Hardware Diagnostics Engineer - Infrastructure
jobs.description: **About TensorWave** Our mission is simple: deliver seamless, secure, reliable, and resilient AI compute at scale. We've built a versatile cloud platform that eliminates infrastructure barriers, empowering builders to focus on innovation instead of fighting their stack. Because breakthrough AI should move at the speed of ideas, not infrastructure. **About the Role** We are building and operating large\-scale infrastructure platforms to support high\-performance AI workloads across multiple data centers. Our environment includes GPU\-intensive systems, high\-throughput networking, and rapidly scaling compute clusters. We are looking for a **Senior Hardware Diagnostics Engineer** to own that surface: which versions we run, how we prove a version is safe, and how we push it across a fleet without breaking production. You'll set the bar for what validated hardware means here, build the tooling that enforces it, and be the person we escalate to when a failure doesn't make sense. Firmware is where a lot of our hardest problems live. A BIOS revision changes how a GPU enumerates. A BMC update fixes one thing and breaks telemetry. **What You’ll Do** * Own the firmware lifecycle across BIOS, BMC, NIC, GPU, and storage controllers: version qualification, approved baselines, staged rollout, and rollback * Design and build the validation harness that qualifies a firmware release before it reaches production, including regression and performance comparison between versions * Build automation against Redfish, IPMI, and vendor management APIs so firmware and validation work runs at fleet scale rather than node by node * Define what passing burn\-in means: the test matrix, the thresholds, and the evidence we keep * Make fleet\-wide changes safe and predictable through pre\-flight validation, blast radius control, staged waves, and a rollback path that has actually been tested * Lead root cause analysis on hardware and firmware failures nobody else can reproduce, including PCIe error analysis, sensor and event log forensics, and thermal and power telemetry * Own technical escalation with OEM, ODM, and silicon vendors on firmware defects, and track fixes to closure * Prepare validation and bring\-up capability for next\-generation AMD platforms before the hardware lands * Mentor the diagnostics engineer on the team, and turn recurring findings into runbooks and tooling * Participate in incident response and root cause analysis * Contribute to runbooks, documentation, and operational best practices **Who You Are** **Required Qualifications** * 6\+ years in infrastructure engineering, hardware validation, systems engineering, or a closely related field * Deep hands\-on experience with BMCs and out\-of\-band management — Redfish, IPMI, iDRAC, iLO, or equivalent — including scripted interaction, not clicking through a web UI * Direct firmware experience flashing, qualifying, and troubleshooting BIOS, BMC, and device firmware on enterprise servers, and a clear sense of how badly this can go wrong at scale * Strong Linux systems skills: boot process, kernel and driver behavior, and hardware diagnostics such as {{dmesg}}, {{lspci}}, {{ipmitool}}, SMART, and vendor CLIs * Ability to read low\-level hardware signals: PCIe topology and error output, SEL and sensor data, thermal and power telemetry * Python for automation against REST APIs — Redfish, vendor tooling, and internal systems * A rigorous diagnostic method: you form a hypothesis, design a test that can disprove it, isolate one variable at a time, and document the evidence behind your conclusion * Experience driving hardware issues with vendors through to resolution * Clear technical writing for runbooks, RCAs, and vendor escalations **Preferred Qualifications** * AMD GPU and ROCm experience: {{amd\-smi}}, {{rocm\-smi}}, ROCm Validation Suite * GPU and HPC validation at scale: stress testing, collective communication testing with RCCL or NCCL, node health frameworks * Low\-level bus and firmware work: I2C, SMBus, BMC firmware behavior, Redfish schema extensions * Kernel\-level debugging, including crash dump analysis * Ansible for fleet operations, and Git\-based workflows with CI/CD * NetBox or other DCIM and IPAM tooling as a source of truth * Prior work at an OEM, ODM, or hyperscaler on hardware bring\-up or validation **First Six Months** * By 90 days you'll have qualified and rolled out a firmware release using our existing process — and told us what's wrong with it. By six months, a validation step that used to be manual runs automatically, and we can state our approved firmware baseline across the fleet without anyone checking node by node. **What We Offer** * Stock Options * 100% paid Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance for Employees * Company Health Savings Account Contributions * 100% paid Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance for Employees * Life and Voluntary Supplemental Insurance Options * Other Insurance Options, such as Pet \& Legal Insurance * Various Supplementary Health Benefits, such as discounted Virtual Healthcare Appointments and Serious Illness Support * Flexible Spending Account * 401(k) * Employee Assistance Program * Flexible PTO * Paid Holidays * Parental Leave * Other In\-Office Perks **Equal Employment Opportunity** TensorWave is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected status under applicable law. **Reasonable Accommodations** TensorWave provides reasonable accommodations in accordance with applicable laws. If you require accommodation during the hiring process, please contact accomodations@tensorwave.com. **Employment Eligibility** All offers of employment are contingent upon verification of identity and authorization to work in United States, as required by law. **Background Checks** Where permitted by law, employment may be contingent upon the successful completion of a job\-related background check. **Data Privacy Notice** By submitting an application, you acknowledge that TensorWave may collect, use, and retain your personal information for recruiting and employment\-related purposes in accordance with applicable data privacy laws.

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Lead
jobs.description: **Do You...** 1\. Get genuinely excited about testing campaign changes, analyzing the data, and optimizing for better results? 2\. Think analytically rather than emotionally—trusting data over hunches, and learning just as much from failures as from wins? 3\. Have hands\-on experience managing substantial advertising budgets across multiple platforms (Google Ads, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube)? 4\. Thrive on structured experimentation, documenting results, and systematically applying learnings to future campaigns? 5\. Enjoy collaborating with creative, product, and engineering teams to solve growth problems end\-to\-end? 6\. Have the discipline to work independently in a remote environment, maintain meticulous documentation, and report results weekly? 7\. Combine the mindset of a scientist (hypothesis, testing, measurement) with the execution of an operator (speed, rigor, results)? 8\. Take ownership of outcomes and continuously ask: 'How can we improve this?' **If you answered yes to most of these questions, we would love to talk to you!** **Tasks** --------- **The Role** We are seeking a hands\-on Performance Marketing Lead who thinks like a scientist, operates like an engineer, and reports like a professional. This is an execution\-focused role for someone who loves solving growth problems, testing ideas, and seeing measurable business impact from their work. This is not an administrative role; you'll be in the campaigns daily. You'll set up tracking, optimize targeting, launch experiments, analyze results, and make recommendations backed by data. You'll work closely with creative, product, and analytics teams to continuously improve customer acquisition and campaign efficiency. The ideal candidate combines the empathy of understanding customer experience with the discipline of a process\-driven operator—meticulous on documentation, firm on timelines, rigorous in testing, and persuasive in presenting data\-backed recommendations. **Requirements** ---------------- **What You'll Own** **As Performance Marketing Lead, you will own the following functional areas:** 1\. Daily Paid Media Execution \& Campaign Optimization 2\. Build, launch, and manage campaigns across Google Ads (Search, Display, Performance Max), Microsoft Ads (Bing), YouTube, and TikTok 3\. Monitor campaign health daily: CTR, conversion rates, CPC, CAC, ROAS 4\. Manage budgets to maximize ROI; scale winning campaigns, pause underperformers 5\. Refine audience targeting, keywords, bidding strategies based on performance data 6\. Report campaign performance to CEO weekly with clear insights and recommendations **Structured Experimentation \& Learning Program** 1\. Design and execute 4\-6 structured experiments per week across targeting, keywords, bidding, creative, landing pages, offers 2\. Document 100% of experiment results with hypothesis, results, insights, and business impact 3\. Conduct weekly performance reviews with CEO: analyze results, identify winners, plan next week's tests 4\. Systematically scale winning experiments into ongoing campaigns; retire underperforming approaches **Creative Performance \& Collaboration** 1\. Analyze ad performance by creative asset; identify winners and detect creative fatigue 2\. Provide data\-driven feedback to Creative Strategist on what's working and what to test next 3\. Scale high\-performing creative; test new hooks, messaging, and offers continuously 4\. Work with the creative strategist to maintain the pipeline **Funnel Optimization \& Cross\-Team Collaboration** 1\. Analyze acquisition funnel end\-to\-end: ad click landing page registration paid member 2\. Work with Product/Design on landing page optimization and A/B testing 3\. Collaborate with Engineering on registration flow optimization and conversion improvement 4\. Provide weekly funnel insights to Product, Engineering, and Sales teams **Analytics, Reporting \& Data Integrity** 1\. Set up and maintain accurate tracking via Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, platform native reporting 2\. Track all key metrics: impressions, clicks, conversions, CTR, CPC, CAC, ROAS, cost\-per\-registration 3\. Prepare detailed weekly reports for CEO on revenue, ROAS by channel, CAC trends, and actionable insights 4\. Ensure data integrity and troubleshoot tracking issues across all platforms **Qualifications:** 1\. 5\+ years managing paid digital advertising campaigns at scale 2\. Demonstrated track record of improving measurable business results through paid acquisition (revenue growth, CAC reduction, ROAS improvement) 3\. Strong hands\-on experience with Google Ads (Search, Display, Shopping, Performance Max) 4\. Experience managing campaigns on at least one additional platform: Microsoft Ads (Bing), TikTok, YouTube, or Meta 5\. Proven ability to set up tracking (Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager) and analyze marketing funnel metrics 6\. Experience with A/B testing, experimentation, and landing page optimization 7\. Strong analytical and quantitative skills; comfortable analyzing data and making evidence\-based decisions 8\. Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain complex concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences 9\. Comfortable working independently in a remote environment with minimal supervision 10\. Highly organized, meticulous with documentation, and disciplined about process **Benefits** ------------ **What We're Looking For** The ideal candidate: 1\. Thinks analytically rather than emotionally 2\. Takes ownership of outcomes and learns quickly from both successes and failures 3\. Is naturally curious and continuously seeks improvement 4\. Communicates clearly with both technical and non\-technical audiences 5\. Thrives in a fast\-moving environment where testing and optimization never stop **What Success Looks Like** Within your first six months, you will have: 1\. Developed a deep understanding of our customer acquisition funnel 2\. Identified the highest\-impact opportunities to improve paid marketing performance 3\. Established a consistent cadence of structured experimentation 4\. Improved campaign efficiency across multiple advertising channels 5\. Built strong working relationships with Creative, Product, Engineering, and Analytics 6\. Reduced acquisition costs while increasing marketing\-generated revenue 7\. Delivered reporting that helps leadership make better marketing decisions **About Together Light Inc.** Together Light Inc. operates several online businesses serving an international customer base, including Christian Filipina, Filipino Visa, and related travel services. Every month, thousands of prospective customers discover our brands through paid advertising. We believe exceptional marketing is built through disciplined experimentation, rapid learning, and continuous optimization—not opinions. We're looking for a hands\-on Performance Marketing Lead who enjoys solving difficult growth problems, improving advertising performance, and using data to make better decisions. This is an execution\-focused role for someone who loves testing ideas, optimizing campaigns, and continuously improving results.

jobs.title: Principal Civil Engineer
jobs.description: At Toole Design, we're leading the way in creating safer, more connected communities through sustainable multimodal transportation design. We're looking for a Principal Civil Engineer to join our growing team in Silver Spring, MD, someone who's excited to lead impactful transportation projects that reflect our mission and values. **Why You'll Love Working Here** At Toole Design, you'll join an employee\-owned team of engineers, planners, landscape architects, and urban designers who care deeply about the places we shape. Our colleagues have helped write and implement the national guidance that defines our field, including the AASHTO Bike Guide (5th Edition), the forthcoming AASHTO Pedestrian Guide (3rd Edition), the FHWA Guide for Achieving Multimodal Networks, and numerous NCHRP publications. Here, you'll learn directly from those experts. They'll mentor you, invest in your growth, and help you build a career with lasting impact. And because we're employee\-owned, you'll have a direct stake in our shared success.We also offer: * A collaborative, inclusive culture that supports your growth and advancement * A hybrid schedule with shared team days in office (Tuesday\-Thursday) * 8 paid holidays; and at least 16 days of PTO accrual annually * Competitive salary, excellent benefits, and transportation perks: Benefits and Supports * Projects that truly improve lives through safe, comprehensive design rooted in ethics, empathy, and equity * Employee\-ownership, so we all share in the success we build together, and the financial security that comes with it **What You'll Do** As a Principal Civil Engineer at Toole Design, you'll lead the design and delivery of complex, high\-visibility transportation projects, from quick\-build and permanent safety improvements and major trail projects to multimodal capacity expansions featuring innovative intersection treatments and major capital investments. As project manager, you'll own scope, schedule, budget and project financials. You'll guide civil design teams and collaborate with clients and interdisciplinary partners from concept through construction, turning complex challenges into creative, buildable solutions. You'll manage a team of engineers who share your commitment to the work, mentoring junior staff, and supporting each person's growth. As a technical lead, you'll also perform quality control reviews on projects led by others ahead of major milestones, helping ensure every submittal is accurate, complete, and buildable. You'll also lead client meetings and help grow our business across Maryland and the Mid\-Atlantic, building your reputation as a trusted expert at a company that promotes from within. **What You Bring:** * Professional Engineering (P.E.) license in DC, Maryland, or Virginia, or the ability to gain reciprocity within first 6 months of employment * Proven leadership of multi\-discipline infrastructure design and construction teams * 15\+ years of experience in transportation engineering, including at least 10 years managing complex transportation projects * Strong networks and relationships in the Mid\-Atlantic transportation market, including existing clients with the DOT, municipalities, and other consulting firms * Bonus: Design and project management experience in both multimodal transportation and roadway design projects, and you are comfortable presenting on projects and in pursuit interviews. **Join Us. Make an Impact.** We're proud to be an ENR Top 500 design firm with one of the lowest turnover rates in the industry. If you're ready to do meaningful work with a supportive, talented team\-apply today! **We are targeting a salary range of $155,000 to $185,000 for a candidate with a PE.** Candidates with additional experience or qualifications may fall into a difference salary range. **Questions, assistance or accommodations?** Contact HR@tooledesign.com or call 301\-927\-1900, press 5\. At Toole Design, we foster a collaborative culture and welcome people of all backgrounds to help build more inclusive communities. We strongly encourage women and applicants from underrepresented communities, people of color, LGBTQIA\+, immigrants, first\-generation college students/graduates, those with disabilities and people at all the intersections in between, to apply. We're proud that about half our managers are women and we are committed to diverse leadership that reflects the communities we serve. Toole Design is a woman\-owned, equal opportunity employer (EO/AA/VEV/Disabled employer). At Toole Design, people are at the center of everything we do. We bring this value to our recruitment process and do not use AI, automated filtering algorithms, or bot screening. We believe every candidate deserves a thoughtful review, so every application is read by a member of our team. For more information about Toole Design, visit our website and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram, or Facebook.

jobs.title: Sr Embedded Engineer, Vehicle Diagnostics and Monitoring
jobs.description: **About the Role** Uber is launching AV Labs to accelerate the autonomous technology ecosystem. We're building out a high\-velocity team of multi\-disciplinary experts to turn real\-world operations into high\-quality data for our autonomous partners. This team is focused on the hardest problem in AV today: unlocking real\-world, long\-tail driving data. Autonomy is now a data race—and Uber has an edge: We collect rare, real\-world driving data at a scale and capital efficiency no one else can match. Our AV Labs Hardware team is building the next\-generation E/E architecture for our L4 data\-collection vehicle fleet. A fleet only collects useful data when its compute, MCU and sensors work reliably in the car, and when a fault can be found and fixed without a technician on site. You will build the diagnostics, monitoring and dashboards that make fleet health visible, from MCU and SoC firmware to fleet dashboards, and you will bring our hardware to life in vehicles and support the path to production\-line testing. **What the Candidate Will Do** * **Diagnostics and fault management:** Design and implement fault detection, event and DTC handling, UDS and DoIP services, and watchdog supervision across the MCU and the Linux compute platform. * **Monitoring framework:** Design and own the vehicle health monitoring pipeline: collect metrics, logs and fault events from the MCU (CAN, serial or UDP) and the Linux SoC, and send them to a central time\-series and log store using standard tooling (for example Prometheus exporters or OpenTelemetry collectors). * **Deep system observability:** Use eBPF and kernel tracing to observe Linux SoC behavior with low overhead: scheduling, network, driver and camera pipeline latency, and frame or packet drops. * **Dashboards and alerting:** Build dashboards (for example in Grafana) for fleet, vehicle and board health: temperatures, voltages, power state, bus load, time sync offset, camera link status and update status. Define alert rules and thresholds, and route alerts to on\-call. * **Vehicle bring\-up and integration:** Commission the compute, MCU and sensor stack in vehicles (CAN\-FD, Ethernet, power sequencing, GNSS, IMU, cameras) and validate gPTP and PPS timing. * **Field triage and test automation:** Use monitoring data to reproduce and root\-cause vehicle issues with the reliability and software teams, and turn each one into an automated regression test and, where useful, a new dashboard panel or alert. * **Safety and security of diagnostics:** Contribute to safety analysis (FMEA, FMEDA) and implement safety mechanisms. Protect diagnostic access with authenticated sessions and security access. * **Production line support:** Define the diagnostic interfaces and readouts (unit identity, firmware versions, pass or fail data) that end\-of\-line test stations use, with the manufacturing test team. **Basic Qualifications** * **Embedded experience:** Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, with 7\+ years developing embedded software in C/C\+\+ on an RTOS, embedded Linux or bare metal. * **Automotive diagnostics:** Hands\-on experience with UDS (ISO 14229\), DTC handling and ISO\-TP over CAN; DoIP (ISO 13400\) is a plus. * **Vehicle networks and integration:** Strong experience with CAN/CAN\-FD and Automotive Ethernet, tools such as Vector CANoe or similar, oscilloscopes and logic analyzers, and integrating compute platforms and sensors in vehicles. * **Linux observability:** Hands\-on experience debugging system\-level issues on embedded Linux with eBPF\-based tools and profilers (for example bpftrace, bcc or perf). * **Monitoring and visualization:** Experience building monitoring for devices or fleets (for example with Prometheus and Grafana): instrumentation or exporters, dashboards and alert rules, in Python, Go or C/C\+\+. * **Production lifecycle:** Experience taking embedded systems from prototype and third\-party integration to production, ideally in autonomous vehicle, robotics or mission\-critical automotive domains. **Preferred Qualifications** * **Observability stack:** Experience with log and time\-series stacks (for example Loki, ELK, OpenTelemetry, InfluxDB), eBPF\-based observability tools, and fleet\-scale telemetry pipelines (retention, cardinality, cost). * **Security:** Hardware security module (HSM) and secure boot experience, plus secure diagnostics (UDS security access, authenticated sessions, key management). * **AUTOSAR diagnostics:** Configuring Dcm, Dem, FiM, WdgM and E2E modules in an AUTOSAR Classic stack. * **Functional safety:** ISO 26262 (ASIL B through D), ASPICE and MISRA C/C\+\+. * **Production and service tooling:** End\-of\-line test, factory programming or remote service diagnostics tooling. * **Linux and AV compute:** Linux kernel, device tree and Yocto board support, and experience with platforms such as NVIDIA DRIVE or Jetson. For Sunnyvale, CA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $180,000 per year \- USD $200,000 per year. jobs.title: AI Infrastructure & Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: Build the platforms behind enterprise AI Unified Technologies is expanding its AI \& Cloud Solutions practice. We are looking for a hands\-on AI Infrastructure \& Cloud Engineer to build, automate and operate secure AI platforms across Microsoft Azure and private data centers. You will help turn our Azure AI Lab into repeatable customer demonstrations, proofs of concept and managed infrastructure services. Your focus will be cloud infrastructure, CPU\-based Kubernetes services, GPU inference and operational reliability. Work with architecture, presales, security and MSP teams to reproduce platforms across cloud and on\-premises environments. What you will do · Design and operate Azure infrastructure, including compute, networking, AKS, identity, security, storage and monitoring. · Deploy containerized services with Kubernetes, Docker and Helm, using Git\-based delivery and CI/CD practices. · Automate provisioning and configuration with Terraform, Ansible and scripting; maintain reusable deployment templates. · Deploy and support vLLM on Linux GPU systems, including quantized models up to 10B parameters for the lab; troubleshoot NVIDIA drivers, CUDA, memory use and serving performance. · Integrate Open WebUI, enterprise authentication, CPU\-based AI gateways and secrets management; validate secure model\-routing and access policies. · Monitor latency, concurrency, GPU utilization, API errors and infrastructure costs; build alerting, recovery procedures and runbooks. · Prepare architectures that can move from Azure to local Kubernetes and GPU environments on Dell/VMware infrastructure. · Support customer PoCs and demonstrations, document operational handoffs and collaborate with MSP teams on production readiness. What you bring · 5\+ years in infrastructure, cloud, DevOps or platform engineering, including enterprise production environments. · 2\+ years administering Kubernetes and deploying containerized Linux workloads. · Practical Azure experience with virtual networks, VMs, AKS, security and monitoring. · Strong Linux troubleshooting and networking fundamentals, including TLS, DNS, access controls and API connectivity. · Hands\-on automation with Terraform, Ansible, scripting, Git and CI/CD. · Clear documentation, independent problem\-solving and effective collaboration with technical and commercial teams. Experience that will help you stand out · NVIDIA GPUs, CUDA, vLLM, NVIDIA NIM, open\-weight LLMs or inference benchmarking. · Open WebUI, Fortinet FortiAIGate or other AI gateway and runtime\-security technologies. · Microsoft Entra ID, SSO/RBAC, Prometheus, Grafana or Log Analytics. · VMware vSphere/VCF, Dell PowerEdge and private or hybrid infrastructure. · FinOps, API consumption reporting or enterprise data\-access governance. You do not need prior experience with every AI product listed. Strong Azure, Kubernetes, Linux, networking and automation skills are the foundation; we value the ability to learn new infrastructure technologies. Relevant Azure, CKA, Terraform, VMware or NVIDIA certifications are welcome. Pay: $150,000\.00 \- $200,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Full Stack Web Developer
jobs.description: Warmoth Guitar Products, Inc. has been building custom guitar and bass parts in Puyallup for over 45 years. We are a family owned and operated business located in Puyallup on South Hill. Much of what we sell is configured by the customer on Warmoth’s website before it gets made. We love guitars and our customers love them too. Our website is the businesses primary platform and we are seeking a developer to manage it. **Hours:** Full\-time, Monday – Friday, 8:00am – 4:30pm, onsite **Compensation:** $90,000 \- $130,000/yearly, DOE **Benefits:** Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Employee Assistance Program, Employee Discount Program, 401(k) with up to a 4% employer match, Paid Holidays, Vacation and Sick Leave **The Job** You will manage the Company website and internal web applications. This includes the Magento 2 (Adobe Commerce) storefront and its custom configurator, the Node.js tools the shop runs on, and much more. The site sits behind Cloudflare that you will manage, to include DNS, WAF, bot rules, and caching. When bots hit the configurator at 2am, you will be the one responsible for figuring out what they are doing and shutting them down. You would design, build, test, deploy, and fix the website when it breaks. You keep the website up for customers around the clock and hold to Company security and compliance standards while doing so. **Primary Job Duties/Responsibilities Include, but are not limited to:** * Manage and maintain the Magento 2 (Adobe Commerce) architecture, including custom modules, themes, and third\-party extensions. * Troubleshoot and debug code across Magento 2 (Adobe Commerce), PHP, and JavaScript. * Develop and support internal web applications built on Node.js and Postgres. * Build and consume REST and GraphQL APIs for the storefront and internal systems. * Implement SEO techniques and use site data to increase traffic and performance. * Work web tickets through our help desk and track projects in Trello daily. * Ensure the website is operating properly and cross compatible across various browsers and mobile devices. * Manage Cloudflare: DNS, WAF rules, bot mitigation, caching, page rules, watching traffic, spotting abuse, and tuning the rules. * Synchronize and update development and production environments; deploy through CI/CD. * Utilize Claude and other approved AI tools to accelerate coding, debugging, documentation, and testing. * Proactively identify and suggest opportunities for web\-related improvements. * Maintain strict adherence to internal and external security and compliance standards. **Requirements** * Skills: + Excellent verbal and written communication. + Excellent organization and attention to detail. + Excellent time management. + Confident decision making. + Strong analytical and problem\-solving. + Professional email and phone etiquette. + High level of integrity and professionalism * Able to: + Operate efficiently and stay focused in a sometimes\-distracting environment. + Prioritize tasks while adapting to shifting workloads and changing priorities. + Handle sensitive, confidential and proprietary information properly. + Type 40\+ wpm and 10 key by touch. + Navigate and use Excel, Word, Outlook, (Microsoft Office Suite). **Required Experience** * 3\+ years of professional web development * 3\+ Magento 2 (Adobe Commerce) experience (themes, modules, customization) in a production environment. * PHP 8\+. * JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3\. * Node.js for internal applications and service\-layer work. * MySQL: schema design and query writing. * Postgres Database Management * Git: feature branching, rebasing, merge workflows. * Linux and Windows command line: file system, scripting, process control. * REST and GraphQL APIs, both consuming and building. * Daily use of AI coding tools in your development workflow. Warmoth’s approved tool is Claude. You need solid judgment on when to trust output, when to verify it, and what data never leaves the company. * Basic networking and server concepts: DNS, ports, firewalls, Apache/Nginx. * Cloudflare or equivalent CDN/WAF: DNS management, firewall rules, caching. **Preferred Experience** * Vue.js or React. * Sass/Less, Bootstrap, jQuery. * Docker. * CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent). * Python, Java, C\+\+, C\#, or another object\-oriented language. * Kanban\-style project tracking (Trello or similar) and help desk ticketing. **Working Environment** This position does not supervise other positions and is a team of one that reports directly to the Chief Operating Officer (COO). It is full\-time, onsite, Monday – Friday from 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM, and may be expected to work as needed for emergencies. This position works in a temperature\-controlled office environment with four to five other people. This individual will work both independently and with other employees, as needed. This position will spend most of the day sitting or standing at a desk, working at a computer, speaking on the phone, or with individuals in person. **To Apply** * Resume. * A link to a portfolio, GitHub, or a live site you built or maintain. * 2–3 references, at least 2 from work\-related experience. * A short description of which Requirements you meet and how they would benefit Warmoth.

to application architecture, testing, source control, security, and deployment. * Experience providing technical lead s the flexibility to choose between multiple investment options. **Social Part\-time employees who are in pay status during the month of the holiday qualify for the holiday on a pro\-rata basis. Compensation for holidays (including personal holiday) will be proportionate to the number of hours in pay status in the month to that required for full\-time employment, excluding all holiday hours. Pay status includes hours worked and time on paid leave. **Sick Leave** Full\-time employees earn eight hours of sick leave per month. Overtime eligible employees who are in pay status for less than 80 hours per month, earn a monthly proportionate to the number of hours in pay status, in the month to that required for full\-time employment. Pay status includes hours worked, time on paid leave and paid holiday. jobs.description: **About Turing** ================ Turing's mission is to accelerate superintelligence to drive real economic progress. As the Enterprise AI Account Director for a consumer packaged goods company, you will own an established custom engineering relationship both commercially and operationally. You will expand the account by identifying operations, supply chain, and commercial workflows where AI can create measurable value, selling those deployments, and overseeing delivery through a senior Forward\-Deployed Engineer or delivery lead. This is a high\-ownership role for someone who combines commercial instinct, enterprise credibility, and delivery leadership. **As the Enterprise AI Account Director, You Will** --------------------------------------------------- ### **Expand the Client Relationship** Build relationships across multiple buying centers and identify new sponsors and decision\-makers beyond the current buyer. ### **Identify AI Deployment Opportunities** Assess the client's operations, supply chain, and commercial workflows to identify two or three quantified opportunities where AI deployment can create measurable value. ### **Sell Follow\-On Work** Translate identified opportunities into clear scopes of work and lead the expansion from discovery through client alignment and signed SOWs. ### **Own Delivery Quality** Maintain single\-point accountability for the client relationship and business outcome. Oversee the embedded delivery team through a senior FDE lead or delivery lead. ### **Manage Commercial Performance** Own SOWs, pricing, margin, and delivery quality. Establish a written scope baseline and weekly issue log to maintain alignment across the client and delivery teams. ### **Build Reusable Capabilities** Harvest at least one reusable component from the engagement for Turing's Enterprise AI platform. **The Anti\-Sell** ------------------ **Commercial and delivery ownership:** This is not a pure delivery or project management role.
